If anyone in the party has a stage-4 Prime Weapon, a second option appears: Normal mode 'Forward!' (Mesosiderite will NOT drop) vs Hard mode 'To the deepest dark!' (Mesosiderite has a chance to drop only for stage-4 players). Aminon is locked into hard mode for the rest of the run, so choose carefully. It always opens the fight with Incessant Void a few moments after aggro/pull (usually about 2 melee rounds).

Changes its elemental weakness based on the TP move used; counter with the opposing element's magic damage to proc blue (!!): Demonfire (Fire) -> counter with Water; Torrential Pain (Water) -> counter with Thunder; Frozen Blood (Ice) -> counter with Fire; Ensepulcher (Earth) -> counter with Wind; Ceaseless Surge (Lightning) -> counter with Earth; Blast of Reticence (Wind) -> counter with Ice. Even 0-damage subjob Elemental Magic procs it; countering with the correct element five times in a row procs a stronger !! and removes active fetters. Unaffected by Slow/Elegy.

Resistance ranking: 5% (near-immune) to any element that is not its last TP move's element, 150% (very weak) to the corresponding element (Fire after Demonfire, etc.), and 70% to its current elemental weakness. Geomancy 50%; it also resists Ranged attacks at 5%. It gains -5% Damage Taken for each 30 seconds it stays un-proc'd after a TP move, retained for the rest of the fight; proccing does NOT reset accumulated DT, and the DT is not reset even after leaving the battle area and returning.

Bane of Tartarus is used every 4 minutes from the start of battle: it Dispels all buffs including food, inflicts Death and a ~60-second weakness, and generally KOs everyone within its ~20+ yalm range. The Death effect can be resisted with Resist Death gear; a proc delays the timer. Unlike Setting the Stage it can be stopped by Elemental Sforzo (though it still fully dispels and weakens); Perfect Defense and Mana Wall also work; Valiance and other magic-damage-reduction reduce it; possessing a Ra'Kaznar Seal reduces its power (potentially survivable with Scherzo/Migawari/Earthen Armor, though testing is needed). It can also be triggered by healing Aminon with the matching Elemental Magic or skillchain to the last TP move. On a wipe/recovery the timer does not stop; after three idle minutes the first move is Bane of Tartarus, which must hit a target before the timer resets (you may not bind and run away while the timer passes).

Possessing a Ra'Kaznar Seal changes several abilities: Bane of Tartarus prevents its Death; Blast of Reticence inflicts Silence instead of Mute; Crippling Agony prevents equipment removal; Demonfire inflicts Burn (-19/tic) instead of Plague; Ensepulcher inflicts Slow instead of Petrification; Eternal Misery and Impudence inflict Haunt with no enmity reset; Incessant Void prevents its Dispel; Tenebrous Grip prevents Reraise removal; Torrential Pain inflicts Poison instead of Taint.

Its usable TP moves and elemental Resistance Rank depend on which hand element is showing. Thunder hand -> Zap / Concussive Shock / Undulating Shockwave (Undulating Shockwave changes it to Wind hands after); resistance rank 70% Earth, 5% every other element. Wind hand -> Chokehold / Tearing Gust / Shrieking Gale (Shrieking Gale changes it to Thunder hands after); resistance rank 70% Ice, 5% every other element. With both hands up only Ice damage is effective. Geomancy 50%.

Zap copies one debuff from Gartell to all party members in range — avoid applying strong DoTs (it may transfer them; a magic-bursted Helix practically guarantees a 1-shot on anyone inflicted). Chokehold steals one buff from each party member in range and transfers it to Gartell; absorbing Shell V makes nuking much harder, so cancel and re-apply Shell/Protect (Gartell seems to prioritize Shell and Protect). Tearing Gust inflicts a heavy Magic Defense Down — remove it (Erase/Panacea) or Gartell's attacks do increased damage. Shrieking Gale is heavy Wind damage plus knockback.

Dealing elemental damage (including skillchains) matching the current element heals it for extreme amounts and forces a rage — use the opposing element to proc blue (magic-burst for best odds). This also applies to Level 3 skillchains: do not use a Light skillchain, or you will force the Wind AND Thunder alignment procs.

After 3:00 it begins summoning a Gyve on the top-enmity player; these deal Wind or Thunder damage (the Gyve's colour indicates which) and inflict a very strong Shock and Choke effect of about -296 each — move the tank out of them and Erase/Panacea, since Gartell does much more damage with your VIT and MND reduced this much. Gains a stacking ~5% DT and ~5% damage-up per nameless attack, which also applies to its Gyve (dangerous if Gartell is left un-proc'd, especially with Choke's VIT down).

Any elemental damage opposing its currently selected element has a chance to proc blue (magic bursting strongly advised); a proc removes the DT/damage-up stacks and can disable the oldest elemental aura. Per SE, proccing multiple times can force a change of hands and will delay its use of 'special abilities'.

Spell tiers by HP: Addle and Slowga throughout; above 50% Stone V, Stonega IV, Fire V, Firaga IV; below 50% it switches to one tier higher — Stone VI, Stonega V, Fire VI, Firaga V. Casts roughly every 30-35 seconds.
Throughout the fight: will NOT absorb damage during Slaverous Gale, Disgorge and Dustvoid, but WILL absorb damage during Aeolian Void, Gorge and Psyche Suction.

Below 50% HP it also switches absorption mode based on the spell it casts: a Fire spell triggers magical absorption (all magic heals it) until a Stone spell is cast — after a Fire spell, do physical damage; a Stone spell triggers physical absorption (all physical damage heals it) until a Fire spell is cast — after a Stone spell, do magical damage. The mode changes once the spellcasting completes. Between 50%-25% HP, using the appropriate damage type during casting is acceptable.
Below 25% HP it additionally absorbs all damage during any spellcasting.

It has no innate Silence resistance but continues to behave as if it were not silenced, switching modes silently and changing the absorption damage type. Silence is potentially useful in a group at 25% and lower to limit healing while it is casting.

Spawns Onychophora's Sandworm after any skillchain performed on it — x2 for a Lv1, x4 Lv2, x6 Lv3, x8 Lv4 (Light->Light etc.). Repeating a skillchain will not spawn more on top of existing ones unless a higher level skillchain was performed.

Counterattacks with Doomvoid — a 1-shot K.O. for the entire alliance — if hit with the same skillchain repetitively. The same skillchain may not be repeated within the last five skillchains performed.
Builds power for Disgorge by absorbing damage as well as by using Gorge. A backup tank is advised.
Its unique TP move (called Psyche Suction in its notes, Psyche Absorption in the tables) is an unremovable and significant Impact-style stat reduction.

At 55% Ou levels up and its HP bar shows briefly before hiding again, and it starts using higher-tier magic (single-target shifts to AoE).

45% Zero Hour (AoE magic throat stab, hate reset, 60s Inhibit TP); 30% Target (eyes light up, enabling Eleventh Dimension: a 3:00 Terror on the Target'd player; shifting hate off that player disables it, and Ou gains Interference from this point on).

Access: the Omen run initiator must hold all 5 Omen boss beads and ~55+ mobs must be cleared before warping to Ou's floor; all participants lose their Omen boss beads on entry.

notes: The Wyrm God, an Abyssea Notorious Monster fought in Abyssea-Empyreal Paradox (~65,000 HP; ~800,000 on the Very Difficult ★ battlefield). Entry needs 10,000 cruor and a Crimson traverser stone. Title Wyrm God Defier.
Despite the name and the shape, it is NOT a member of the dragon family.

Stances: it opens with wings spread and swaps roughly every three minutes. Spread, it absorbs damage dealt while it readies a weaponskill or casts, and uses -ga spells; folded, it absorbs nothing, takes about 30% less damage from everything, and casts Ancient Magic instantly. The page notes it is likely but UNCONFIRMED that Comet goes with folded wings and Meteor with spread.

HP gates: at 66% it gains Atomic Ray, Dark Matter, tier-2 Ancient Magic and tier-5 -ga. At 33% it gains Protostar, Supernova, Comet and Meteor. It opens the fight with all tier-1 Ancient Magic and tier-4 -ga.

Nearing defeat it may repeat one of Protostar, Supernova, Comet or Meteor up to five times in a row. Meteor spam has a 30-yalm range and is very hard to survive without a Primeval Brew; Fool's Drink and Fool's Powder are the usual answer.

Its standard melee swings count as TP moves, the way an Iron Giant's do, so "!!" weaknesses can only be struck by timing your attacks into the gaps between its swings. Those swings are a conal AoE of roughly 10 yalms and are blocked by 1-4 Utsusemi shadows.

It also hits anyone standing at its tail when it attacks, and the tail attacks carry an Additional Effect: Stun — which makes retreating after a Draw In genuinely dangerous. Triggering a blue weakness stops it meleeing for the duration.
Red, blue and yellow stagger windows key off the time SHINRYU HAS BEEN ENGAGED, not the time you entered the battlefield.
Susceptible to red, blue and yellow "!!" staggers, and to Slow, Paralyze, Addle and Blind. Immune to Stun.
The Atma is granted on winning AND on exiting the BCNM if you managed to trigger a red weakness. Any Atma, cruor enhancement and Abyssea temporary item may be used against it.

Solo with a Primeval Brew is possible but has two traps. Supernova's Doom is not covered by the brew and will kill you fast — bring a Doom Screen. And using the brew while its wings are spread, into a TP move or a cast, feeds it a huge heal through Damage Absorption; wait for the wings to fold first.
30-minute battlefield time limit. That is the standard BCNM clock and has nothing to do with Visitant status, which is unlimited in Abyssea - Empyreal Paradox.

The fight occurs in 3 stages. It respawns in each stage with the remaining HP it had when it despawned; between stages you always disengage, which stops trusts healing you — have high HP before pushing its health down too far.
Stage 1: initially spawns as Steamy Samantha. Occasionally uses Bad Breath for ~1000 damage. Immediately uses Sweet Breath before despawning at roughly 75% HP.

Stage 2: respawns as Sultry Samantha and immediately uses Bad Breath for ~1500 damage. Frequently uses Bad Breath; occasionally Sweet Breath, Impale and Vampiric Lash. Gains a random, occasional enspell enfeeble effect this stage, from endrain to any of the enfeebles Bad Breath can inflict. Immediately uses Sweet Breath before despawning at 45-50% HP. Skipped entirely if enough damage is done during stage 1.

Stage 3: respawns as Sybaritic Samantha and immediately uses Bad Breath for ~1500 damage. Can use Bad Breath multiple times back to back without needing TP after the initial one (seems to come in waves of 3). Occasionally uses Sweet Breath, Impale and Vampiric Lash — these have no activation time and inflict 1000-1600 damage.
Stage 3 only: procs and becomes terrorized when players use weaponskills in response to a readied TP move. The proc is not guaranteed and seems to only work on Sweet Breath or Bad Breath.
Possesses a powerful regen of ~2% HP/tick. When proced, the regen is disabled for the duration of the terror (roughly 20 seconds).

All breath attacks are conal, not AoE, in every phase — a Paladin or Rune Fencer tank mitigates Bad Breath effectively. During stage shifts Bad Breath targets whoever had hate before the despawn, so all party members aside from the tank should run away during despawn/phase shifts.
It is impossible to one-shot this NM from stage 1 — it will always have at least 1 HP until it gets Bad Breath off for its final stage before it dies.

Leaf Dagger.d: Single-target piercing damage. Additional effect: Poison (potency scales with level).

Hypnic Lamp.d: Inflicts Sleep (2~3 min) on targets facing the user. The enhanced version used by NMs inflicts nightmare sleep.
Hypnic Lamp.notes: Condition: lanterns attached to the Orobon. Bypasses shadows without removing them. Destroying the lanterns locks access to it (Nerrivik).

Incisive Apotheosis.d: Severe wind damage to players in a cone-shaped area with a brief Weakness and an Enmity reset. Used below 25% HP or while the Blink Whirlwind aura is active.

Frypan.d: Smashes the area with a frying pan.
Frypan.notes: Damage and Stun (5-15s), 10' radius. Consumes 2-3 shadows. A Moblin TP move.

Incinerator.d: Deals conal fire damage. Additional effect: Burn.

Sacred Caper.d: Area-of-effect light magic damage. Additional effect: Rasp and Terror.

Everyone's Rancor.d: Invokes rancor to spite a single target.
Everyone's Rancor.notes: Damage is 50x the amount of Tonberries slain. Only used by certain Notorious Monsters, generally only once and when they have reached a certain percentage of HP (usually 25%).

Berserker Dance.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in WOTG areas.

Smite of Fury.d: Deals critical damage to a single target.
Smite of Fury.notes: Used only by some notorious monsters.

Tenebral Crush.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Defense Down.

Veil of Chaos.d: Deals Light elemental damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback, Amnesia, and enmity reset

Equalizer.d: Deals physical damage to players in range. Additional effect: Knockback.

Sandspray.d: Deals damage to players in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Blindness and Accuracy Down (-100).

Double Claw.d: A 2-hit physical attack on a single target.

Memento Mori.d: Self-buff. Gains Magic Attack Bonus (+25 Magic Attack Bonus, 30 seconds).
Memento Mori.notes: Giltine follows Memento Mori with Gala Macabre; stunning Memento Mori prevents it.

Sparkstorm.d: Lightning-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect centred on a player. Additional effects: Accuracy Down (-50), Magic Accuracy Down (-50) and TP reduction.

Turbulence.d: Damage to players in an area of effect centred on the monster.
Turbulence.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Removes all shadows.

Cold Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Bind
Cold Breath.notes: Strength of ability is reliant on the current HP of the mob using it, like most Breath attacks.

Molting Burst.d: Deals damage and drains HP. Transfers any negative status effects to the target.
Molting Burst.notes: Used by Limules affiliated with light element.

Battle Dance.d: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: DEX Down

Droning Whirlwind.d: Deals wind damage to enemies in an area with Knockback and multiple Dispel. The Bztavian gains 50 Magic Defense and raises its Blink Whirlwind aura (25 shadows). Used as the first TP move below each 25% HP threshold.
Droning Whirlwind.notes: Blink Whirlwind aura removable only by depleting the shadows or dealing ice damage, not by AoE. On Xevioso it opens the !! proc window.

Petro Eyes.d: Petrifies players with a gaze in a cone-shaped area.
Petro Eyes.notes: Inflicts Petrifaction (4-7 min). Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Mucus Spread.d: Splashes a slowing mucus around in a 10' area of effect.
Mucus Spread.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Rhino Attack.d: Deals physical damage to a single target with Knockback and a 100% Attack bonus.

Crushing Gaze.d: Cone-shaped gaze that inflicts Gravity and Slow.

Frond Fatale.d: Cone-shaped Charm. Vir'ava also uses it to summon its Rafflesia adds.

Magic Fruit.d: Restores over 3,000 HP to the user, erases its status ailments, and resets the enmity of the player holding the most hate.

Magma Hoplon.d: Covers the user in and absorbs damage. Enemies that hit it take fire damage.
Magma Hoplon.notes: The Blaze Spikes can be dispelled, the Stoneskin (Status Effect) cannot.

Crispy Candle.d: Hurls a burning candle at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Crispy Candle.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).

Blackout.d: AoE that inflicts Silence, Paralysis and Blind.

Hypothermal Combustion.d: Explodes for damage based on remaining HP (HP * 1/3) to targets in an area of effect, then falls to the ground.
Hypothermal Combustion.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Hypnotic Sway.d: Inflicts Amnesia on a single target with a gaze attack.
Hypnotic Sway.notes: Used only by Lamia (not Merrow). A single-target gaze.

Cacophony.d: Grants the user a Counter boost and the effect of Haste.

Sweeping Gouge.d: Delivers a twofold attack. Additional effect: Decreases defense.

Baleful Gaze.d: Inflicts Petrifaction (1~2 min) on a single player with a gaze.
Baleful Gaze.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Area is Gaze.

Wing Slap.d: Slaps a single player four times with its wings. Damage with Stun.

Spinning Claw.d: Slashes targets in an area of effect.

Grapple.d: Deals physical damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area originating from pet.

Knife Edge Circle.d: Conal damage with Poison (-20 HP/tick, 1~2 min) and Stun (5~15s).
Knife Edge Circle.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. NOT part of the standard family kit. Used by Tres Duendes in its third form.

Infaunal Flop.d: Conal debuff attack. Inflicts damage plus Slow, Gravity, and HP and MP Down.
Infaunal Flop.notes: Raskovniche's version is -50% HP Down / -50% MP Down / -50% Slow. Morseiu's potency is based somewhat on its endrain potency.

Pile Pitch.d: Stabs a player for massive damage. Additional effect: Enmity reset + Bind
Pile Pitch.notes: Used by Omega, Proto-Omega and Pantokrator. Reduces target's HP to 5% of its maximum value. Cannot K.O. target.

Rage.d: The user gains the Berserk effect, increasing attack.

Poison Breath.d: Deals water breath damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Poison (~1 HP/tick). Damage ~Current HP x 10.3% (cap 405).
Poison Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Hammer-Go-Round.d: Damages nearby targets with a hammer carousel. Additional effect: Knockback

Metallic Body.d: Grants the crab a weak Stoneskin effect (about 25 HP).
Metallic Body.notes: NMs using it have a greatly enhanced potency.

Orthopterror.d: High physical damage in a cone-shaped area with Knockback and Terror.
Orthopterror.notes: Supernal Chapuli 'Mode 2' unique move; also used by Aristaeus.

Numbing Noise.d: Creates an unsettling sound. Additional effect: Stun
Numbing Noise.notes: Nightmare Efts use an enhanced version that works in an AoE radial.

Ecliptic Meteor.d: Summons a meteor to smash the opposition. Additional effect: Paralysis + Bio + Blind

Caudal Capacitor.notes: A radial, no-damage Stun centred on the caster. On Pakecet it grants Shock Spikes; Shockmaw follows it by switching to its Lightning casting phase.

Razor Fang.d: Bites a single target in a twofold attack.

Pinecone Bomb.d: Lobs a pinecone at a single target.

Jamming Wave.d: A jamming signal silences targets in an area of effect.
Jamming Wave.notes: Unusually high accuracy. Generally cannot be fully resisted without some form of Resist Silence.

Scissor Guard.d: Grants the crab a Defense Bonus: base defense x2 for 1 minute.
Scissor Guard.notes: Overwrites any existing Defense Down (e.g. Acid Bolts) and is likewise overwritten by a new Defense Down. Nightmare Crabs use an enhanced version that directly reduces physical damage by ~90% and cannot be dispelled.

Blood Weapon.d: Self-buff: for its duration the user’s melee hits drain the target’s HP equal to the damage dealt.

Hex Eye.d: Gaze that inflicts Paralysis on players facing the enemy, in a cone.
Hex Eye.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Ore Lob.d: Deals very high damage with a ranged attack to enemies in an area of effect.
Ore Lob.notes: Used by Stronghold Notorious Monsters and Campaign leaders Di'Dha Adamantfist and Ga'Dho Softstep (the latter summons Gu'Dho Staggershell to use the ability simultaneously). Also used by Mu'Nhi Thimbletail, Va'Gho Bloodbasked and by most NM Quadavs in Beadeaux (S)

Marrow Drain.d: Drains MP from a single player.
Marrow Drain.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Pyric Blast.d: Deals fire breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Plague.
Pyric Blast.notes: Used while the right/middle head is alive. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Orcish Counterstance.d: Grants the user the effect of Counterstance.
Orcish Counterstance.notes: Only used in Wings of the Goddess (Shadowreign) areas.

Fuscous Ooze.d: Damage in a frontal cone. Additional effects: Weight and Encumbrance (30~45s).
Fuscous Ooze.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Prevents equipment from being changed; it used to also strip equipment from the target, which was removed in the October 7th 2014 update because losing iLvl gear was too powerful.

Spoil.notes: Initially applied as STR -10, and counts down by 1 (STR -10, STR -9, STR -8, ...) until wearing off completely.

Tail Thrust.d: Strikes a single target with its tail.

Haymaker.d: Punches the daylights out of all targets in front. Additional effect: Amnesia
Haymaker.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing.

Feathered Furore.d: Removes one random piece of equipment from players in a fan shaped area.
Feathered Furore.notes: Used only by Yagudo in WOTG areas. It will randomly remove one piece of visible equipment (i.e. anything other than accessories or ranged/ammo), and will also remove any shield/grip/sub-weapon if the main weapon is knocked off. However, this ability has a chance to miss. It has no effect on pets or NPC defenders.

Dark Invocation.d: Deals heavy dark damage to a single target. Additional effect: Doom/Death
Dark Invocation.notes: Exact effect(s) of this ability uncertain; used only by certain Campaign leaders and notorious monsters. May rarely be used by ordinary Yagudo populating Campaign areas; one used in West Sarutabaruta by a Yagudo Condottiere did about 400 damage to a 75 RDM/WHM.

Glassy Nova.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: full Dispel (removes all buffs, including food) and all stats down (-78).

Erosion Dust.d: Spreads eroding dust particles on targets in an area of effect, dealing damage and inflicting Dia.
Erosion Dust.notes: Dia effect is equivalent to Dia III. The damage dealt per tic, however, is 11 damage.

Incisive Denouement.d: Severe wind damage to a single target with an Enmity reset and all stats down. Used below 50% HP.

Arrow Deluge.d: Delivers a threefold ranged attack to targets in an area of effect.
Arrow Deluge.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a bow. If they lost their bow, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.

Proboscis.d: Steals MP and dispels one beneficial status effect from targets in front.
Proboscis.notes: Damage shown in chat log is done to MP instead of HP.

Batholithic Shell.d: The user gains Blaze Spikes, Stoneskin, Haste, Attack Bonus, and Magic Attack Bonus (dispellable).

Venom.d: Deals damage in a fan shaped area. Additional effect: poison
Venom.notes: Additional effect can be removed with Poisona.

Extremely Bad Breath.d: A fan-shaped breath that instantly K.O.s players in range.

Lethal Triclip.d: Deals damage in a threefold attack to all players in range. Additional effect: Max HP Down
Lethal Triclip.notes: Only used by Megalotaur, Torvotaur, Tikbalang, Shadowclaw and Bukhis.

Venom Shell.d: Inflicts Poison in an area of effect centred on the user.
Venom Shell.notes: Poison ticks for 16 HP and lasts 2 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. It uses Venom Shell to return into its shell and regenerate.

Faze.d: Inflicts Terror on a single target.
Faze.notes: Sight-based; turning away from the monster negates it.

Frigid Shuffle.d: An icy waltz that paralyzes targets who see it.
Frigid Shuffle.notes: A GAZE attack — bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Ironbeak Inguza's version also resets enmity on all affected party members; turning your back to it avoids the reset.

Jettatura.d: Terrorizes players in a frontal gaze.
Jettatura.notes: Avoidable by facing away. Kotan-kor Kamuy's terror lasts 15 seconds and it always follows this with Hoof Volley.

Ectosmash.d: Teleports in to smack a single target.
Ectosmash.notes: Can critical hit. Mob is still set to same spot for attacks and abilities that deal with monster position, such as Sneak Attack and Cover. Monster will always return to this starting position after. Consumes 1 shadow.

Zephyr Mantle.notes: 4 shadows for ordinary Puks; up to 10 for Notorious Monsters.

Discharger.notes: Used by Omega at low health (sometimes sooner).

Wing Cutter.d: Damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Wing Cutter.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Heat Breath.d: Deals HP-dependent fire damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.
Heat Breath.notes: HP-dependent damage; follows Riddle. Ignores shadows.

Spinning Fin.d: A spinning attack that damages targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Asthenic Fog.d: A mist drowns all nearby targets.

Catapult.d: Tosses a boulder at a single target.
Catapult.notes: Used by RNG Gigas as a ranged attack.

Ion Efflux.d: An ion outflow damages players in front. Additional effects: Paralysis

Canopierce.d: Damage split among targets, plus Rasp.

Colossal Blow.d: Strikes a player for massive damage. Additional effect: Enmity reset + Knockback
Colossal Blow.notes: Used only by Proto-Omega, in its final form. Because of the long time to ready, it can be easily dodged or stunned.

Virulent Haze.d: Inflicts Burn and Addle on monsters in a frontal cone.
Virulent Haze.notes: Amphitrite (the family's Limascabra) counters with it after absorbing damage, and its Addle lands even on a player in i119 gear with high magic evasion. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. The element icon measures (173,118,50) against the Fire reference gem (166,111,48).

Polar Bulwark.d: Grants the monster an undispelable Physical Shield (~60s).
Polar Bulwark.notes: Used while the left head is alive (right head in Nyzul, where the bulwarks are reversed).

Incessant Fists.d: Delivers a fivefold punching attack to a single target.
Incessant Fists.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing and Dabargar the Stoic.

Mortal Revolution.d: Performs a spinning attack on all nearby targets. Additional effect: Knockback + Stun
Mortal Revolution.notes: Only used by Armored Chariot, Shielded Chariot, and Impervious Chariot. Stun can last 3-5 seconds.

Vitriolic Barrage.d: Bombards nearby targets with acid, dealing fixed damage. Additional effect: Poison
Vitriolic Barrage.notes: Damage is 1000 divided by all targets, like 1,000 Needles. Poison can take 20/tick.

Sprout Smack.d: Single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Slow.

Carnal Nightmare.d: An enervating wave erases all TP in an area of effect.
Carnal Nightmare.notes: Reduced effectiveness on pets and Campaign NPCs (only partial loss).

Condemnation.d: Threefold physical damage in a frontal cone, with additional Stun.
Condemnation.notes: Restricted move — used by Dark Kindred (Dynamis, Uleguerand Range, Castle Oztroja [S], Campaign, Voidwatch). Consumes 3 shadows.

Giga Slash.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance. Absorbable by Utsusemi.

Barofield.d: Deals wind damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Weight (Gravity).
Barofield.notes: Emitted from the central head. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Deep Sea Dirge.notes: The only single-target move in the family's kit.

Deadly Hold.d: Deals critical damage to a single target.

Cimicine Discharge.d: Earth-based AoE that inflicts Slow on players while the gnat gains Haste.

Tail Roll.d: Deals damage to targets in a cone-shaped area originating from the user.

Train Fall.d: Deals damage equal to six times base damage to a single player and drains HP for an equal amount.
Train Fall.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. NOT part of the standard family kit. Used by Tres Duendes in its second form.

Damnation Dive.d: Twofold damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Stun (up to 15 seconds).
Damnation Dive.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Consumes 2-3 shadows. Also reported for Ghrah in "bird" form.

Guided Missile.d: Targets players within an area of effect with a missile. Additional effect: Bind

Slipstream.d: Inflicts Accuracy Down and Ranged Accuracy Down (-25, 2~3 min) on players in an area of effect.
Slipstream.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Frenzy Pollen.notes: Used only by Nightmare Hornets in Dynamis - Tavnazia and the Chasmic Hornet in Abyssea - La Theine.

Lamb Chop.d: Deals critical damage to a single target.
Lamb Chop.notes: When performed by a Beastmaster with Ready, it carries skillchain attributes.

Somersault.notes: Used only in Chains of Promathia areas.

Infernal Bulwark.d: Self-buff. Grants Haste, Stoneskin, Attack Boost, Defense Boost, Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus.
Infernal Bulwark.notes: Dispel it if you can - Gogmagog's page recommends it specifically.

Trebuchet.d: Tosses a large boulder at a single target, dealing heavy damage in an area of effect.
Trebuchet.notes: Used only by Antaeus, Briareus, and Grandgousier. AoE damage is centered around the target. Randomly removes Sambas.

Mow.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Poison
Mow.notes: Poison (~10-25 HP/tick, 30s). Can critical hit. Consumes 2-3 shadows.

Wing Whirl.d: Strikes all targets within an area of effect with its wings.

Earth Pounder.d: Deals damage to enemies within area of effect. Additional effect: Dexterity Down

Hyper Pulse.d: Deals damage to players within an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind + Weight
Hyper Pulse.notes: Used by Omega, Proto-Omega and Pantokrator. Bind effect has a very short duration. Proto-Omega and Pantokrator inflict Weight.

Magma Fan.d: Expels a blast of at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Rock Smash.d: Damages a single target. Additional effect: Petrifaction

Atramentous Libations.d: Drains HP from players in an area of effect around the monster. The user gains an intimidation effect.

Lowing.d: Inflicts Plague on targets in an area of effect.

Sledgehammer.d: Delivers a sledgehammer blow to all targets in front. Additional effect: Petrifaction
Sledgehammer.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing and Dabargar the Stoic.

Cathartic Caper.d: Cone-shaped magic damage that resets the target's TP.

Cocoon.d: Grants the crawler a Defense Bonus (+100%).

Ululation.d: Paralyzes all enemies in an area of effect.

Nimble Snap.notes: Nightmare Efts and Splacknuck use an enhanced version that hits three times.

Diamond Shell.d: Nullifies all physical damage from behind.
Diamond Shell.notes: Used only by Quadav in WOTG areas.

Hell Slash.d: Single target damage. Can critical hit.

Sensilla Blades.d: Deals physical damage to players in a narrow cone-shaped area with Knockback.

Drill Branch.d: Drills a single target with a branch.

Pleiades Ray.d: Fires a magical ray at nearby targets. Additional effects: Paralysis + Blind + Poison + Plague + Bind + Silence + Slow
Pleiades Ray.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing with health below 20%.

Black Cloud.d: A cloud deals damage to players in range. Additional effect: Blind.
Black Cloud.notes: Blind is about -20 accuracy for 5-7 minutes. Removes all shadows.

Foxfire.d: Strikes frontal targets with a luminous wave. Additional effect: Stun
Foxfire.notes: Only used by Fomors that wield a one-handed weapon (principally RDM, THF, PLD, BST, BRD, RNG, NIN, and COR fomors).

Brain Drain.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Blazing Angon.d: Deals fire damage to players in an area with Defense Down (-50%) and Knockback. Used by Mamool-ridden Wivres. Ignores shadows but does not remove them; centered around the target.
Blazing Angon.notes: Used by Mamool Rider Wivres and Lancelord Gaheel Ja.

Jet Stream.d: Three-hit damage to a single player.

Kick Back.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance. Absorbable by Utsusemi.

Trembling.d: Deals physical damage in an area of effect and dispels one status enhancement.
Trembling.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Sweet Breath.d: Puts all targets in a fan-shaped area to sleep.

Epoxy Spread.d: Splashes a binding resin around in a 10' area of effect.
Epoxy Spread.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Permafrost Requiem.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror.

Spore.d: Cone-shaped spore cloud that inflicts Paralysis.

Necrotic Brume.d: AoE dark damage with Blind, Curse, and Paralyze.

Supersonics.d: Inflicts Accuracy Down on targets in an area of effect.
Supersonics.notes: ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Mighty Snort.d: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Hate reset
Mighty Snort.notes: Only used by Apis, Chichevache and Audumbla, Audumbla's version increases in damage as it's HP decreases.

Subsonics.d: Inflicts Defense Down (-25%, 90~180s) on targets in an area of effect.
Subsonics.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Clobber.d: Deals physical damage to players behind it (a tail swipe) with additional Knockback. Absorbable by 2-3 shadows.

High-Tension Discharger.d: Discharges a powerful current that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Stun
High-Tension Discharger.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.

Negative Whirl.d: Dark winds damages targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Slow

Dust Cloud.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Blind.

Trinary Tap.d: Attempts to absorb three buffs from a single target, or otherwise steals HP.
Trinary Tap.notes: Absorbs up to three buffs (including food); drains up to 300 HP if it cannot take enough buffs. Goes through shadows.

Fire Break.d: Deals heavy damage to targets in front.

Soul Drain.d: Single-target unaspected physical damage that drains the target’s HP.

Turbine Cyclone.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect with knockback, and dispels 1-3 status enhancements.

Wild Rage.d: Deals physical damage to enemies within area of effect.
Wild Rage.notes: Has additional effect of Poison when used by King Vinegarroon.

Horrid Roar.d: Dispels a single target's beneficial effects, removes its enmity and wipes its shadows.
Horrid Roar.notes: The effect varies slightly depending on which wyrm uses it.

Blood Saber.d: Drains HP from players in range.

Soul Accretion.d: Absorbs one buff at random from a single player.
Soul Accretion.notes: Goes through shadows — bypasses them, but does not remove them. Tiyanak uses it almost exclusively below 25% HP.

Invincible.d: Reduces physical damage taken to zero for a short time.

Call of the Moon.d: Howls at the moon to intimidate attackers.
Call of the Moon.notes: All players and Campaign NPCs will be intimidated for a short time.

Thunder Break.d: Deals lightning damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun (10-20s).

Panzerschreck.d: Strikes a single target with a ranged attack; can critical hit.

Deadening Haze.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Silence. Gains a poison aura (-13 HP/tick).

Spike Flail.d: Deals extreme damage in a threefold attack to targets behind the user.
Spike Flail.notes: Only uses this ability if the target with hate is out of reach of the wyrm's head, such as near its hind legs or directly behind it. If fafnir doesn't have enough TP, he will attack this target with normal attacks with his tail, instead. If the target still has hate when he readies a TP attack, he'll virtually always use the only TP attack solely associated with his tail, Spike Flail. Due to his high regain in combination with attacks made on him, he will likely be able to use this ability the moment a target outside the range of his head has taken hate. Damage can be reduced by Blink, Utsusemi, Stoneskin, PLD's Invincible and Sentinel. General damage is about 1600-2400.

Ichor Stream.d: Spews venomous ichor at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Sinuate Rush.d: Damages nearby targets with an undulating attack.
Sinuate Rush.notes: Only used when the caster is not enfeebled.

Dire Straight.d: Deals damage to a single target.
Dire Straight.notes: Requires a right arm to use. Removes all shadows.

Emetic Discharge.d: Transfers all ailments to another player.
Emetic Discharge.notes: Transfers all of the gnat's ailments onto one player; used by Gnat NMs below ~33% HP.

Poison Pick.d: Damage and Poison (-5 HP/tick, 3 min) to a single player. The poison ticks 1 HP harder for every foe level past 56 (e.g. -6/tick at 57, -24/tick at 75).

Sandspin.d: Area-of-effect damage and Accuracy Down (-25 accuracy, 3 min).

Scalding Breath.d: Deals water damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Burn (~30/tic), Knockback, and a TP reset. Removes all shadows.

Sand Veil.d: Applies a sand shroud to increase evasion.

Shrieking Gale.d: Damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Dispel.

Serpentine Tail.d: Deals physical damage to a player holding hate from behind.
Serpentine Tail.notes: Used only when the hate-holder is behind the Hydra.

Tail Crush.d: Smashes a single target with its tail. Additional effect: Poison

Granite Skin.d: The user gains an undispellable shield that nullifies frontal physical damage for 60 seconds (no effect on Ranged or Magical attacks).

Sable Breath.d: Deals darkness damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.
Sable Breath.notes: Used only by Vrtra and Azdaja.

Foul Waters.d: Cone-shaped damage plus Gravity and Drown (-41 STR, -14 HP/tick).
Foul Waters.notes: Removes all shadows. U Bnai's version is single-target and inflicts Blind instead of Gravity/Drown.

Magic Barrier.d: Grants a temporary immunity to magic (60s).

Jumping Thrust.notes: Functionally similar to Jump. This is only used by Dragoon sahagins.

Stomping.d: Deals heavy damage to a single target.

Nuclear Waste.d: Reduces elemental resistances by 50 to players in range.
Nuclear Waste.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima. Follows this ability with one of the following moves: Flame Thrower, Cryojet, High-Tension Discharger, Smoke Discharger, Hydro Cannon, or Turbofan.

Sharp Sting.d: Deals high damage to target in a ranged attack.

Silence Gas.d: Fan-shaped breath attack dealing damage (scales with current HP). Additional effect: Silence.

Thunderbolt.d: Deals lightning damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Stun.

Bad Breath.d: Cone-shaped breath: damage plus Slow, Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Weight, Bind, and Blind.

Claw Storm.d: Slashes a single target in a threefold attack. Additional effect: Poison

Chomp Rush.d: A threefold attack on a single target with additional Slow (-25%).

Shell Charge.d: Deals damage in a fan-shaped area around the target, causing knockback. Additional effect: Amnesia. Amount of damage varies by TP.
Shell Charge.notes: Used only by Ga'Lhu Nevermolt, and very rarely Di'Dha Adamantfist. Attacking from the side may prevent you from getting hit.

Stalking Prey.d: AoE hate reset. Additional effect: Terror.

Arm Cannon.d: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Max HP and Max MP Down (-50%).

Cold Stare.d: Silences enemies in a line area of effect.
Cold Stare.notes: Only applies when face-to-face with the dhalmel.

Aqua Ball.d: Inflicts water damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down (-10, decays 1 per 9 seconds).

Earth Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Aqua Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.

Tornado Edge.d: Deals physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Max HP Down, Max MP Down, and Max TP Down
Tornado Edge.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in Wings of the Goddess areas.

Great Bleat.d: Lowers maximum HP of targets in an area of effect.

Gates of Hades.d: Deals fire damage to enemies within an area of effect. Additional effect: Burn and INT Down.

Hoof Volley.d: Critical damage to a single target. Resets enmity and causes knockback.
Hoof Volley.notes: May follow immediately after another TP move.

Perdition.notes: Used only by bhoots. Has a five second readying time. Requires equipment or a status boost to block. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Dissolve.d: An enhanced Digest: drains the HP of every target in a frontal cone.
Dissolve.notes: Removes all shadows. Only used by Blobdingnag, Morbid Molasses, Fistule and Lorbulcrud. The enmity of the NM's target is erased a few seconds after the move executes; peripheral targets that are hit do not have their enmity reset.

Grave Reel.d: Steals HP from all targets in an area of effect.

Blistering Roar.d: Deals fire damage to enemies in an area with Terror; grants the user Defense Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus plus a flame aura (unlocks fetters).

Venom Shower.d: Water-based damage to players in a large radius. Additional effects: Poison (-40 HP/tick, 1 min) and Defense Down (-25%).
Venom Shower.notes: Removes all shadows. Depending on the NM the Poison is unremovable by any means except Chakra. Karkinos (at low HP), Krabakarpo, Krabimanjaro (below 50% HP, and it gains Regain), Krabkatoa. It can be evaded by a height difference like Astral Flow, it leaves a Plague aura, and 229 water resist fully resisted both the damage and the poison.

Blitzstrahl.d: Deals lightning damage to a single target.

Concussive Oscillation.d: Smacks around all nearby targets. Additional effect: Knockback + Weight

Root of the Problem.d: Absorbs buffs and TP from a single target.

Back Heel.d: Physical damage to a single target.

Protolithic Puncture.d: Deals severe damage to a single target and resets enmity.

Sticky Thread.d: Inflicts slow on targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Sticky Thread.notes: The slow effect is weaker than the White Magic spell Haste. The spell will overwrite Sticky Thread. If a player has Haste, Sticky Thread will have no effect.

Torpefying Charge.d: Paralyzes players in an area with a gaze (~2 min).

Wind Shear.d: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback. Damage varies with TP; knockback fails if fully resisted.
Wind Shear.notes: Consumes 2-3 shadows. Vulpangue uses an enhanced version that inflicts Weight.

Ore Toss.d: Deals high damage in a ranged attack.
Ore Toss.notes: This ability has somewhat low accuracy. Deals increased damage the further away the target is.

Biting Abrogation.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effects: Knockback, Paralysis, and Dispel (up to 4 buffs).

Goblin Dice.d: Deals a random effect based on the roll of the dice.
Goblin Dice.notes: Causes a completely random effect on players: Sleep, Slow, Dispel, Disease, Stun, Poison, damage, drop TP to 0, Benediction, or recharge abilities. Used only by Vanguard goblins in Dynamis, the Moblin Fantocciniman or the summoned goblin Choplix.

Boiling Point.d: Reduces magic defense in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Boiling Point.notes: This attack can be extremely dangerous, greatly lowering a player's magic defence; thus causing a flan's spells to become tremendously powerful.

Fluid Toss.d: Lobs a ball of liquid at a single player. Damage with a 100% attack bonus.
Fluid Toss.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. Damage appears to vary with TP.

Incinerate.d: Deals fire breath damage to players in a cone-shaped area (~Current HP x 13.75%, cap 700).
Incinerate.notes: Used by Eruca-type crawlers in place of Poison Breath.

Toxic Spit.d: Spews a toxic glob at a single target. Effect: Poison
Toxic Spit.notes: The Tartarus Eft variant deals 18 damage per 3 seconds and lasts 3 minutes (180 seconds) dealing 1080 damage if not cured.

Mayhem Lantern.d: Deals damage and charms players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Shock and Attack Boost on those charmed.
Mayhem Lantern.notes: Not a gaze attack - it still hits players who have turned around, and the Shock DoT prevents charmed players from being slept (Kamohoalii). Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Strap Cutter.d: Removes and disables several (3-5) random equipment slots for a period of time.

Vertical Slash.d: Vertically slashes a single target. Additional effect: Accuracy Down

Hecatomb Wave.d: Conal Wind breath damage (HP x 1/21, max 260) with additional Blind.
Hecatomb Wave.notes: Blind lowers accuracy ~30 for 60-120s. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).

Vacant Gaze.notes: Powered-up Blank Gaze; removes up to 3 buffs.

Netherspikes.d: Projects shadow spikes towards the front at a single target. Additional effect: Bind

Shock Wave.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Sand Trap.d: Petrifies targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Hate reset
Sand Trap.notes: Can be stunned; petrification typically has a very short duration, similar to Stun

Impenetrable Carapace.d: Gains a Defense Boost and a Magic Evasion boost.
Impenetrable Carapace.notes: On Faded Craklaw it instead provides short-term MAGICAL DAMAGE IMMUNITY and cannot be dispelled.

Kick Out.d: Deals damage to targets in a cone behind the user.

Fantod.d: The monster gains a quadruple damage bonus for its next attack round.

Dispelling Wind.d: Dispels beneficial status effects (2-3) from targets in an area of effect.

Aegis Schism.d: Deals an armor breaking blow to a single target. Additional effect: Defense Down

Sonic Boom.d: Inflicts Attack Down (-25%, 2~3 min) on players in an area of effect centred on the monster.
Sonic Boom.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Mega Scissors.d: Conal physical damage dealing 50% of the target's maximum HP, and resets enmity.
Mega Scissors.notes: Removes all shadows. Not a "throat stab" skill — the damage can kill the target. Karkinos (at low HP), Krabimanjaro, Krabkatoa. A frontal cone with high damage and a hate reset.

Synergism.d: Steals HP from any nearby flans.
Synergism.notes: Any sleeping flan will be awoken by this ability. When only 1 flan is in range the flan using Synergism will absorb up to around 50% of the other Flans HP. (This is true for Ebony Puddings. It has not been tested whether or not flans in other zones drain different amount of HP.)

Microspores.d: Transfers all ailments to every player in range.
Microspores.notes: Only used by Goldcap and Morille Mortelle.

Kibosh.d: Inflicts Amnesia on a single target.

Chthonian Ray.d: Inflicts doom in a wide line gaze attack.
Chthonian Ray.notes: Conal gaze that inflicts Doom. Used by certain Notorious Monster Taurus (e.g. Eldertaur, Mindertaur).

Night Stalker.d: Cone-shaped damage that resets the target's TP to 0.

Phase Shift.d: A shockwave deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun + Bind
Phase Shift.notes: Used by Eald'narche in his first form at 66%, 33%, and 1% HP, and by his Exoplates as a 33%-HP reaction; damage escalates each use (~600-1300).

Terror Touch.d: Touches a single target. Additional effect: Attack Down
Terror Touch.notes: Attack -70% for 30~90 seconds. Can critical hit. Consumes 1 shadow.

Amnesic Blast.d: Deals damage in a cone and inflicts Amnesia. Additional effect: Knockback.

Hellborn Yawp.d: AoE Dark damage with additional Blind and Dispel.
Hellborn Yawp.notes: Restricted move — used by Shadowsoul, Abununnu, and Count Bifrons.

Rapid Molt.d: Sheds skin to erase negative debuffs. Additional effect: Regen
Rapid Molt.notes: Doesn't use this unless there's something to Erase.

Painful Whip.d: Deals threefold damage to a single target. Can critical hit.
Painful Whip.notes: Consumes one shadow. On Amphitrite it triggers the switch to absorbing magical damage, after a delay.

Uproot.d: Reduces HP to critical, slows and resets hate; triggers the firefly aura.

Discharge.d: Releases an discharge at nearby targets. Additional effect: Paralyze

Beak Lunge.d: Dives beak-first into a single player. Damage with Knockback.

Absorbing Kiss.notes: Only used by Pepper and Bloodguzzler.

Hi-Freq Field.d: Lowers the evasion of enemies in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Yawn.d: Puts targets who see it to sleep.
Yawn.notes: A GAZE attack — bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Apkallu start with Yawn as their only TP move; as zone-wide Apkallu Hate rises they upgrade to more aggressive moves, and by the time they use Wing Slap they no longer use Yawn.

Vile Belch.d: Belches noxious fumes at targets in an area of effect, inflicting Silence (30~60s) and Plague (100 TP & 6 MP per tick, 15~45s).

Sleet Blast.d: A sleet storm deals damage to enemies in an area of effect.
Sleet Blast.notes: Used only by Jormungand when he's in the sky.

Gnash.d: Inflicts damage equal to 45%~55% of the target's HP.

Sanguinary Slash.d: Physical damage to a single target with Knockback and Max HP Down (~10%).

Cutpurse.d: Randomly removes one piece of the target's equipment.
Cutpurse.notes: If it removes the main weapon, anything in the sub slot is unequipped as well.

Regurgitation.d: Damages a single target with additional Knockback and Bind.

Nihility Song.d: A song that dispels ONE positive effect from players in an area of effect.

Charged Whisker.d: Deals lightning damage to enemies within an area of effect. Removes shadows.

Stygian Vapor.d: Infernal fumes inflicts nearby targets with a plague.

Aerial Wheel.d: Deals a ranged attack to a single target. Additional effect: stun

Shoulder Attack.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: knockback

Gastric Bomb.d: Lobs a long-range acid bomb at a single player. Damage and Attack Down (-50% attack, 2~3 min).

Sonic Wave.d: Reduces defense of enemies in an area of effect.

Depth Charge.d: Inflicts damage, shock, and knockback. The user gains Shock Spikes.

Ballistic Kick.d: Deals conal damage (can reduce the target’s HP to ~5% of maximum), resets hate, and inflicts Encumbrance (~30s).
Ballistic Kick.notes: Resets hate and places Encumberance on every alliance member hit by this move. Can be stunned.
Ballistic Kick.r: 20-30' Front and back wide range conal attack

Pyric Bulwark.d: Grants the monster an undispelable Magical Shield (~60s).
Pyric Bulwark.notes: Used while the right head is alive (left head in Nyzul, where the bulwarks are reversed).

Bubble Curtain.d: Grants the crab a Shell effect: -50% magic damage taken, 3 minutes.
Bubble Curtain.notes: Nightmare Crabs use an enhanced version that applies a Magic Defense Boost that cannot be dispelled.

Sheep Charge.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback
Sheep Charge.notes: When performed by a Beastmaster with Ready, it carries skillchain attributes.

Deadeye.d: Lowers the defense and magic defense of players in a frontal cone.

Riptide Eupnea.d: AoE damage. Additional effects: Max HP Down, Encumbrance and Bind.
Riptide Eupnea.notes: On Marmorkrebs its Max HP Down followed by Sundering Snip is a guaranteed KO on the tank if the Max HP Down lands.

Impale.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis.

Wrath of Gu'Dha.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback and Weight
Wrath of Gu'Dha.notes: Used only by named Dynamis Quadav NM's and Wings of the Goddess NMs. Knockback effect can send players back considerable distances. Occasionally inflicts a potent but short lasting Gravity effect, even if the attack is evaded. This attack can either be Conal or Radial AoE.

Quake Stomp.d: Stomps the ground to boost next attack.

Crossthrash.d: Damages enemies within area of effect with a twofold attack. Additional effect: Knockback
Crossthrash.notes: used by Nightmare Tigers in Dynamis - Qufim and Gerjis in the BCNM 50 called Eye of the Tiger. It is believed to be used by some Tiger's NM aswell.

Viscid Spindrift.d: Conal water-based damage. Additional effects: Attack Down (-33%), Magic Atk Down and Gravity.
Viscid Spindrift.notes: Removes all shadows. Area/Target: conal, centred on the monster.

Tidal Guillotine.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone, or an instant KO if the damage dealt would be greater than 50% of the target's HP.

Photosynthesis.d: Self-buff: gains Regen (potency scales with level). Daytime only.

Spinning Attack.d: Frontal cone dealing damage with Knockback.

Orogenic Storm.d: Deals earth damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Silence, Slow, Blindness, and Evasion Down.

Recoil Dive.d: Deals twofold damage to targets in a frontal cone. Can critical hit.

Sound Blast.d: Inflicts INT Down (-10 INT, decays, 3 min) on players around the monster.
Sound Blast.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Geist Wall.d: Dispels one positive status effect from targets in an area. Removes all shadows.

Seaspray.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone (HP x 0.125, capped at 500 damage for non-NMs). Additional effect: Slow (35%, 30~60s).
Seaspray.notes: Slow effect is equivalent to Slow II. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Full Bloom.d: Sacrifices a nearby pet/Rafflesia to restore roughly 10% HP and erase negative status effects. Additional effect: Stoneskin. Instantly K.O.s a charmed player if used on one.

Calcifying Mist.d: Releases a mist; players in the area are petrified after 20 seconds.

Fevered Pitch.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun and Defense Down

Wings of Agony.d: High damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Paralyze and Sleep.

Howl.d: Grants the effect of Warcry to user and any linked allies.
Howl.notes: Unlike the Warrior's job ability, this expends the mob's TP as a weapon skill rather than function as a job ability. Much like the job ability, this applies to all nearby members of the same family, and any other mobs linked with it (e.g. warmachines). In Campaign Battles, it applies to all members of the Beastmen Confederate in its range.
Howl.r: Self and nearby mobs of same family and/or force up to 20'.

Cyclone Wing.d: Deals darkness damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Sleep

Batterhorn.d: Deals physical damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Knockback. Absorbable by 2-3 shadows.

Rampant Gnaw.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis

Lateral Slash.d: Laterally slashes a single target. Additional effect: Defense Down
Lateral Slash.notes: Reduces defense by 75%. Can be removed with Monk Job Ability Counterstance.

Impact Roar.d: Emits the roar of an impact event, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Crystal Rain.d: Invokes the power of a crystal to deal damage to targets in an area of effect.

Debilitating Spout.d: Deals water damage to players in a cone-shaped area with a full Dispel, Knockback, and Zombie.

Shell Bash.notes: Does not knockback like Head Butt does, but is readied much faster.

Great Whirlwind.d: Deals damage to targets in front. Additional effect: Choke

Accursed Armor.d: Covers the user in cursed spikes. Enemies that hit it become cursed.

Cytokinesis.d: Area-of-effect damage with a powerful Gravity and Knockback.
Cytokinesis.notes: Only used by Blobdingnag and Fistule, which also call forth reinforcements with it — Fistule spawns 2 Pustules after using it. Paints the shadow count '3?'.

Cold Wave.d: Inflicts Frost on targets in an area of effect (AGI -33, HP -14/tick, 15-60s).
Cold Wave.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Smoke Discharger.d: Sprays a cloud of smoke that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Petrifaction
Smoke Discharger.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.

Apocalyptic Ray.d: Inflicts Doom in a conal attack.
Apocalyptic Ray.notes: Inflicts Doom regardless of player facing or position.

Slam Dunk.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: bind

Brownout.d: Lightning-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Blind (-50 Accuracy) and Slow.

Spiral Burst.d: Sacrifices HP for cone-shaped damage and erases all of the ladybug's own negative status effects.

Bubble Armor.d: Grants the user a dispelable Shell (about -20% magic damage taken).

Horror Cloud.d: Inflicts Slow on a single target.
Horror Cloud.notes: Slow is 50%. Blocked by and overwritten by Haste. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Sundering Snip.d: Water-based AoE damage dealing 60% of the target's maximum HP, and applies Magic Defense Down.
Sundering Snip.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. The damage IS reduced by Magic Damage Taken. On Marmorkrebs it is manageable with Sulpor Valiance, but Riptide Eupnea's Max HP Down followed by Sundering Snip is a guaranteed KO on the tank if the Max HP Down is not removed in time. Area/Target: AoE centred on the monster.

Malediction.d: Drains HP from players in range. Damage scales with the monster's level.
Malediction.notes: Used only by Draugar. A stronger form of Blood Saber. Removes all shadows.

Primal Drill.d: Drills into nearby targets with appendages. Additional effect: Bind

Incinerating Lahar.d: Deals fire damage to enemies in a ~10' area with Weakness (~20 sec) and knockback; used below 50% HP or with an active aura. Removes all shadows.

Bombilation.d: Removes TP from players in an area of effect, and halves the TP of NPCs.

Venom Sting.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Poison
Venom Sting.notes: Stronger version of Poison Sting, used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, and Nightmare Scorpions.

Entangle.d: Attempts to bind a single target with vines. Bypasses shadows.

Shackled Fists.d: Cursed fists deals damage in a fivefold attack to a single target.
Shackled Fists.notes: Only used by Fomors using hand-to-hand combat (monks).

Retinal Glare.d: Cone-shaped attack that inflicts damage and Flash.

Spirit Absorption.d: Steals HP or a random buff from a single target.

Mandibular Lashing.d: Deals wind damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Stun.

Bone Crunch.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Plague

Seismohammer.d: Swings the hammer right at a single target. Additional effect: Petrifaction

Shakeshroom.d: Fires a mushroom cap for single-target damage. Additional effect: Disease. Used after Queasyshroom and Numbshroom.

Hexidiscs.d: A sixfold attack damages targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.

Scythe Tail.d: Damages a single target with additional Stun and Knockback.

Foul Breath.d: Deals fire damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Disease.

Meltdown.d: Reactor failure triggers a self-destruct, dealing magic damage based on the doll's remaining HP (HP x 1/2) to targets in an area of effect; the doll then falls to the ground.
Meltdown.notes: When it is about to use this move it curls up and levitates; it can be stunned.

Enervating Grasp.d: Deals area damage. Additional effects: Paralysis, Bind, and Defense Down.

Smokebomb.d: Throws a blinding smoke bomb at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Smokebomb.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).

Blow.d: Lays the smackdown on a single target. Additional effect: Stun

Sharp Strike.notes: Grants 50% boost to attack for about 4 minutes, 15 seconds.

Curse.d: Inflicts Curse on all targets within a 15' radius.
Curse.notes: Reduces maximum HP and MP by 25% for 15~38 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Predatory Glare.d: Glares at targets in a fan-shaped area of effect, leaving them stunned.
Predatory Glare.notes: Only used by Nightmare Tigers in Dynamis - Qufim and Saehrimnir in Einherjar.

Ice Break.d: Deals ice damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind (2-3 min).

Static Prison.d: Lightning-based magic damage to players around the monster. Additional effects: Paralyze, Shock (-20 HP/tick) and multiple buff dispel.
Static Prison.notes: Centred on the monster. Ongo's own table gates it to HP <50%. On Cailimh and Palila it is an aura-only move: Cailimh's dispels 1-2 buffs, Palila's dispels 2 and applies a potent Paralyze.

Body Slam.d: Deals physical damage to enemies in an area of effect. Can critical hit. Damage varies with TP.
Body Slam.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Grim Glower.d: While its eyes glow, petrifies any player who faces its gaze. Blind prevents its use.

Fanatic Dance.d: Attempts to charm targets in an area of effect.
Fanatic Dance.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in Dynamis and Wings of the Goddess areas.

Rending Deluge.d: Water-based AoE damage, and dispels 2-3 status enhancements.
Rending Deluge.notes: Removes all shadows. Area/Target: AoE centred on the monster.

Overthrow.notes: Moving to the side will avoid attack.

Queasyshroom.d: Fires a mushroom cap for single-target damage. Additional effect: Poison. First of the Queasyshroom->Numbshroom->Shakeshroom sequence; requires a full mushroom cap.

Vampiric Lash.d: Single-target attack that absorbs HP. When used by Ameretat-type Morbols it also absorbs all beneficial status effects.

Wild Oats.d: Single-target damage. Additional effect: VIT Down.

Icy Grasp.d: Conal damage with Paralysis and Terror.

Glacial Tomb.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind and Encumbrance (locks gear swaps rather than stripping equipment).

Entomb.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Petrifaction.

MP Drainkiss.d: Drains MP from a single target.
MP Drainkiss.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Insipid Nip.d: Single-target physical damage that absorbs a random attribute from the target.

Earthbreaker.d: Deals damage to enemies within massive area of effect. Additional effect: Stun
Earthbreaker.notes: Stronger version of Earth Pounder, used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, and Nightmare Scorpions.

Nox Blast.d: A dark blast hits targets in front. Additional effect: Knockback and resets TP

Heavy Stomp.d: Deals physical damage to enemies in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis. Damage varies with TP.
Heavy Stomp.notes: Paralysis has a very long duration (up to ~16 min).

Poison Sting.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Poison

Embalming Earth.d: Deals earth damage to enemies in an area with additional Slow. Removes all shadows.

Discoid.d: Releases a fragmenting disc that deals fixed magical damage to players in an area of effect.
Discoid.notes: Only used by Assailer Chariot, Battleclad Chariot, Battledressed Chariot, and Pandemonium Warden.

Impalement.d: Impales a single target, leaving it near death. Additional effect: Slow + resets enmity
Impalement.notes: Inflicts damage similarly to the Tonberry attack Throat Stab; as such, it will normally never inflict a K.O. on its target, but generally leaves it at approximately 5% remaining HP. Only used by Craver NMs. Similar to Murk, Slow effect has low priority can be overwritten/blocked by Haste.Yearner and Usurper can occasionally score greatly increased damage with this attack, causing an immediate K.O. without adequate physical damage reduction.

Wings of Woe.d: High damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Silence, Plague and Bind.
Wings of Woe.notes: None of the three effects can be removed.

Rumble.d: A disorienting vibration lowers evasion of targets in an area of effect.

Diffusion Ray.notes: Only used if person with hate is directly in front.
Diffusion Ray.d: Deals damage and dispels a beneficial effect.

Spikeball.d: Throws a spiky projectile at a single target. Additional effect: Poison

Dark Nova.d: Dark energy damages targets in an area of effect.
Dark Nova.notes: Used during his first phase, in his magic stance.

Promyvion Brume.d: A fog deals area damage. Additional effect: Poison (9/tick).
Promyvion Brume.notes: Damage element is based on the mob's Core. Enmity is reset on certain Cravers.

Molting Plumage.d: Wind-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Dispel and Knockback.

Cesspool.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Plague (-50 TP/-10 MP/tic) and Knockback. The caster gains a poison aura (-117 HP/tic).

Howling Gust.d: AoE wind damage. Additional effects: Knockback, Silence, and Choke.

Ultrasonics.d: Inflicts Evasion Down (-25, 120~180s) on targets in an area of effect.
Ultrasonics.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Flashflood.d: AoE damage that dispels multiple enhancements.

Tail Swing.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Bind

Vivisection.d: AoE damage and a full Dispel. Used when it levels up.

Pentapeck.d: Five-hit physical damage to a single player. Additional effect: Amnesia (~5 seconds).

Righteous Rasp.d: Frontal cone. Additional effects: Magic Defense Down and Defense Down.

Dancing Chains.d: Underworldly chains twist and drown all targets in an area of effect.
Dancing Chains.notes: The damage dealt per tic is 15 HP.

Fulminous Smash.d: AoE damage with Stun and Knockback.

Wind Wall.d: Invokes a protective wind barrier for increased evasion.

Critical Bite.d: Deals extreme damage to a single target.
Critical Bite.notes: More powerful version of Mandible Bite, used only by King Vinegarroon, Serket, and Nightmare Scorpions.

Cursed Sphere.d: Deals dark-based magic damage to players in a 10' area of effect.
Cursed Sphere.notes: Water-based only when cast by Blue Mages; dark for the Fly family.

Baleen Gurge.notes: On Pakecet it also grants water spikes, nullifies the damage type it absorbs while active, and moves one resistance to 100%. Shockmaw follows it by switching to its Water casting phase.

Glacial Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.
Glacial Breath.notes: Used only by Jormungand when he's on the ground.

Great Sandstorm.d: Deals damage to single target. Additional effect: Blind

Dark Spore.d: Fan-shaped breath attack dealing dark damage (scales with the funguar's current HP). Additional effect: Blind.

Turbofan.d: Turns on a powerful turbofan that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Silence
Turbofan.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.

Cryojet.d: Releases a freezing blast that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis
Cryojet.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.

Gravity Field.d: Inflicts Slow (-45%) on targets in an area of effect. Does not override Haste.

Start from Scratch.d: Removes all status ailments from the caster.

Healing Stomp.d: Stomps the ground to apply regeneration.

Scapula Beam.d: Deals magic damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: All Stats Down (-80%). Removes all shadows.

Stygian Release.d: Deals damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Knockback and Dispel (removes one status enhancement).

Big Scissors.d: Single-hit physical damage to one player.
Big Scissors.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. Nightmare Crabs use an enhanced version that ignores shadows.

Fetid Eddies.d: Cone-shaped attack on a player: damage plus Gravity. The caster gains a poison aura (-117 HP/tic).

Whirl of Rage.d: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect.

Scorching Lash.d: Deals heavy damage to targets behind user.

Radiant Breath.d: Deals light breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Slow and Silence.
Radiant Breath.notes: Can deal upwards of 700 damage from Notorious Monsters.

Carcharian Verve.d: Self-buff. The user gains Attack Boost and Magic Attack Boost, removes its own negative status effects, and activates a water aura.
Carcharian Verve.notes: Marine Mayhem is only ever used as the next technique after this. Both buffs should be dispelled immediately (high Magic Accuracy needed). Stunning the move stops the Attack and Magic Attack buffs but the water spear still activates. It opens a Red Stagger Window. Instead paints the row purple (Magical) and puts "Buff" in its Area cell.

Seismic Tail.d: Deals damage and knockback to targets in a 10' area of effect. Can critical hit.

Sinker Drill.d: Deals five-hit damage to a single target.
Sinker Drill.notes: Deals piercing damage. Requires a left arm to use. Consumes 5 shadows.

Flame Blast.d: A fire storm deals damage to enemies in an area of effect.
Flame Blast.notes: Used only by Wyrm when he's in the sky.

Inferno Blast.d: A fire storm deals damage to enemies in a 30’ area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Sand Shield.d: Applies a sand barrier to increase defense.

Hell Scissors.d: Deals extreme damage to a single target. Additional Effect: Hate Reset
Hell Scissors.notes: TP move similar to Throat Stab. Used only by Khadem Quemquoma, Vaa Oozu's Scolopendrid, Centipedal Centruroides, Hedetet, Hedjedjet and Transcendent Scorpion. Has a longer readying time than Death Scissors, and can be outran.

Hammerblow.d: Swings the hammer right at a single target.

Bai Wing.d: A dust storm deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Slow
Bai Wing.notes: Used only by Ouryu and Cuelebre when in the sky.

Sandstorm.d: Kicks up a sandstorm, inflicting Blindness on targets in an area of effect.

Hydroball.d: Deals Water damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down.
Hydroball.notes: STR Down potency scales with the target's level.

Hydro Cannon.d: Sprays a torrential aqua jet that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison
Hydro Cannon.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.

Tebbad Wing.d: A hot wind deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Plague
Tebbad Wing.notes: Used only by Tiamat, Smok, Ildebrann and Azi Dahaka.

Ravenous Wail.d: Wind-based breath damage in an area of effect that also drains MP. Additional effects: Silence and Stun.

Vespine Hurricane.d: Deals wind damage with Knockback to enemies in an area, with additional Magic Defense Down and Attack Down.

Subduction.d: Deals damage based on the target’s remaining HP in an area of effect, with a very potent Gravity effect.

Roar.d: Paralyzes targets in an area of effect.

Stasis.notes: Used only by Serket, Shaula and Nightmare Scorpions.

Plenilune Embrace.d: Recovers HP and removes 0-3 status ailments, then grants Attack Bonus and Magic Attack Bonus. Potency varies with the moon phase.
Plenilune Embrace.notes: Recovers significant HP; prevent with Silence.

Final Retribution.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Swooping Frenzy.d: Damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Defense Down and Magic Defense Down, both 30~60 seconds (magnitudes unpublished).

Brain Freeze.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Amnesia.

Gusting Gouge.d: Deals damage in a threefold attack to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Gusting Gouge.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a one-handed weapon. If they lost their weapon, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.

Pounce.d: Deals damage to a single target.

Deracinator.d: Area-of-effect magical damage. Additional effect: Amnesia, Blind, and Muddle.

Blood Drain.d: Drains HP from a single player.
Blood Drain.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Tiyanak's Blood Drain regularly does 1k to non-tanks.

Claw Cyclone.d: Inflicts damage on enemies in a fan-shaped area.

Vaskania.d: Cone-shaped attack that inflicts damage and Curse.

Skull Smash.notes: Used only by Khroma Quadav, Ra'Dha Scarscute, Ru'Bha Stonewall, and Za'Dha Adamantking.

Tremors.d: Area-of-effect damage and DEX Down (-10 DEX, 3 min).
Tremors.notes: Removes all shadows. Radial, centered on the worm.

Delta Thrust.d: A threefold thrust on a single target with additional Plague.

Leeching Current.d: Deals damage divided by the number of players hit and recovers the user's HP.

Random Kiss.d: Randomly steals an enemy's HP, MP, or TP.

Detonating Grip.d: Deals heavy damage to targets in an area of effect. Guaranteed hit.
Detonating Grip.notes: Sacrifices its right arm. Requires a right arm to use. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Sylvan Slumber.d: Gaze that puts all targets in a 10' radius to sleep.

Pyroclastic Surge.d: Deals fire damage to enemies in an area with additional Addle.

Umbra Smash.notes: Used during his first phase, in his melee stance. Absorbable by Utsusemi.

Typhoean Rage.d: Damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Encumbrance and Muddle.

Blazing Bound.d: Deals fire damage and inflicts Burn (-53 INT).

Infrasonics.d: Inflicts Evasion Down on players in a cone-shaped area.

Brainjack.d: Brainjacks a player, charming them and inflicting damage over time.
Brainjack.notes: Only used by Long-Armed Chariot and Long-Horned Chariot. Last roughly 90 seconds; DoT takes about 25HP/tick.

Bubble Shower.d: Water-based damage to players around the crab, proportional to its current HP (about HP/16). Additional effect: STR Down (-10 STR, decays 1 per 9s).
Bubble Shower.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. A "Breath Weapon": damage scales with the crab's remaining HP, capped around 200 from standard crabs. Area/Target: AoE centred on the monster.

Healing Breeze.d: Restores the user's HP within an area of effect.

Atropine Spore.d: Cone-shaped magical damage. Additional effect: Sleep, Paralyze, and Silence.

Demonic Howl.d: AoE attack that inflicts Slow on players in range.
Demonic Howl.notes: Slow ~50% for 2-4 min. Lower priority than (blocked/overwritten by) Haste. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).

Antimatter.d: Fires its antimatter weaponry to deal damage to a single player.
Antimatter.notes: Used by Ultima (at very low health) and Proto-Ultima (until last phase). Ignores Utsusemi.

Tail Slap.d: Deals physical damage and Stun to targets in a fan-shaped area.

Murk.d: Weighs down nearby targets with an oppressive gloom. Additional effect: Weight + Slow.

Typhoon.d: Spins around dealing damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback, which occurs even if shadows absorb the damage.

Metamorphic Blast.d: Delivers a frontal (conal) area attack with knockback. Additional effect: Rasp.

Pole Swing.d: Deals damage to a single target.
Pole Swing.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a staff. If they lost their staff, they'll use Hysteric Barrage instead.

Tegmina Buffet.d: A 3-hit physical AoE that inflicts Choke.

Flurry of Rage.d: Deals multiple hits to a single target.
Flurry of Rage.notes: Only used by Eldritch Edge, Malefic Fencer, and Nightmare Weapon.

Filamented Hold.d: Inflicts Slow (~50%) on players in a cone-shaped area.

Actinic Burst.d: Inflicts Flash on targets in an area of effect.

Panzerfaust.d: Strikes a target twice with an armored fist.
Panzerfaust.notes: Some Notorious Monsters add a Knockback effect.

Benediction.d: White Mage SP ability: fully restores the user's HP and removes all enfeebling effects.

Xenoglossia.d: Prepares next spell for instant casting.

Erratic Flutter.d: AoE fire damage; the target gains Haste.

Tortoise Song.d: Removes all song and roll effects in an area of effect.
Tortoise Song.notes: This ability only dispels songs or rolls in effect on players. It has no effect on any other buffs, except in Nyzul Isle, where it takes up to 3 buffs from players.

Nerve Gas.d: Deals damage in an area of effect with an additional Curse (HP/MP -50%) and Poison (~20 HP/tick).
Nerve Gas.notes: Used only while all three heads are alive. Removes all shadows.

From the Skies.d: Damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Encumbrance (~10 seconds), Choke (19 HP/tick) and Knockback.

Absolute Terror.d: Single/multiple target(s) is frozen with fear.
Absolute Terror.notes: Ouryu's and Bahamut's version is AOE. All others are single target.

Whispers of Ire.d: Randomly absorbs 2 to 5 attributes from target.
Whispers of Ire.notes: Used only by some notorious monsters.

Fire Angon.d: Deals fire damage to players in an area. Used by Mamool-ridden Wivres. Ignores shadows but does not remove them; centered around the target.
Fire Angon.notes: Used by Mamool Rider Wivres and Lancelord Gaheel Ja.

Sound Vacuum.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. AREA DIFFERS BY FAMILY: the Cockatrice version is conical and silences for 1~2 min; the Worm version is single target (1P) for 30~90s, except Nightmare Worm, which is conical. The Nightmare Cockatrice inflicts Mute instead of Silence.

Brain Spike.d: Stabs a single target in the head. Additional effect: Paralysis
Brain Spike.notes: Not used by notorious monsters; see Impalement for the NM variant.

Maelstrom.d: Deals water damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: STR Down (-10, decays).
Maelstrom.notes: Removes all shadows. Iku-Turso gains a Silence aura after using it, and Bakunawa uses it the moment it spawns to summon its two Kanavid adds.

Target Analysis.d: Attempts to absorb all attributes from all players in range.

Magnetite Cloud.d: Breath damage to targets in a cone. Additional effect: Weight.

Ocher Blast.d: An earth storm deals damage to enemies in a 30' area of effect. Ignores shadows.
Ocher Blast.notes: Used by earth wyrms while airborne.

Mercurial Strike.d: Swings at an enemy dealing fixed damage in an area attack.
Mercurial Strike.notes: Used by Briareus and Cottus. Damage is fixed by a repeating pattern (e.g. 111), and determines which ability Briareus uses next.

Scream.d: Area-of-effect MND Down (~-25%, decays over 3 min). Additional effect: Terror.

Agaricus.d: Single-target damage. Additional effects: Slow, Plague (~-26 MP/tick), and an enmity reset.

Choke Breath.d: Earth-based damage in a frontal area of effect. Additional effects: Silence and Paralysis.

Sulfurous Breath.d: Deals physical damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area originating from the caster.

Polar Blast.d: Deals ice breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Paralysis.
Polar Blast.notes: Used while the left head is alive. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Ripper Fang.d: Damages a single target with additional Slow.

TP Drainkiss.d: Drains 50% of a single target's TP.
TP Drainkiss.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Broadside Barrage.d: Damage to a single player. Additional effect: INT Down and MND Down (-19).
Broadside Barrage.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Consumes 1 shadow. Notorious Monsters use an enhanced conal version.

Noyade.d: Damage plus Silence. The caster gains a poison aura (-117 HP/tic).

Dire Whorl.d: Spins around, dealing physical damage to targets in a 10' area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Cyclotail.d: Flails around with its tail, dealing damage to targets in an area of effect.

Dark Sphere.d: Throws an orb of dark energy at a single target. Additional effect: Blind
Dark Sphere.notes: Accuracy -20 for 5 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Bomb Toss.d: Hurls an explosive bomb at an area.
Bomb Toss.notes: Magic accuracy varies with TP. Bypasses shadows. Can backfire — see Bomb Toss (Dropped).

Debilitating Drone.d: Inflicts a random attribute reduction on enemies in an area of effect.
Debilitating Drone.notes: Used only in Chains of Promathia areas.

Corrosive Ooze.d: Damage in an area of effect around itself. Additional effects: Attack Down (-33%) and Defense Down (-33%).

Double Kick.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun
Double Kick.notes: Stun may or may not take effect.

Deathgnash.d: Inflicts damage equal to 90% of the target's HP and resets enmity.
Deathgnash.notes: Nuhn uses a more powerful version that reduces the target's HP to 1. Bypasses shadows without removing them.
