Beatdown.d: Lays the smackdown on a single target. Additional effect: Bind

Blindeye.d: Inflicts damage on a single target. Additional effect: Blind

Shirahadori.d: Pins down a single target with feathers. Additional effect: Knockback and Bind.
Shirahadori.notes: Used by Yagudo Genja, Maa Illmu the Bestower, and Soo Luma the Ascended.

Shoulder Charge.d: Deals physical damage to enemies in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Defense Down
Shoulder Charge.notes: Only used by Notorious Monsters in Wings of the Goddess areas.

Methane Breath.notes: Damage is current HP x 1/16, capped at 400. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Crosswind.d: Deals damage (about 1/12 of max HP) to players in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback.
Crosswind.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Shadow Spread.d: A dark shroud renders any nearby targets blinded, asleep, and cursed.

Flame Thrower.d: Uses a flamethrower that deals damage to players in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Plague
Flame Thrower.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima, as one of its follow-up attacks after Nuclear Waste.

Arcane Stomp.d: Stomps the ground to apply elemental absorption.
Arcane Stomp.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing and Dabargar the Stoic. This results in all elemental damage (from spells or weaponskills) healing him. Aspir still works normally. Lasts approximately 5 minutes, cannot be dispelled.
Arcane Stomp.r: AoE surrounding Gurfurlur, affects all mobs.

Feeble Bleat.d: Emits a unnerving bleat that paralyzes all in range.
Feeble Bleat.notes: Used only by the Karakul in the Near East.

Venom Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Poison
Venom Breath.notes: Used by Serket and Nightmare Scorpions in place of Cold Breath & Numbing Breath.

Eye Scratch.d: Scratches a single target right in the eyes. Additional effect: Blind

Ritual Bind.d: Area of Effect Bind and Paralyze.
Ritual Bind.notes: Used by Bloodeye Vileberry and Murk-Veined Baneberry. After using, will teleport to the character with the most hate, using Throat Stab several times in a row.

Sand Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Moribund Hack.d: Slams a massive ice boulder onto players. Additional effect: Paralyze and Enmity Reset
Moribund Hack.r: Small radius (10 yalms max) originating from the target. Damage seems to decrease the farther you are from the main target.

Kartstrahl.d: Deals ice damage to a single target.

Lava Spit.d: Deals damage to enemies within an area of effect.

Stinger Volley.d: Deals wind damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Paralysis and Curse (Recovery Down / Zombie, ~5-10 sec).

Angry Seas.notes: Angry Seas is what SUMMONS its adds: it spawns three to ten Pakecet's Pugils (~4,500 HP each), and the number summoned rises as Pakecet's own HP falls.

Ion Shower.d: Calls forth an ion storm, dealing damage to all nearby targets. Additional effect: Stun

Berserk.d: Grants the user the Berserk effect: Attack +(1 + 116/256), Defense -(150/256), for 2-3 minutes.

Hurricane Wing.d: Deals hurricane-force damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Blind
Hurricane Wing.notes: Used only by Dragua, Fafnir, Nidhogg, Cynoprosopi, Wyrm, and Odzmanouk. The blinding effect does not last long but is very harsh. The attack is wide enough to generally hit an entire alliance.

Terminal Sting.d: Delivers a Final Sting like attack that sacrifices the bee which can deal a great amount of damage. (Used by Chasmic Hornet).
Terminal Sting.notes: If Terminal Sting is used by Chasmic Hornet there will be no Experience Points or Cruor gained and will drop nothing but Stingers.

Fear Touch.d: Touches a single target. Additional effect: Slow
Fear Touch.notes: Slow 25% for 5 minutes. Can critical hit. Consumes 1 shadow.

MP Absorption.d: Drains MP from a single player.
MP Absorption.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Pelagic Cleaver.d: Deals damage in a 10' area of effect. Additional effect: Max HP Down.

Pestilent Plume.d: Cone-shaped damage plus Plague (-50 TP/tick, -8 MP/tick), Blind (-50), and Magic Defense Down (-25).

Snow Cloud.d: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Paralyze
Snow Cloud.notes: Used only by the white rabbits inhabiting snowy areas (namely Uleguerand Range), instead of Dust Cloud.

Nullifying Rain.d: Area-of-effect damage plus multiple Dispel and Max HP Down (-25%).

Empty Cutter.d: Deals physical damage to a single target. Can land a critical hit.

Petribreath.d: Petrifies targets within a fan-shaped area.
Petribreath.r: Unknown cone, Seen up to 15' distance.

Whistle.notes: When used by the Nightmare Dhalmel in Dynamis - Buburimu, it grants an Evasion Boost instead.

Regeneration.notes: Restores 5~8 HP per tick for about 5 minutes.

Purulent Ooze.d: Damage in a frontal cone. Additional effects: Bio (-15 HP/tick, -10% attack) and Max HP Down (-10%).
Purulent Ooze.notes: Removes all shadows. The Bio component is roughly equivalent to Bio II.

Unblest Armor.notes: Self Shell (reduces magic damage taken 50%, 3 min).

Head Snatch.notes: Only used by Gurfurlur the Menacing. Reduces HP to 10%.

Venom Storm.d: Inflicts deadly venom to targets within a massive area of effect.
Venom Storm.notes: Used only by Serket, King Vinegarroon, Calchas and Nightmare Scorpions. Poison effect can deal as much as 20-30/tick.

Crepuscular Grasp.d: AoE dark damage with Bind, Bio, and Paralyze.

Drainkiss.d: Drains HP from a single target.

Searing Serration.d: A four-fold hybrid attack on a single target with all attributes down (~200 each, ~1 min).

Marine Mayhem.d: Instant KO to targets between 5' and 20' away; water damage to targets within 5'.
Marine Mayhem.notes: Condition: below 25% HP or during the water aura, and only ever used as the next technique after Carcharian Verve.

Shoulder Slam.d: Body slams into a single target. Additional effect: Knockback

Palsynyxis.d: Deals one-and-a-half-fold damage to a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis.
Palsynyxis.notes: Paralysis lasts 30~60 seconds. Consumes one shadow. On Amphitrite it triggers the switch to absorbing physical damage, after a delay.

Inertia Stream.d: Directs an energy force at nearby targets. Additional effect: Bind

Numbshroom.d: Fires a mushroom cap for single-target damage. Additional effect: Paralysis and Stun. Used after Queasyshroom.

Hammer Beak.d: Threefold damage to a single player.

Freeze Rush.d: Deals damage to a single target.
Freeze Rush.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Nature's Meditation.d: Grants an undispellable attack bonus that decays over time, plus a brief window of damage immunity.
Nature's Meditation.notes: Separates the Chapuli's two TP-move modes.

Ice Roar.d: Emits a wintry roar, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Ice Roar.notes: Used only by Gigas in the Northlands, campaign battles, and in Limbus.

Aquatic Lance.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Echolocation.notes: Using Echolocation while its Pugils are out makes them change targets at random.

Crystal Shield.d: Invokes the power of a crystal to grant Protect (+20 Defense, ~5 min).

Acid Spray.d: Deals damage to targets in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effect: Poison

Chemical Bomb.d: Tosses a noxious explosive that inflicts elegy and slow on players in range.
Chemical Bomb.notes: Used by Ultima and Proto-Ultima early on. Slow is equivalent to Slow II, and so erase must be applied twice to remove both effects.

Amorphic Scythe.notes: Only used by custards and Immortal Flan.

Drop Hammer.d: Drops the hammer. Additional effect: Bind

Fluid Spread.d: Splashes liquid around in a 10' area of effect. Damage with a 50% attack bonus.

Seismic Impact.d: Deals earth damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: extremely potent Slow, Terror, and hate reset.

Luminous Drape.d: A glowing curtain charms all nearby targets.

Stone Throw.d: Throws a rock at a single target. Additional effect: Paralysis

Big Horn.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback.

Paralysis Shower.d: Releases paralyzing confetti in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Paralysis Shower.notes: Also used by Goblins in Dynamis and in the Past. Has a chance to backfire like Bomb Toss (except in Dynamis).

Mandible Bite.d: Deals damage to a single target.

Geotic Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.
Geotic Breath.notes: Used only by Earth Wyrms such as Ouryu and Dragua when they are on the ground.

Throat Stab.d: Deals damage to a single target reducing their HP to 5%. Resets enmity.
Throat Stab.notes: Very short range, easily evaded by walking away from it.

Acheron Flame.notes: Enhanced Gates of Hades; Old Shuck under 50% HP.

Reverse Current.d: Lightning-based magic damage in an area of effect centred on a player. Additional effect: Stun.
Reverse Current.notes: Centred on a player. Ongo's table calls the damage low.

Level 5 Petrify.d: Inflicts petrification on all targets with a level at a multiple of 5.
Level 5 Petrify.notes: This ability will only affect those whose level is a multiple of 5 (e.g. 65, 70, 75). It has no effect on anything else. If a target's level is a multiple of 5, petrification will always occur. It cannot ever be resisted naturally, nor will Resist Petrify be able to occasionally block it.

Antiphase.d: 15' radial mist that inflicts Silence on all targets.

Tortoise Stomp.d: Damages a single target with additional Defense Down.

Core Meltdown.d: Reactor core fails and self-destructs, damaging any nearby targets.

Cranial Thrust.d: Deals damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Max HP Down (-25%).

Aqua Fortis.d: Expels venom at players in an area with additional Knockback and Poison.

Lightning Roar.d: Emits a roar of thunder, dealing damage in a fan-shaped area of effect.
Lightning Roar.notes: Used by the regular Gigas found in Delkfutt's Tower and Tavnazia. Cannot be evaded.

Fang Rush.d: Deals major damage with a threefold attack to a single target.

Tail Thwack.d: Deals damage to enemies in an area with Defense Down (-50%) and Knockback.

Tyrannical Blow.d: Deals fire damage to enemies in an area with additional Plague.

Sheep Bleat.d: Emits a unnerving bleat that slows down players in range.
Sheep Bleat.notes: Used only by the Nightmare Sheep in Dynamis - Valkurm. The slow effect can be overwritten by Haste.

Heavy Strike.d: Deals physical damage to a single target with knockback; can land a critical hit.

Crystal Weapon.d: Invokes the power of a crystal to deal magical damage of a random element to a single target.
Crystal Weapon.notes: Can be , , , or element. Functions even at a distance (outside of melee range).

Gregale Wing.d: An icy wind deals damage to enemies within a very wide area of effect. Additional effect: Paralyze
Gregale Wing.notes: Used only by Jormungand in the air and on the ground and by Isgebind.

Abominable Belch.d: Belches toxic fumes at targets in an area of effect, inflicting Silence (30~60s), Plague (100 TP & 6 MP per tick, 15~45s) and Paralysis (30~60s).
Abominable Belch.notes: Nerrivik's Vile Belch is replaced by Abominable Belch once its lanterns are destroyed. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Spinning Top.d: Deals damage in an area of effect.

Lithic Ray.d: Inflicts Dia and Petrifaction in a conal area gaze attack.
Lithic Ray.notes: Only seen used by Shadowclaw, Bukhis and Bata.

Whip Tongue.d: Whiplashes a single player with its tongue. Additional effects: Stun and Knockback. Can land a critical hit.

Tail Smash.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Bind.
Tail Smash.notes: Weaker than Tail Swing in Monstrosity, despite being learned at a higher level.

Starward Yowl.d: AoE. Additional effects: Knockback and Bind.

Whirl Claws.d: Deals damage in an area of effect.
Whirl Claws.notes: ~15 yalm range; absorbed by 2 shadows. NM versions reset hate on each target hit.

Numbing Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralysis

Grim Halo.d: Deals heavy damage to all targets with a circular strike. Additional effect: Knockback
Grim Halo.notes: Only used by Fomors that wield a two-handed weapon (principally WAR, BLM, DRK, SAM, DRG, and SMN fomors).

Dragon Breath.d: Deals damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area.
Dragon Breath.notes: Used only by Fafnir, Nidhogg, Cynoprosopi, Wyrm, and Trust: Areuhat. Because of the high damage output from Fafnir/Nidhogg/Wyrm, it is usually avoided by standing on (or near) the wyrm's two front feet. Cynoprosopi's breath attack is much less painful.

Sweep.d: Damages enemies in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun

Fiery Breath.d: Deals HP-dependent fire breath damage to enemies in a frontal cone. Ignores shadows.

Polar Roar.d: Deals ice damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Bind and Knockback; the user gains an aura.

Riddle.d: Reduces maximum MP in an area of effect.
Riddle.notes: Retaliation to magic damage; locks MP.

Implosion.d: Channels a wave of negative energy, damaging all targets in very wide area of effect.
Implosion.notes: Only uses this ability during his second phase, every 10 seconds. Heralded by a distinct sound & visual effect, it will hit almost everyone in the battlefield due to large range. Removes Utsusemi.

Seedspray.d: Single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Defense Down (~-33%).

??? Needles.d: Deals between 1,000 and 100,000 damage divided among targets; power increases while Photosynthesis is active.

Sheep Song.d: Puts all players within range to sleep.

Flame Armor.d: Grants the user the effect of Blaze Spikes.

Wild Horn.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone.

Dust Storm.d: Deals damage and inflicts Blindness on targets behind the user.

Rabid Dance.d: Grants the user the effect of Evasion Bonus.

Snort.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Blaster.d: Inflicts Paralysis on a single target. Ignores shadows.

Chaotic Eye.d: Inflicts Silence on a single target. Ignores shadows.

Petrifactive Breath.d: Inflicts Petrifaction on enemies within a fan-shaped area. Ignores shadows.
Petrifactive Breath.notes: Used in CoP areas or by NMs.

Blink of Peril.d: Reduces the target's HP by 95% and resets enmity. Ignores shadows.

Mortal Blast.d: Inflicts instant Death on a single target.
Mortal Blast.notes: Gaze/conal instant KO — avoid by turning.

Asuran Claws.d: A six-hit physical attack against a single target.

Preternatural Gleam.d: Deals light damage to enemies within a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralysis, Mute, and enmity reset.

Flailing Trunk.d: Deals damage in a cone; can critical strike. Removes 2-3 shadows.

Onrush.d: Single-target damage that can critical strike.

Voracious Trunk.d: Absorbs one positive status effect from the target. Ignores shadows.

Barrier Tusk.d: Grants the user Defense Bonus (+50%) and resistance to all elements (+120). Undispellable.

Barreling Smash.d: Reduces the target to critical HP and resets enmity. Similar to Throat Stab.
Barreling Smash.notes: Reduces target to critical HP and resets enmity.

Zealous Snort.d: Grants the user Haste, enhances magic defense, and raises the likelihood of Countering and Guarding.

Booming Bleat.d: Inflicts Max HP Down (-50%) on enemies within an area. Ignores shadows.

Disorienting Waul.d: Inflicts Amnesia on enemies in an area of effect.

Gerjis' Grip.d: Stuns a single target with a menacing gaze.

Head Butt.d: Deals single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Stun and Knockback.

Awful Eye.d: Inflicts STR Down on a target with a gaze. Ignores shadows.

Heavy Bellow.d: Inflicts Stun on enemies in a cone-shaped area. Ignores shadows.

Tusk.d: Damages a single target with additional Knockback.

Tyrant Tusk.d: Damages enemies in a cone-shaped area with additional Bio; can inflict instant Death if Bio is already active or the target is at low HP.

Hungry Crunch.d: Drains HP from a single target, removes its food effect, and resets its TP.

Tarichutoxin.d: Inflicts an unremovable Poison (~15 HP/tick) on a single target.

Volcanic Stasis.d: Deals fire damage to a target with additional Stun and a full Dispel.

Brazen Rush.d: A powered rushing attack used by Kalunga at 75% HP.

Blockhead.d: Damages a single target with additional Knockback.

Brain Crush.d: Damages a single target with additional Silence.

Plaguebreath.d: Deals damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Poison.

Tail Blow.d: Damages a single target with additional Stun.

Fireball.d: Deals fire damage to players in a 10' area of effect.

Snowball.d: Deals ice damage to players in a 10' area of effect.

Backdraft.d: Deals fire damage to players in a ~7-9' area with additional Gravity and Burn. Removes all shadows.

Oppressive Glare.d: While its eyes glow, inflicts Terror and Zombie on any player who faces its gaze. Blind prevents its use.

Frost Breath.d: Deals ice damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Paralysis.

Boiling Blood.d: The user gains Haste (+25%) and Berserk (+50%) for 3 minutes.

Demoralizing Roar.d: Inflicts Attack Down (-50%) on players in a 10' area for 30-90 seconds.

Crippling Slam.d: Deals physical damage to players in a 15' area with potent Paralysis for 30-60 seconds.

Burning Memories.d: Deals fire damage to players in an area with Amnesia and TP Reduction. Used by Mamool-ridden Wivres. Ignores shadows but does not remove them; centered around the target.
Burning Memories.notes: Used by Mamool Rider Wivres and Lancelord Gaheel Ja.

Mandibular Bite.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Sandpit.d: Inflicts Bind on a single target. Ignores shadows.

Sandblast.d: Inflicts Blind on enemies in an area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Venom Spray.d: Inflicts Poison on players in a cone-shaped area. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).

Pit Ambush.d: A surprise physical attack from underground, used only from a burrowed/hidden state. Removes all shadows.
Pit Ambush.notes: Triggered when a player steps over a burrowed Pit-type Antlion without Sneak.

Final Sting.d: A self-sacrificing sting used at low HP. Deals magic damage based on the bee's current HP (~Current HP x .5), then removes the bee's own remaining HP (the bee dies). Bypasses shadows.

Pollen.d: Restores the bee's own HP (~Max HP x 147/1024, about 14%).

Power Attack.d: Deals physical damage to a single target with a 100% Attack bonus.

Viscid Secretion.d: Inflicts Slow and Weight on players in a cone-shaped area.

Viscous Deluge.d: Applies Bio and various debuffs to enemies.

Sticky Situation.d: Magical damage to enemies in an area with additional Plague, Slow, and Silence.

Mandible Massacre.d: Physical damage to players in a cone-shaped area with additional Paralysis and Doom.

Abdominal Assault.d: Physical damage to players in a cone-shaped area with Gravity, a TP reset, and Knockback.

Flesh Syphon.d: Physical damage to a single target while absorbing its attributes.

Umbral Expunction.d: Magical damage to enemies in an area; damage increases with the number of active debuffs on the caster.

Pandemic Nip.d: Single-target physical damage; transfers up to five of the gnat's negative status effects onto the target player.

Nepenthean Hum.d: AoE that inflicts Amnesia. Used only during daytime.

Noisome Powder.d: AoE that inflicts Attack Down (~-40%). Used only during daytime.

Spiral Spin.d: Cone-shaped physical damage with Accuracy Down (~-40). Used only during daytime.

Sudden Lunge.d: Sacrifices HP for single-target damage with Knockback and Stun. Used only at night.

Searing Effulgence.d: AoE light damage with Knockback and a strong Dia III (~-24% defense, 15-60s).

Slicing Sickle.d: Cone-shaped physical damage with Knockback and Defense Down.

Macerating Bile.d: AoE that inflicts Bio (~-50 HP/tick) and lowers all attributes (~-22).

Raptorial Claw.d: AoE physical damage with Knockback and Magic Defense Down.

Preying Posture.d: Self-buff granting Attack Boost, Accuracy Boost, Magic Attack Boost and Intension. Takes four dispels to fully remove.

Phlegm Expulsion.d: AoE that inflicts Slow, Silence and Amnesia for ~2 minutes.

Death Prophet.d: Frontal cone-shaped Death effect (instant K.O.). Usually used below 50% HP; can be stunned.

Exorender.d: Frontal cone-shaped damage; the mantid levels up afterward (and kills any assisting flies caught in the cone). Used by Tsui-Goab and Tenodera.

Immolating Claw.d: Cone-shaped physical damage with Plague (cannot be removed).

Infected Leech.d: Cone-shaped magic damage with Plague (~-50 HP/tick).

Bloody Mist.d: Cone-shaped magic damage with Bio; the mosquito gains a dispellable ~5,000 HP/tick regen.

Death Scissors.d: Single-target physical damage that can critically strike; grants a large Attack Bonus (+150%).

Exuviation.d: Removes the user's negative status effects and restores HP based on the number removed.

Amber Scutum.d: Self-buff granting a +20% Defense Bonus (used while curled).

Cannonball.d: Long-range single-target physical damage (used while curled).

Heat Barrier.d: Self-buff granting Blaze Spikes and Enfire.

Thermal Pulse.d: AoE fire damage with Blind (used while extended).

Vitriolic Spray.d: Cone-shaped fire breath damage with Burn (used while extended).

Vitriolic Shower.d: AoE fire damage with a powerful Burn (used while extended).

Beautiful Death.d: 16' area-of-effect Charm with a 9-count Doom; charmed players are transformed into Rafflesia and cannot be Cursna'd, making it effectively a guaranteed K.O. Typically used below 50% HP.

Leeching Vines.d: Absorbs adjacent black Rafflesia; triggers a !! proc, after which Vir'ava's magical and physical evasion are significantly lowered.

Gloeosuccus.d: Cone-shaped earth-based magic. Additional effect: Slow (~35%).

Palsy Pollen.d: Single-target ice-based magic. Additional effect: Paralysis. Bypasses Utsusemi.

Soporific.d: 10' area-of-effect dark-based magic. Additional effect: Sleep. Bypasses Utsusemi.

Draw In.d: Pulls its current target, and every party member holding hate, to the user.
Draw In.notes: Players who have taken no action are not on its hate list and are not drawn in. It also draws the party in at random while readying a TP move or casting an area spell, so the whole alliance eats the follow-up.

Consecration.d: Area-of-effect light magic damage. Additional effect: Stun.

Phototrophic Blessing.d: Self-buff: recovers HP and grants Regen, Defense Boost, and Magic Defense Boost.

Phototrophic Wrath.d: Self-buff: grants Attack Boost, Magic Attack Boost, Haste, and Enlight.

Demonic Flower.d: Sacrifices HP to deal damage to a single target. Additional effect: Weakness (~60s).

Fatal Scream.d: Area-of-effect attack that inflicts a 10-second Doom.

Petalback Spin.d: Area-of-effect attack that inflicts Poison, Paralyze, Blind, Silence, Plague and Amnesia, and resets the target's hate.

Phaeosynthesis.d: Self-buff: gains Regen, Regain, Multistrikes and Evasion Boost. Night only.

Vampiric Root.d: Single-target attack that absorbs HP and one beneficial status effect.

Drain Whip.d: Single-target attack that drains HP, MP, or TP.

Bloody Caress.d: Single-target physical attack that drains HP equal to the damage dealt.

Floral Bouquet.d: Area-of-effect Sleep; also charms nearby Bees.

Rotten Stench.d: Area-of-effect Magic Accuracy Down and Accuracy Down.

Blighted Bouquet.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Bio (~-50 HP/tick) and Mute. Used only by Mitrastema-type Rafflesia.

1,000 Needles.d: Deals 1,000 damage divided among targets in range.

2,000 Needles.d: Deals 2,000 damage divided among targets in range.

4,000 Needles.d: Deals 4,000 damage divided among targets in range.

10,000 Needles.d: Deals 10,000 damage divided among targets in range.

Chupa Blossom.d: Area-of-effect HP drain that absorbs multiple beneficial effects and lowers all of the target's stats.

Firefly Aura.d: Gains a regen firefly aura and removes status ailments.

Timber.d: 10,000 Needles-style move; damage scales with Max HP, characters present and enmity. Believed Non-Elemental.
Timber.notes: Non-elemental (10,000 Needles style); used while aura is active.

Cordon of Apathy.d: Damage and multiple dispel. Dark Yggdreant exclusive.

Testudo Tremor.notes: Used below 50% HP. Severe AoE Earth-based magical damage; also Stun + Weight (Gravity).

Bonebreaking Barrage.d: Conal physical barrage inflicting Gravity and Max HP Down (-60%).

Calcifying Claw.d: Conal physical attack with knockback and an additional Petrifaction effect.

Divesting Stampede.d: AoE physical charge dealing damage, dispelling buffs, and lowering Defense and Magic Defense, with knockback.

Soulshattering Roar.d: AoE roar dealing damage and Terror; the user gains a shield granting temporary immunity to one physical damage type (Slashing, Piercing, or H2H). Remove it with a weapon skill from behind (on Fleetstalker, first proc a stagger with Water damage).
fx: Self: 0 damage from one physical damage type (shield)

Beastruction.d: Self-centered AoE used at low HP: reduces the user’s own remaining HP to 1 while inflicting Gravity, Encumbrance, Weight, and knockback on nearby players.
Beastruction.notes: Usually used under 35% HP; very long ready time.

Hellfire Arrow.d: Conal fire attack dealing damage with Burn and knockback. Used only by Red Yztargs.

Incensed Pummel.d: Single-target physical strike with an additional stat-down effect. Used only by Red Yztargs.

Quake Blast.d: High AoE damage that also strips buffs.

Gravitic Horn.d: Very long frontal AoE dealing percentage-based damage. Not blocked by Fanatic’s Drink.
Gravitic Horn.notes: Used by Antlion NMs; the frontal cone reaches unusually far.

Rhinowrecker.d: High conal physical damage with knockback.
Rhinowrecker.notes: Unique Beetle-NM move. Gulltop gains access to it below 25% HP; keep it pointed away from weaker party members.

Soul Enslavement.d: Dark Knight SP ability used by some Beetle NMs.
Soul Enslavement.notes: While it is active, Lumber Jill loses her Enstun effect.

Tarsal Slam.d: Conal AoE that reduces its targets to 1 HP and resets enmity.

Booming Bombination.d: Magical AoE damage with additional Plague, Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Telsonic Tempest.d: Inflicts Encumbrance on targets in range.

Benumbing Blaze.notes: Unique to Wamoura NMs; used below 50% HP.

Upgrowth.d: Turns a single target into a mandragora costume. Equipment stays on and the target keeps fighting as a mandragora until it wears off, but cannot use items.

Wildwood Indignation.notes: Haughty Tulittia's version copies one of its own debuffs onto every party member in range each time it is used — dangerous if you have applied Paralyze or a Helix.

Infected Illusion.d: AoE Charm. Only used after Dryad's Kiss.

Matriarchal Fiat.d: High AoE damage. Only used after Dryad's Kiss.

Thousand Spears.d: Area-of-effect damage. Melancholic Moira's can deal 1,000 damage or more.

Tainting Breath.d: Charm. Melancholic Moira gains access to it below 50% HP.

Bloody Breath.d: Inflicts a 50-count Doom. Removed either by killing the monster or by conventional methods of removing doom such as Cursna.

Rancid Breath.d: Used by Sensual Sandy in retaliation to skillchains.
Rancid Breath.notes: Sandy will attempt to ready it and follow with an "Out of Range" message.

20000 Needles.d: Deals 20,000 damage divided among targets in range.

Venomous Vapor.d: Area-of-effect damage plus All Attributes Down. Gains a poison aura.
Venomous Vapor.notes: Used by Yecuex and Sortie Acuex.

Hemorrhaze.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Paralyze and Poison.
Hemorrhaze.notes: Used by Yecuex. Removes all shadows.

Chymous Reek.d: Cone-shaped damage plus Stun and a non-removable Choke.
Chymous Reek.notes: The Choke cannot be removed. Removes all shadows.

Crowning Flatus.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Stun and Knockback.

Gnash 'n Guttle.d: Cone-shaped attack that inflicts Max HP Down (-50%).

Just Desserts.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Stun and Drown (-38 HP/tick).

Rancid Reflux.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Gravity and Knockback.
Rancid Reflux.notes: Botulus Rex's version is conal and inflicts Max HP Down instead of plain damage.

Slimy Proposal.d: Area-of-effect Charm (~30 seconds) plus Dia (-38/tick). Clears negative status ailments from the user.

Sloughy Sputum.d: Cone-shaped damage plus Gravity, Drown, and Knockback.

Death Ray.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Petro Gaze.d: Gaze that inflicts Petrifaction on players facing the enemy, in a cone.
Petro Gaze.notes: CoP areas only. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Aeolian Void.d: Frontal cone area-of-effect damage plus Blind and Silence.

Desiccation.d: Frontal cone attack on a player: damage plus Knockback, removes all equipment, and resets all job ability timers to their maximum.
Desiccation.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Dustvoid.d: Area-of-effect damage plus Knockback, and removes all equipment.
Dustvoid.notes: Removes all shadows. Does not inflict Encumbrance, so lost gear can be re-equipped immediately.

Extreme Purgation.d: Absorbs any status effects from targets in range, including SP abilities and ailments. Food and Reraise are not absorbed.
Extreme Purgation.notes: Removes all shadows. Every buff it absorbs has to be dispelled off it individually.

Slaverous Gale.d: Frontal cone area-of-effect damage plus Slow and Plague.

Disgorge.d: Frontal cone area-of-effect damage, scaled by the HP absorbed with Gorge as well as by passive damage absorption. The total is split evenly among all targets in front of the caster.

Gorge.d: Absorbs HP from targets in range. The absorption is divided among them.
Gorge.notes: Removes all shadows. Usually followed by Disgorge, which spends the absorbed HP as damage.

Doomvoid.d: Sends all targets in range to the Ghoyu's Reverie, Everbloom Hollow or Ruhotz Silvermines battlefield.
Doomvoid.notes: Onychophora's version instead K.O.s the entire party, and is used when multiple repeat skillchains are performed on it.

Psyche Absorption.d: Frontal cone area-of-effect: absorbs HP and randomly 1-300+ of each attribute from players in range for 60 seconds.
Psyche Absorption.notes: The attribute down is not erasable. Removes all shadows.

Digest.d: Drains HP from a single player.

Mucilaginous Ooze.d: Inflicts Slow and a long Encumbrance (60~90s) in an area of effect.
Mucilaginous Ooze.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. The Encumbrance used to also strip equipment from the target, which was removed in the October 7th 2014 update because losing iLvl gear was too powerful.

Full-force Blow.d: Damage with Knockback to a single player. Can critical hit. Has a 50% attack bonus.

Mud Stream.d: High area-of-effect damage with Magic Defense Down, Slow, Bind, Rasp and a draw-in.

Bloody Beak.d: A threefold attack in a 5' frontal cone that absorbs HP from targets.
Bloody Beak.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Reaving Wind.d: Resets the mob's TP to 0 and creates a wind aura that periodically knocks back players within range.
Reaving Wind.notes: Monster-centred. The Amphiptere attacks slower while the aura is up. Erinys also gains a DoT with the aura, and drops it after using Calamitous Wind.

Storm Wing.d: Threefold wind damage in a 15' frontal cone, with Silence (90~120s) and Knockback.

Tail Lash.notes: Consumes 2-3 shadows. Condition: used when the player with hate is behind it.

Calamitous Wind.d: Fourfold wind damage in a 20' area of effect, with a full dispel and Knockback.
Calamitous Wind.notes: Removes all shadows. Monster-centred. The dispel takes everything except food.

Feral Peck.d: Reduces the HP of targets in a frontal cone by 90%, and resets the enmity of those hit.
Feral Peck.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Warped Wail.d: Wind damage in a 20' area of effect, with severe Max HP Down and Max MP Down.

Vermilion Wind.d: Medium wind damage in a 20' area of effect (~800-1000 on normal players).

White Out.d: Damage in a 20' area of effect, with Zombie and Sleep.
White Out.notes: Removes all shadows. Isarukitsck's version also resets Little Wingman hate onto its current target.

Contamination.d: Transfers the monster's own debuffs to players in range.

Contagion Transfer.d: Absorbs positive and negative status effects from targets in a cone.
Contagion Transfer.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Chickcharney's Attack rises with the number of buffs it absorbs with this move.

Toxic Pick.d: Damage to a single player. Additional effects: Poison (-36 HP/tick, 3 min), Plague (-5 HP/tick, 1 min) and Gravity (-75% movement speed, 2 min).

Feather Tickle.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Pecking Flurry.d: Four-hit damage to a single player.
Pecking Flurry.notes: Consumes 4 shadows. Can deal high damage.

Snatch Morsel.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Resistible with magic evasion AND fire resistance+ — you need a fire resistance value greater than 0, no matter your magic evasion level. Yalungur spawns a Predatory Colibri with each use and levels up if it stole food.

Wisecrack.d: Charms players in an area around the monster.
Wisecrack.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. NOT part of the standard kit. Chamrosh can use it once; Yalungur gains it under 50% HP (10' AoE, up to 2 minutes — Stun is recommended, and it despawns if everyone is charmed).

Tropic Tenor.d: Substantial damage in a 15' area around the monster (~1k), plus All Stats Down, TP Reset and knockback.
Tropic Tenor.notes: Removes all shadows. NOT part of the standard kit.

Feather Barrier.d: The monster grants itself an Evasion Bonus (+25).
Feather Barrier.notes: Duration varies with TP (3~10 minutes). Shared by the standard and the enhanced NM sets - it is not swapped out.

Gliding Spike.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. NMs and Gaganas use Dread Dive instead.

Scratch.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. NMs and Gaganas use Blind Vortex instead.

Triple Attack.d: Three-hit damage to a single player.
Triple Attack.notes: Consumes 3 shadows. NMs and Gaganas use Giga Scream instead.

Stormwind.d: Threefold damage to players in an area of effect.
Stormwind.notes: Removes all shadows. NMs and Gaganas normally use Dread Wind instead, but Suzaku, Vedrfolnir, Zduhac and Picolaton keep it.

Dread Dive.d: Twofold damage to a single player.
Dread Dive.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Gliding Spike.

Blind Vortex.d: Twofold damage to a single player.
Blind Vortex.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Scratch.

Giga Scream.d: Three-hit damage to a single player.
Giga Scream.notes: Consumes 3 shadows. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Triple Attack.

Dread Wind.d: Damage to players in an area of effect centred on the monster.
Dread Wind.notes: Terror lasts about 10 seconds. Removes all shadows. The enhanced NM/Gagana version of Stormwind.

Helldive.d: Damage to a single player. Additional effect: Knockback.

Blind Side Barrage.d: Damage to a single player. Additional effect: STR Down and VIT Down (-19).
Blind Side Barrage.notes: CoP/ToAU areas only. Consumes 1 shadow. Notorious Monsters use an enhanced conal version.

Crashing Thunder.d: Lightning-based magic damage to players around the monster. Additional effect: Knockback. The monster gains the thunder wing aura.
Crashing Thunder.notes: Centred on the monster. The aura gives the caster -Damage Taken and inflicts Avoidance Down; earth-based damage removes it.

Reverberating Cry.d: Lightning-based magic damage to players around the monster. Additional effects: Magic Defense Down and Magic Evasion Down.
Reverberating Cry.notes: Centred on the monster. Palila resummons its vultures after using it.

Weighted Flux.d: Lightning-based magic damage in a fan-shaped area of effect. Additional effects: Silence and Gravity.
Weighted Flux.notes: Palila only, and only while the Crashing Thunder aura is up.

Debilitating Surge.notes: Palila only. Palila summons or resummons its vultures after using it.

Elemental Sforzo.notes: A Blue Mage job ability the NMs borrow. Procne uses it; Ongo uses it at 75% HP.

Kaleidoscopic Fury.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Resets every job ability timer, and inflicts Dia (20-80 HP per tick) and -60 to all attributes.

Aetheric Pull.d: Drains MP and grants the user Dread Spikes.
Aetheric Pull.notes: On Pakecet it also nullifies one damage type while active and moves another resistance to 115%.

Intimidate.d: Inflicts Slow (25%, 2~4 min) on targets in a frontal cone.
Intimidate.notes: Lower priority than Haste. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Screwdriver.d: Inflicts damage on a single target. Can critical hit.

Splash Breath.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone (current HP x 10%, capped at 400 damage for non-NMs).

Water Shield.d: Gains Evasion Bonus (+25, 120~600s). Duration varies with TP.

Water Wall.d: Gains Defense Bonus (Defense x2, 60~180s). Duration varies with TP.

Counterspore.d: A magical ranged attack with a Knockback effect.

Bite.d: Single-target physical damage. Additional effect: Defense Down.
Bite.notes: One of the three auto-attack types Rockfins choose from, not a TP move.

Thrust.d: Conal physical damage with a knockback effect.
Thrust.notes: One of the three auto-attack types Rockfins choose from, not a TP move.

Spin.d: Spins in place for AoE damage with a knockback effect.
Spin.notes: One of the three auto-attack types Rockfins choose from, not a TP move.

Aqua Blast.d: Deals water damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Knockback (6).
Aqua Blast.notes: Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows.

Frozen Mist.d: Inflicts Terror (20s) and grants the user a unique Stoneskin that absorbs only 1,500 physical damage.
Frozen Mist.notes: The user also gains an ice aura and absorbs Ice damage for its duration; the aura remains until enough physical damage is dealt or about 3 minutes pass. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows.

Hydro Wave.d: Deals damage, removes one piece of equipment, and grants the user a unique Stoneskin that absorbs only 1,500 magical/breath/non-elemental damage.
Hydro Wave.notes: The user also gains a water aura and absorbs Water damage for its duration; the aura remains until enough magic damage is dealt or about 3 minutes pass. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows.

Severing Fang.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Defense Down.
Severing Fang.notes: Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Consumes 2 shadows.

Sub-zero Smash.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis.
Sub-zero Smash.notes: Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Aqua Cannon.d: Deals water damage in a frontal cone. Additional effects: Knockback (10) and Defense Down (-50%, 3 minutes).
Aqua Cannon.notes: The user gains a 10' Silence aura. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows. Scylla spams this move every 3-4 seconds while its Hydro Wave aura is up.

Ice Guillotine.d: Inflicts Max HP Down (-50%, 3 minutes) and Amnesia (45~60s) in a frontal cone.
Ice Guillotine.notes: The user gains a 10' Paralysis aura. Self-targeted, like every Ruszor TP move - it can go off even when no player is in range of it. Removes all shadows. Scylla spams this move every 3-4 seconds while its Frozen Mist aura is up.

Cross Attack.d: Deals 2-hit damage to a single target. The attack carries a +50% Attack bonus.

Ink Jet.d: Deals dark damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Blind (-80 Accuracy, 30~120s).
Ink Jet.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Tentacle.d: Deals 1-hit damage to a single target. Can critical hit.

Whirlwind.d: Deals wind damage in an area of effect. Additional effect: VIT Down (-10, decays).

Gas Shell.d: Inflicts Poison on players in an area of effect.
Gas Shell.notes: Poison ticks for 26 HP and lasts 30~90 seconds. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. It is the family's shell-mode retaliation - the mob uses it when physically attacked while inside its shell.

Suctorial Tentacle.d: Inflicts Poison and Bind on a single target.
Suctorial Tentacle.notes: Bind lasts 30~90 seconds. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Corpse Breath.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Blind.
Corpse Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Cannered Noz uses it on every spawn except its last, which is how you know the fight is ending.

Louring Skies.d: Deals damage in a 20' radius. Additional effect: Paralysis and Bind.

Danse Macabre.d: Inflicts Charm on a single player for 60 seconds.
Danse Macabre.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Belphegor gains access to it at about 25% HP - have Fealty ready if you are tanking on PLD. S Charm effect fairly accurate.

Envoutement.d: Deals damage to a single player. Additional effect: Curse (-25% HP and MP, 3 minutes).

Silence Seal.d: Inflicts Silence on players in an area of effect for 2 minutes.
Silence Seal.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Gala Macabre.d: Inflicts Charm on players in an area of effect for 60 seconds.
Gala Macabre.notes: The AoE version of Danse Macabre; bypasses shadows without removing them. Giltine uses it after Memento Mori, occasionally with a spell in between - stunning Memento Mori or that spell stops it.

Hadal Summons.d: Deals heavy fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Burn.
Hadal Summons.notes: Powerful AoE Physical AND Fire damage with a potent Burn; Giltine's calls it large AoE fire damage with a strong DoT Burn.

Cruel Joke.d: Inflicts a 10-count Doom on players in an area of effect.
Cruel Joke.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Skomora's and Triboulex's versions inflict Haunted instead of Doom - a stronger form of Curse - and ignore shadows.

Feast of Arrows.d: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bind.
Feast of Arrows.notes: On Skomora and Triboulex it also inflicts Bio.

Last Laugh.d: Deals critical damage to a single player and drains the HP dealt. Additional effect: Hate Reset.
Last Laugh.notes: Rare on Skomora, but it can be used.

Regurgitated Swarm.d: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Paralysis.
Regurgitated Swarm.notes: On Skomora and Triboulex it also sets TP to 0 - an AoE TP wipe.

Setting the Stage.d: Deals damage to a single player. Additional effects: Slow and Amnesia.
Setting the Stage.notes: On Skomora and Triboulex it is an AoE instead, dealing roughly 30,000 damage divided by the number of targets in range, used about every three minutes. It bypasses Scherzo and Migawari but is survivable with Mana Wall, Perfect Defense, or an Annuls Damage proc.

Curtain Call.d: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Bio.

Abyss Blast.d: Deals dark-elemental damage to a single player. Additional effect: Blind (-25 Accuracy, 2 minutes).
Abyss Blast.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Acid Breath.d: Breath damage in a cone (HP x 0.05, capped at 200). Additional effect: STR Down (-10 STR, decaying 1 per 15 seconds).
Acid Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Call of the Grave.d: Inflicts INT Down (-10 INT, decaying 1 per 15 seconds) on players in an area of effect.
Call of the Grave.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Stinking Gas.d: Inflicts VIT Down (-10 VIT, decaying 1 per 15 seconds) on players in an area of effect.
Stinking Gas.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Undead Mold.d: Deals damage in a cone. Additional effect: Disease (no HP or MP recovery while resting, 11 minutes).
Undead Mold.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Infernal Pestilence.d: Breath damage in a cone (HP x 0.05, capped at 200). Additional effect: Plague (-50 TP and -3 MP per tick, 13 minutes).
Infernal Pestilence.notes: Used only by certain Notorious Monsters. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Villainous Rebuke.d: Deals significant damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Stun and Knockback.

Noahionto.d: Deals significant dark-elemental damage to players in an area of effect, scaled to the damage the monster has already taken.
Noahionto.notes: Removes all shadows. Capable of one-shotting a party. Lux Valiance and Holy Circle reduce its damage; Migawari: Ichi negates it entirely.

Barbed Crescent.d: Slices a single target from long range with a barbed crescent. Additional effect: Accuracy Down
Barbed Crescent.notes: Accuracy is reduced by 100 for 2~3 minutes.

Dimensional Death.d: Rends the air with a dimension-splitting blow to a single target.
Dimensional Death.notes: Deals hand-to-hand damage. Used exclusively by Shadows, though some Shadow notorious monsters can also use Fomor TP moves.

Eagle Eye Shot.d: A ranged attack that is guaranteed to hit.

Howling.d: Howls, inflicting Paralysis on players in an area of effect centred on the monster.
Howling.notes: 30~40% proc rate, 60 seconds. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Rot Gas.d: Releases a rotting gas in an area of effect centred on the monster.
Rot Gas.notes: Disease blocks HP and MP recovery for 6 minutes. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Shadow Claw.d: Claws a single target. Additional effect: Blind

Raksha Stance.d: The monster enters Raksha Stance, gaining -50% magic damage taken and erasing its own status ailments. Unlocks the Raksha TP moves.
Raksha Stance.notes: Dispels up to three status enhancements from players. Not every Naraka gains the damage reduction. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Raksha: Judgment.d: Magic damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Silence, Amnesia and Bind.
Raksha: Judgment.notes: Requires Raksha Stance. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Raksha: Illusion.d: Long conal magic damage. Additional effect: Paralysis and Curse.
Raksha: Illusion.notes: Requires Raksha Stance. The Curse halves maximum HP and MP. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Raksha: Vengeance.d: Heavy magic damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Muddle and Weakness.
Raksha: Vengeance.notes: Requires Raksha Stance. Weakness lasts one minute and is applied before the damage. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Yaksha Stance.d: The monster enters Yaksha Stance, gaining -50% physical damage taken and erasing its own status ailments. Unlocks the Yaksha TP moves.
Yaksha Stance.notes: Dispels up to three status enhancements from players. Not every Naraka gains the damage reduction. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Yaksha: Damnation.d: Conal physical damage. Additional effect: Magic Defense Down and Defense Down.

Yaksha: Bliss.d: Conal physical damage. Additional effect: Attack Down and Magic Attack Down.
Yaksha: Bliss.notes: Requires Yaksha Stance. Attack -25%. Absorbed by shadows.

Yaksha: Oblivion.d: Heavy physical damage to players in a wide area of effect, with a hate reset.
Yaksha: Oblivion.notes: Requires Yaksha Stance. All attributes -110. Resets enmity.

Sakra Storm.d: Moderate damage to players in an area of effect, with a hate reset. Additional effect: Zombie, Paralysis and Muddle.
Sakra Storm.notes: Used only by Uptala and Vinipata. Uptala uses it below 50% HP. Removes all shadows.

Yama's Judgment.d: Damage to players in an area of effect, and inflicts a five-count Doom.
Yama's Judgment.notes: Used only by Kalasutrax and Vinipata. The Doom is blocked by a Fanatic's Drink. Removes all shadows.

Animating Wail.d: The monster gains Haste (about 30%) for two to three minutes.

Fortifying Wail.d: The monster gains a physical damage taken reduction of about 25% for 90 to 120 seconds.

Hex Palm.d: Drains HP from players in a cone. The amount drained is roughly twice the monster's level.
Hex Palm.notes: Only used while fighting hand-to-hand. Removes all shadows.

Leaping Cleave.d: Single-hit damage to one player. Additional effect: Stun for 15 to 30 seconds.
Leaping Cleave.notes: Only used while wielding a primary or secondary weapon. Consumes 1 shadow.

Mangle.d: Three-hit damage to players in a cone.
Mangle.notes: Only used while wielding a primary or secondary weapon. Consumes 3 shadows.

Spinal Cleave.d: Damage to a single player. Can critical hit.
Spinal Cleave.notes: Only used hand-to-hand, once the primary weapon has broken. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Unblest Jambiya.d: Drains HP from players within 15 feet.
Unblest Jambiya.notes: Used only by notorious monsters, and only while the main weapon is unbroken. Removes all shadows.

Gen'ei Ryodan.d: Damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Stun and multiple Dispels.
Gen'ei Ryodan.notes: Used only by notorious monsters. Removes all shadows.

Phantom Whorl.d: Very high single-hit damage to one player.

Triple Reversal.d: Drains HP from a single player.

Enforce.d: Drains HP from players within 15 feet, but cannot defeat a player.
Enforce.notes: Ambuscade only. The monster recovers more than it takes from each player, and the drain is weaker the less HP a player has. Removes all shadows.

Bloodrake.d: A three-hit attack that drains HP.

Decollation.d: Damage to players in a cone. Can critical hit.

Eternal Damnation.d: A conal gaze that inflicts Doom.

Heliovoid.d: Absorbs one positive status effect from each target in range, including food.

Nosferatu's Kiss.d: Drains HP, MP and TP from players in range. HP drained scales with the monster's level.

Wings of Gehenna.d: Damage to players in range. Additional effects: Stun and Knockback.

Dirty Breath.d: Breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effect: Zombie.
Dirty Breath.notes: Not part of the standard family kit. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Minax Glare.d: A gaze that inflicts Terror and Defense Down.
Minax Glare.notes: Not part of the standard family kit. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Nocturnal Servitude.d: A conal Charm that dresses the target in a bat costume.
Nocturnal Servitude.notes: Not part of the standard family kit. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Dismemberment.d: Sacrifices a limb to deal damage to a single target.
Dismemberment.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Earthshatter.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect.

Self-Destruct.d: Explodes for damage based on remaining HP (HP * 1/3) to targets in an area of effect, then falls to the ground.
Self-Destruct.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Heat Wave.d: Inflicts Burn on targets in an area of effect (INT -33, HP -40/tick, 15-60s).
Heat Wave.notes: Used only in CoP and ToAU areas. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Vulcanian Impact.d: Deals damage to a single target.
Vulcanian Impact.notes: Used only in CoP and ToAU areas. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Hellstorm.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone (HP * 1/2, capped at 1,300).

Arctic Impact.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect.
Arctic Impact.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Hiemal Storm.d: Deals damage in a frontal cone (HP * 1/2, capped at 1,300).
Hiemal Storm.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Dark Wave.d: Inflicts Bio on targets in an area of effect (-8 HP/tick daytime, -20 HP/tick nighttime).
Dark Wave.notes: BG-wiki publishes the Type column for this move as unknown. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Nocturnal Combustion.d: Explodes for damage based on remaining HP (HP * 1/3) to targets in an area of effect, then falls to the ground.
Nocturnal Combustion.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Penumbral Impact.d: Deals damage to a single target. Potency increases by 50% at night.
Penumbral Impact.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Bludgeon.d: Deals three-hit damage to a single target.

Deal Out.d: Deals damage and knockback to targets in a frontal cone.

Shuffle.d: Dispels one beneficial status effect from targets in a frontal cone.
Shuffle.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Double Down.d: Deals damage to a single target, resets the user’s enmity, and grants the user a 100% attack boost.
Double Down.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Interference.d: Deals magic damage and dispels one beneficial effect from targets in an area of effect.

Malign Invocation.d: Deals magic damage and inflicts Amnesia on targets in an area of effect.

Stygian Sphere.d: Restores roughly 2,000 HP to the user and removes all enfeebling effects.
Stygian Sphere.notes: Iratham variants also gain a magic shield, Stoneskin, and a Magic Attack boost; magic damage removes the shield.

Afflicting Gaze.d: Gaze attack inflicting a strong Plague (150 TP/tick) and Bind on the target.

Banneret Charge.d: Reduces the HP of targets in an area of effect to critical levels and resets enmity.

Besieger's Bane.d: Inflicts a strong Bio (Attack -15%, ~56 HP/3s), Zombie, and Terror on targets in an area of effect.

Dark Arrivisme.d: Deals damage and knockback and dispels up to three beneficial effects from targets in an area of effect; the user then gains Intimidation (75-95%) for one minute.

Deathly Diminuendo.d: Inflicts Curse (-50% HP and MP) and Bio on targets in an area of effect.

Diabolic Claw.d: Deals three-hit damage and Magic Defense Down to a single target.

Discordant Gambit.d: Deals damage, inhibits TP gain, and knocks back targets in an area of effect.

Enthrall.d: Charms targets in an area of effect and applies a Caturae "Sippoy" costume.

Flank Opening.d: Deals damage and knockback to targets in an area of effect and applies a -50% Defense Down aura.

Hellish Crescendo.d: Deals magic damage and Paralysis to targets in an area of effect.

Royal Decree.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect and temporarily restricts their support job abilities.

Shadow Wreck.d: Deals damage and -50% Defense Down to targets in an area of effect.

Shah Mat.d: Gaze attack inflicting Terror and Doom; the gaze lingers briefly like an aura after use.

Stygian Cyclone.d: Deals magic damage and Silence to targets in an area of effect.

Beleaguerment.d: Deals damage and inflicts Curse, Gravity, Slow, and a powerful Dia on targets in an area of effect.
Beleaguerment.notes: Below 50% HP also reduces max HP by ~75% and inflicts Zombie.

Pawn's Penumbra.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect and resets all of their job abilities.

Tabbiyaa Gambit.d: Restores roughly 2,000 HP to the user, removes all enfeebling effects, and may grant a variable damage-immunity shield with Stoneskin. A random damage type removes the shield.

Unchivalrous Stab.d: Deals damage and inflicts Curse, Gravity, and reductions to all attributes and to max HP, MP, and TP on targets in an area of effect.

Ebullient Nullification.d: Dispels and absorbs all beneficial effects from players within 20' of the user, gaining Attack and Magic Attack that scale with the number absorbed.
Ebullient Nullification.notes: Used at 100/75/50/25/10% HP. Does not dispel Aftermath, Dematerialize, runes, or other non-dispellable buffs.

Dancing Fullers.d: Deals 2,500 damage to each person within 10' of the user, including pets and luopans.
Dancing Fullers.notes: Unaffected by Sentinel's Scherzo, One for All, or any Damage Taken reduction. Used at 75/50/25/10% HP.

Eleventh Dimension.d: Inflicts a 3-minute Terror on the player that Target was used on.
Eleventh Dimension.notes: Used ~1:30 after Target activates on that player.

Death Sentence.d: Inflicts a 10-count Doom on the player holding significantly higher cumulative enmity than the next player on the hate list.

Target.d: Marks a player — the user's eyes glow — enabling Eleventh Dimension against them.

Unfaltering Bravado.d: Deals 10,000 damage split among targets in a frontal cone; cannot be reduced by any form of Damage Taken reduction.
Unfaltering Bravado.notes: Used at 75/50/25/10% HP. The user then briefly gains an avoidance-down (no parry or shield block) and a Muddle aura.

False Promises.d: Charms targets in an area of effect.

Zero Hour.d: Deals AoE magic-based damage, resets enmity, and inflicts a 60-second Inhibit TP.

Gardez.d: Inflicts Terror for 3-10 seconds on targets within 20' of the user.
Gardez.notes: Can be fully resisted with sufficient magic evasion.

Prophylaxis.d: Immediately restores the user's HP to 22%, then to 100% after 30 seconds unless the user is defeated in that window.

Discord Gambit.d: Deals dark-elemental damage and resets TP on targets in an area of effect.

Circle of Flames.d: Deals two-to-three-hit fire damage (scaling with the number of bombs in the cluster) and Gravity to targets in an area of effect.

Formation Attack.d: Deals two-to-three-hit damage (scaling with the number of bombs in the cluster) to a single target.

Refueling.d: Grants the user Haste (20% for 3 minutes).

Sling Bomb.d: Deals ranged damage to a single target.

Electrocharge.d: Deals unaspected magic damage to a single target.
Electrocharge.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Electromagnetic Field.d: Deals lightning damage and knockback to targets in an area of effect.
Electromagnetic Field.notes: Used only in Promathia Mission 6-2. Removes all shadows.

Reactive Shield.d: Grants the user Shock Spikes for 3 minutes.

Stunbolt.d: Deals lightning damage and Stun to a single target.
Stunbolt.notes: Used only in Bastion and Brenner.

Death Trap.d: Inflicts Stun and Poison (~10 HP/tick for up to 5 minutes) on targets in an area of effect and resets its enmity.

Pandora's Curse.d: Inflicts Bio II and sets all of the target's attributes to 1 on targets in an area of effect.
Pandora's Curse.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them. Drains roughly 700 HP per tick and lasts about 45 seconds; healers can remove the Bio component but not the attribute reduction.

Double Whammy.d: Deals two consecutive hits to a single target.

Scurvy.d: Inflicts Plague on targets in an area of effect.

Guilded Torpor.d: Inflicts Sleep on targets in an area of effect.

Smite of Rage.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Volcanic Wrath.d: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effects: Burn and Max HP Down. Used only by red golems.

Exponential Burst.d: Deals heavy magic damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Magic Defense Down.

Transmogrification.d: Absorbs all physical damage and converts it into restored HP for ~30 seconds. Used only in Hand Form.

Velocious Blade.d: Delivers a five-fold attack for high damage. Used only in Sword Form.

Sonic Blade.d: Deals heavy damage to targets in an area of effect. Used only in Sword Form.

Scission Thrust.d: Deals directional (conal) area damage. Used only in Sword Form.

Psychomancy.d: AoE Aspir that drains 80+ MP from everyone in range. Used only in Staff Form.

Mind Wall.d: Special magic-shield effect: for ~30 seconds it absorbs and regains HP from all offensive magic used against it (does not protect against Astral Flow or elemental weapon skills). Used only in Staff Form.

Percussive Foin.d: Deals directional (conal) area damage. Used only in Polearm Form.

Microquake.d: Deals high single-target damage. Used only in Polearm Form.

Gravity Wheel.d: Deals high AoE damage. Additional effect: Gravity. Used only in Polearm Form.

Tremorous Tread.d: Deals area damage. Additional effect: Stun. Absorbed by Utsusemi. Usable in all forms.

Tectonic Shift.d: Deals area damage, partially draws in those hit, and resets enmity. Additional effect: Encumbrance. Used only by Notorious Monsters.

Eradicator.d: Deals magic damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Weakness.

Auger Smash.d: Deals damage to a single target. Additional effect: Weakness. Used only by the floating head variant.

Area Bombardment.d: Deals conal fire damage. Additional effects: Flash, multiple Dispel, and hate reset. Used only by the floating head variant.

Cauterizing Field.d: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effects: Burn and Amnesia; the caster gains Enfire and Blaze Spikes. Used only by the floating head variant.

Dreadstorm.d: Deals AoE damage and inflicts Terror (up to 10 seconds); removes all shadows.

Fossilizing Breath.d: Frontal cone breath that inflicts Petrifaction.

Plague Swipe.d: Frontal cone dealing damage with Plague and Bio; enmity is drawn from the rear.

Tenebrous Mist.d: AoE that resets the target's TP to 0.

Thunderstrike.d: Deals Lightning damage and Stun to targets in an area.

Tourbillion.d: Deals damage with Defense Down and Knockback while its wings are raised.

Fulmination.d: Massive AoE Lightning (Thunder) damage (600-1100) with Stun and potent Paralysis.

Lithic Breath.d: Frontal cone breath inflicting Petrifaction and Weakness. Used by Khrysokhimairas.

Double Ray.d: Deals non-elemental magic damage to a single target.

Mysterious Light.d: AoE magic damage with Weight (-75% movement speed, ~2 min); damage varies with TP.

Spectral Barrier.d: Grants Magic Shield (immunity to magic damage) for 30-60 seconds.

Battery Charge.d: Restores MP (about 66, up to doubled by TP).

Mind Drain.d: Absorbs the target's MND (-14, decaying over time).

Airy Shield.d: Grants a temporary immunity to ranged attacks (60s).

Binding Wave.d: AoE that inflicts Bind (30~60s); duration scales with TP.

Eyes On Me.d: Single-target magic damage that ignores Magic Damage Taken (but not Magic Defense Bonus) and cannot be resisted.

Mind Break.d: Gaze attack that lowers maximum MP (Max MP x 128/256, 10s).

Deathly Glare.d: Conal gaze that inflicts Death on players facing it. Used below 50% HP; targets in range not killed by the gaze take minor damage (~400-500).

Level 3 Petrify.d: Inflicts Petrifaction on all targets whose level is a multiple of 3 (15~60s); duration scales with TP.
Level 3 Petrify.notes: Only affects targets whose level is a multiple of three; on a valid target it cannot be resisted.

aerial.d: Flying trait: cannot be struck by standard melee attacks; only ranged attacks, magic, and certain moves (e.g. Cyclone) connect.

Bolt of Perdition.d: Conal lightning damage with knockback; inflicts Mute and Amnesia (~30-40s).

Crippling Rime.d: Conal ice damage that lowers all of the target's attributes (all stats down).

Diluvial Wake.d: AoE water damage; inflicts Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Divesting Gale.d: AoE wind damage; inflicts Encumbrance and Muddle.

Kurnugi Collapse.d: AoE earth damage; inflicts Accuracy Down and Magic Accuracy Down.

Oblivion's Mantle.d: 20’ AoE dark damage that inflicts Weakness (60s) and a 10-count Doom; players killed by the Doom return with double weakness. During some NMs’ Chainspell it inflicts Zombie instead of Doom.

Searing Halitus.d: Conal fire damage with a strong Burn damage-over-time (~38 HP/tick).

Unrelenting Brand.d: AoE damage that resets the user's ability recasts and inflicts Zombie; the user gains Blaze Spikes.
Unrelenting Brand.notes: Samursk's unique move, used below 50% HP; on Samursk it also inflicts Curse (Recovery Down). Easily stunnable, but the user gains Blaze Spikes even when the move is stunned.

Chokehold.d: Wind-based ability that inflicts Silence, Gravity, and Choke and pulls the target in. On the Sortie NMs it instead steals a buff from each party member in range and transfers it to the caster.

Concussive Shock.d: Lightning damage that inflicts Slow and Stun.

Tearing Gust.d: Wind damage that inflicts Magic Defense Down and knockback.

Undulating Shockwave.d: Lightning damage in an area of effect.

Zap.d: Lightning ability that inflicts Plague and Amnesia. On the Sortie NMs it copies a debuff from the caster to all party members in range.

Bloody Claw.d: Single-target HP drain that also absorbs one of the target's status enhancements; bypasses shadows. Used only while standing.

Dark Orb.d: AoE Dark magic damage; bypasses shadows. Used only while flying.

Dark Mist.d: AoE Dark magic damage that inflicts Weight (Gravity) and removes shadows. Used only while flying.

Terror Eye.d: Earth-based gaze that inflicts Terror. Used only while standing.

Triumphant Roar.d: Self-buff that grants an Attack Bonus (~33%). Used only while standing.

Shadow Burst.d: AoE Dark magic damage that inflicts Curse (halves max HP and MP) and removes shadows.
Shadow Burst.notes: NMs only; becomes available below 50% HP.

Quadrastrike.d: Four-hit physical attack with a 25% attack bonus.
Quadrastrike.notes: Restricted move. Consumes 4 shadows (one per hit).

Tera Slash.d: High conal physical damage that ignores Utsusemi.
Tera Slash.notes: Sometimes inflicts Death. Ignores Utsusemi shadows.

Violent Rupture.d: AoE damage with Knockback and Weight.

Dynamic Implosion.d: AoE physical damage with additional Terror.

Bilgestorm.d: AoE physical damage with Defense Down, Attack Down, and Accuracy Down.

Cackle.d: AoE that inflicts Magic Attack Down, Magic Defense Down, and Magic Accuracy Down.

Hellclap.d: Conal physical damage with Knockback and Gravity.

Necrobane.d: AoE that inflicts Paralysis and Curse.

Necropurge.d: AoE physical damage with Curse and Knockback.
Necropurge.notes: Knockback. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them).

Thundris Shriek.d: AoE Lightning damage with Terror; the Dvergr gains an intimidation effect afterward.

Dunur Strike.d: Conal (15’) physical damage that strips one random equipment slot (no Encumbrance).

Bilrost Squall.d: 20’ AoE dealing random-element magical damage plus a matching stat-down and enfeeble (Fire/INT/Amnesia, Ice/AGI/Paralysis, Wind/VIT/Silence, Earth/DEX/Petrify, Lightning/MND/Stun, Water/STR/Poison).
Bilrost Squall.notes: Restricted move (Naphula, Fjalar). Removes all shadows.

Abrasive Tantara.notes: Amnesia lasts 30-60s. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them). An imp cannot use this without its horn.

Deafening Tantara.notes: Silence lasts 30-60s. Bypasses shadows (does not remove them). An imp cannot use this without its horn.

Frenetic Rip.notes: Consumes 3 shadows. An imp resorts to this only while its horn is broken.

Grating Tantara.d: AoE magic damage that also inflicts Amnesia.

Stifling Tantara.d: AoE magic damage that also inflicts Silence.

Bugle Call.d: Self-targeted buff — raises a Bio aura around the imp and may grant a secondary buff.
Bugle Call.notes: Vanasarvik uses Bugle Call to summon and resummon its Elder's Imps.

Dark Recital.d: AoE magic damage with a full Dispel and Paralysis.

Immortal Shield.d: Gains a Rampart-style magic shield (a magic-based Stoneskin) that absorbs magic damage before breaking — about 1,000 on ordinary Soulflayers, far more on NMs.
Immortal Shield.notes: On some NMs the shield reduces melee damage ~90% and nullifies magic until broken (roughly 3,000 non-elemental damage removes it).

Immortal Mind.d: Gains Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus.

Immortal Anathema.d: AoE that inflicts Curse (-20% to -30% HP/MP, ~30s).

Mind Blast.d: Conal magic damage with a potent Paralysis (15-45s); duration scales with TP.

Mind Purge.d: Single-target Dispel that removes all beneficial status effects, including food.

Tribulation.d: AoE (10') that inflicts Blind (-100 Acc, ~2min) and Bio III (-30 to -39 HP/tick, ~2min).

Reprobation.d: AoE Dispel that removes all beneficial status effects, including food.
Reprobation.notes: Restricted move — ordinary Soulflayers gain access to it only at low HP; NMs use it freely.

Back Swish.d: Conal attack with Knockback. Can critical hit.

Frightful Roar.d: Inflicts Defense Down in an area of effect.
Frightful Roar.notes: Defense Down (Defense x199/256, 2-3 min). Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Mortal Ray.notes: Ordinary Taurus use it only once per fight. Bypasses shadows without removing them.

Triclip.notes: DEX Down (~-20 DEX, 90s), varies with TP. Consumes 3 shadows.

Flame Breath.d: Deals fire breath damage to players in a cone. Damage ~ Current HP x 1/10 (cap 400).
Flame Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Wind Breath.d: Deals wind breath damage to players in a cone. Damage ~ Current HP x 1/10 (cap 400).
Wind Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Lodesong.d: Inflicts Gravity on players in an area of effect.
Lodesong.notes: Gravity: -75% movement speed, ~30s. A song - not used while silenced. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Voidsong.d: Dispels all status effects from players (including food) and removes status ailments from itself.
Voidsong.notes: A song - not used while silenced. Removes all shadows.

Thornsong.d: The monster gains non-elemental damage spikes.
Thornsong.notes: A song - not used while silenced.

Chaos Blade.d: Deals dark damage to players in a cone, with an additional Curse effect.
Chaos Blade.notes: Curse: -20% to -50% HP/MP, 1-15 min (varies with NMs). Damage is dealt before the Curse. Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Nullsong.d: Dispels all status effects and deals 117 damage per status enhancement removed.
Nullsong.notes: Used by the Dahak (red) variant. A song - not used while silenced. Removes all shadows.

Discordant Note.d: Deals damage with knockback. Inflicts Slow, Silence, and a very potent Gravity.
Discordant Note.notes: Used by the purple variant. Removes all shadows.

Abyssic Buster.d: Deals massive damage to targets in a frontal cone.

Chaos Blast.d: Deals frontal area-of-effect damage with knockback.

Chilling Roar.d: Lets out a roar that inflicts Terror on nearby players.
Chilling Roar.notes: On Notorious Monsters, also summons adds and/or raises the monster's level.

Dancing Tail.d: Conal physical damage from behind, 3-5 hits depending on wing position.

Dark Star.d: Deals magical damage in an area of effect.
Dark Star.notes: When wings are up, additionally inflicts Defense Down (-25%) and Magic Defense Down.

Dexter Wing.d: Right-side conal physical damage with knockback.

Sinister Wing.d: Left-side conal physical damage with knockback.

Soul Douse.d: Frontal conal breath damage with an additional Doom effect.
Soul Douse.notes: Frontal target only. Doom count is 5 when wings are up, 10 when down.

Obfuscate.d: Inflicts Flash on players in an area of effect.
Obfuscate.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

White Wind.d: Recovers HP based on the caster’s maximum HP.
White Wind.notes: Used by Peapuks (one time only) and by Notorious Monsters (at will).

Ill Wind.d: Deals wind damage in an area of effect and dispels one beneficial status effect.
Ill Wind.notes: Dispel is darkness-based. Removes all shadows. Used by Mamook Puks and Notorious Monsters only.

Somnial Durance.d: Inflicts Sleep on players in an area of effect.
Somnial Durance.notes: Used by Sarimanok when below 50% HP.

Dread Shriek.d: Inflicts Paralysis on players in an area of effect.

Dreaded Shriek.d: Inflicts a potent Paralysis on players in an area of effect (Notorious Monster version of Dread Shriek).

Deadly Drive.d: A single-hit physical attack on one target.

Deadly Dive.d: A powerful single diving physical attack on one target (Notorious Monster version of Deadly Drive).

Thunder Breath.d: Deals lightning breath damage to players in a cone.

Hurricane Breath.d: Deals heavy wind breath damage to players in a cone. Additional effects: Knockback and removes one piece of equipment.

Blizzard Breath.d: Deals ice breath damage to players in a cone.

Chaos Breath.d: Deals dark breath damage to players in a cone.

Gust Breath.d: Deals wind breath damage to players in a cone.
Gust Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Hydro Breath.d: Deals water breath damage to players in a cone.
Hydro Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Lightning Breath.d: Deals lightning breath damage to players in a cone.
Lightning Breath.notes: Bypasses shadows, but does not remove them.

Chastise.d: Inflicts Magic Attack Down and Magic Defense Down on players in an area of effect.

Denounce.d: Deals damage proportional to the maximum HP of all players in range and resets enmity. Additional effects: Paralysis, Defense Down, and Magic Defense Down.

Heaven's Grace.d: Restores the caster’s HP and removes multiple debuffs.

Rending Blow.d: A conal physical attack that dispels up to four beneficial effects (light-based).

Repelling Shout.d: An area-of-effect ability; full effect not documented.

Scorching Luminescence.d: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effects: Dia and Knockback.

Vicious Rake.d: Deals damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effects: Silence and Knockback.

Yaegasumi.notes: A Samurai one-hour ability the NM borrows; used by Tenzen and Bumba (lasts 45 seconds for Bumba).

Touchdown.d: A landing slam that resets the Wyrm’s own TP to 0.
Touchdown.notes: Used when a flying Wyrm lands; does not require TP.

Familiar.notes: A Beastmaster job ability the NM borrows.

Baleful Roar.d: Removes all beneficial effects from targets in an area and resets enmity.

Charm.d: Charms a single target, turning it against its allies.

Depuration.d: Self-buff. Erases all negative status effects from the user.

Sideswipe.notes: Removes the user's own enmity. Used when wielding Hand-to-Hand.

Biotic Boomerang.d: AoE physical damage. Can critical strike.

Medusa Javelin.notes: High damage (up to ~2000). Used when wielding a Polearm.

Efflorescent Foetor.d: Frontal cone. Inflicts Blind and Silence.
Efflorescent Foetor.notes: Blind potency -100. Used in Bloomed (open flower) form.

Stupor Spores.notes: Non-elemental. Bypasses shadows. Used in Bloomed (open flower) form.

Axial Bloom.notes: Bypasses shadows. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Viscid Nectar.notes: Bypasses shadows. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Nutrient Absorption.notes: Consumes 1 shadow. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Morning Glory.d: AoE physical damage. Can critical strike.
Morning Glory.notes: Consumes 2-3 shadows. Used in Petal (closed bud) form.

Vertical Cleave.d: Single-target physical damage. Can critical strike.
Vertical Cleave.notes: +25% Attack (self). Bypasses shadows. Used in Bloomed (open flower) form.

Soul Voice.d: Bard SP ability: doubles the potency of the user's songs for its duration.

Call Wyvern.d: Dragoon ability: summons a wyvern pet to fight alongside the user.
Call Wyvern.notes: Absolute Virtue and Warder of Courage summon Aern's Wynavs instead of a normal wyvern.

Mijin Gakure.d: Ninja SP ability: the user self-destructs, dealing damage based on remaining HP. The user is KO’d.

Aerial Collision.d: Frontal cone. Deals 3 hits of physical damage.

Ink Cloud.d: AoE. Inflicts Blind and grants the user an Evasion Bonus.

Mantle Pierce.d: Single-target physical damage. Can critically hit.

Molluscous Mutation.d: Self-buff. Gains a large Defense Bonus (+75%).

Saline Coat.d: Self-buff. Gains a large Magic Defense Bonus (+100).

Siphon Discharge.d: Frontal cone water damage equal to 10% of the user’s current HP.

Fluorescence.d: Self-buff. Gains Boost; its next attack deals roughly four times damage.

Torrential Torment.d: AoE water damage that also strips all of the target’s equipment.

Earthshock.d: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Flying Hip Press.d: Deals Wind damage to targets in an area of effect.

Heavy Whisk.d: Deals physical damage in a cone. Additional effect: Knockback.

Heavy Blow.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Colossal Slam.d: Deals heavy physical damage in an area of effect, wipes shadows and inflicts Zombie status for a short time.

Goblin Rush.d: Rushes forward with a three-hit melee strike.

Bomb Toss (Dropped).d: A bomb dropped when the goblin dies or its Bomb Toss backfires.
Bomb Toss (Dropped).notes: Damage equal to 1/3 of the goblin's remaining HP. Bypasses shadows.

Belly Dance.d: Charms players within a gaze area of effect.
Belly Dance.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Lamia.

Dukkeripen.d: Restores HP, grants Utsusemi, or inflicts Paralysis on the Lamia and nearby monsters.
Dukkeripen.notes: Used only by Corsair Lamia — a random Phantom Roll-like effect.

Grim Reaper.d: Deals physical damage and inflicts Doom on players in a fan-shaped area.
Grim Reaper.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Lamia.

Hysteric Barrage.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.
Hysteric Barrage.notes: Used when the Lamia's main weapon is broken (in place of its weapon TP move). Consumes 5 shadows.

Rising Swell.d: Removes all equipment from nearby players.
Rising Swell.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Merrow.

Tidal Slash.d: Deals physical damage to targets in an area of effect.
Tidal Slash.notes: Used only by Lamia equipped with a polearm.

Torrent.d: Removes all equipment from a target.
Torrent.notes: Used only by Merrow. Bypasses shadows. The equipment removal is water-based and may be resisted.

Calcifying Deluge.d: Deals damage (~600) and Petrifies targets in a long-range cone.

Gorgon Dance.d: Petrifies players within a sight-based gaze area (~20 yalms).

Pinning Shot.d: Deals moderate ranged damage to targets in an area of effect.

Somersault Kick.d: Deals physical damage to a single target with an added Knockback effect.

Warm-Up.d: The user gains Accuracy Boost and Evasion Boost.

Firespit.d: A fire-based attack. Melee Mamool Ja land a 3-hit physical version; caster Mamool Ja deal single-target fire magic damage.
Firespit.notes: BLU/BST/DRG/NIN/THF forms are 3-hit physical and consume 3 Utsusemi shadows; BLM/WHM forms are magical and bypass shadows without removing them.

Forceful Blow.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.
Forceful Blow.notes: Used by hand-to-hand (H2H) Mamool Ja only.

Rushing Drub.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.
Rushing Drub.notes: Used by WHM/BLM Mamool Ja only.

Rushing Slash.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.
Rushing Slash.notes: Used by BST Mamool Ja only.

Rushing Stab.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.
Rushing Stab.notes: Used by DRG Mamool Ja only.

Vorpal Blade.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.
Vorpal Blade.notes: Used by BLU Mamool Ja; also by Ghrah in Humanoid form.

Groundburst.d: Deals fire damage to players in an area of effect.
Groundburst.notes: Used by Notorious Monster Mamool Ja only.

Drill Claw.d: A conal attack that deals physical damage with an added Max HP Down (-75%) and Knockback effect.

Thrashing Assault.d: A 5-hit physical attack on a single target with an added Defense Down effect.

Meeble Warble.d: An area-of-effect call that deals damage and inflicts Silence; any awake Meebles within range are drawn in to link and assist.
Meeble Warble.notes: Calls nearby awake Meebles to link (see General Notes).

Puncturing Frenzy.d: A conal attack that deals physical damage.
Puncturing Frenzy.notes: Used by Notorious Monster Meebles only.

Blastbomb.d: A frontal attack that deals fire damage with an added Bind effect.

Burst.d: Deals physical damage to a single target.

Fire Arrow.d: Deals fire damage to a single target.

Firebomb.d: Deals fire damage to players in an area of effect around the target.

Fountain.d: A frontal attack that deals water damage.

Scatter Shell.d: An area-of-effect attack dealing roughly 1000 physical damage divided equally among all targets.
Scatter Shell.notes: Certain Notorious Monster only; long cast time (~3-4s).

Sticky Grenade.d: An area-of-effect attack that deals physical damage with an added Weight effect.
