Tear Grenade.d: An area-of-effect attack that deals physical damage with added Silence and Blind effects.

Frog Song.d: Attempts to charm a single target.

Frog Chorus.d: Attempts to charm targets in an area of effect.

Magic Hammer.d: Deals magic damage to a single target. Additional effect: MP Drain

Providence.d: Grants the user Haste and unlocks casting of Breakga, Graviga, Slowga, Bindga, and Death.
Providence.notes: After Providence the Poroggo can cast Breakga, Graviga, Slowga, Bindga, and Death.

Quenching Hammer.d: Deals magic damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Dispel (all) and Aspir. Damage rises with the number of buffs on the target.
Quenching Hammer.notes: Ambuscade only. Buff count includes Runes and Geomancer spells; excludes food, Maneuvers, and SP abilities.

Water Bomb.d: Deals Water elemental damage to players in an area of effect. Additional effect: Silence

Hydro Shot.d: Deals ranged physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Knockback and Enmity reset.

Everyone's Grudge.d: Deals magic damage to a single target based on the target's cumulative "Tonberry Hate" (number of Tonberry-family monsters the target has defeated).
Everyone's Grudge.notes: Damage scales with how many Tonberries the character has killed; unaffected by magic defense.

Jungle Hoodoo.d: AoE magic damage plus Paralyze, Plague, and Curse (-50%).
Jungle Hoodoo.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Mage-type Velkk.

Jungle Wallop.d: AoE physical damage plus Silence, Bind, and Amnesia.
Jungle Wallop.notes: Used only by Notorious Monster Warrior-type Velkk.

Saurian Slide.d: Physical damage that strips the target's main and sub weapons (temporary weapon Encumbrance) and knocks them back.

Saurian Swamp.d: AoE magic damage plus Bind and Slow.

Carousel.d: Deals physical damage. Additional effect: Knockback.
Carousel.notes: NM only. Used immediately after View Sync as a combo; never used as a stand-alone move.

View Sync.d: Draws in all targets and deals area damage. Additional effect: Bind.

Quadratic Continuum.d: Four-hit physical attack; inflicts a -20% Attack penalty on itself afterward.

Blessing Sync.d: Copies status enhancements from players within ~10'.
Blessing Sync.notes: NM only. Copies even normally non-dispellable buffs (e.g. Dematerialize, Aftermath). Copying many effects grants a strong Damage Taken reduction, up to full immunity; dispel the stolen buffs to remove it. Enfeebling effects on it also count toward the reduction.

Empty Seed.d: Deals physical damage to targets in a 20' area of effect. Additional effect: Knockback.

Lamentation.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect and inflicts Dia (Defense Down, roughly 8 HP per tick).

Occultation.d: The user gains the Blink status.

Vanity Strike.d: Deals physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun.

Wanion.d: Transfers the user's negative status effects onto targets in an area of effect.

Binary Absorption.d: Drains 200 HP from a single target.

Binary Tap.d: Absorbs two positive status effects from a single target, or otherwise drains HP.

Pain Sync.d: Deals breath damage equal to 40% of the damage inflicted to the user while it readies this move, in a 20' area of effect.

Spirit Tap.d: Absorbs one positive status effect from a single target, or otherwise drains HP.

Trinary Absorption.d: Drains 300 HP from a single target.

Winds of Promyvion.d: Erases a negative status effect from the user.
Winds of Promyvion.notes: Used when the user has an active status ailment.

Vacuous Osculation.d: Single-target physical damage; inflicts Poison and Plague.

Decayed Filament.d: Deals physical damage and Poison to targets in an area of effect.

Optic Induration.d: Conal physical attack that Petrifies targets. ~15 yalm range.

Reactor Cool.d: Grants the Zdei a Defense Bonus and Ice Spikes (with a potent Paralyze effect).

Reactor Overload.d: Deals physical damage and Silence to targets in an area of effect.

Searing Tempest.d: Deals fire damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Burn.

Blinding Fulgor.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Flash.

Spectral Floe.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Terror.

Scouring Spate.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Attack Down.

Anvil Lightning.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Stun.

Silent Storm.d: Deals damage to targets in an area of effect. Additional effect: Silence.

Heartfelt Aura.d: Grants itself undispellable temporary Protect, Shell, Haste, Regen, and Regain.

Impairing Glister.d: Deals damage in an area of effect. Additional effects: Dia, Flash, and resets the target's TP.

Ancestral Banishment.d: Deals damage in an area of effect and dispels multiple status effects.

Crippling Gleam.d: Deals damage in an area of effect, dispels multiple status effects, and lowers all of the target’s attributes.

Acheron Kick.d: Physical damage with knockback to nearby targets; used when attacking from behind.

Damsel Memento.d: Restores ~5% HP and removes its status ailments; may boost its magic damage.

Rampant Stance.d: Physical damage to nearby targets. Additional effect: Stun.

Wrath of Zeus.d: Heavy thunder damage to nearby targets. Additional effect: Silence. Damage increases when charging animations precede it.

Lightning Spear.d: Thunder-based breath damage in a cone. Removes shadows.

Grace of Hera.d: Restores ~5% HP, removes its status ailments, and grants itself Regen.

Scintillant Lance.d: High light-based magical damage in a frontal cone (~160°). Removes shadows.

Cyclonic Turmoil.d: Deals Wind damage + Knockback + Dispel positive status effects.

Lethe Arrows.d: Deals physical damage + Knockback + Bind + Amnesia.

Summer Breeze.d: Erases negative status effects, or gains Regain.

Norn Arrow.d: Heavy AoE damage (~1000, 20' radius) + Encumbrance (~1 min).
Norn Arrow.notes: NM-only Pixie TP move (Belphoebe, Bhishani). Fanatic's Drink blocks the damage but not the Encumbrance.

Eldritch Wind.d: AoE damage + full Dispel + Addle + Plague.

Beclouding Dust.d: AoE damage that removes one beneficial effect (Dispel).

Brewing Storm.d: Conal damage with Flash, Attack Down, and Magic Attack Down.

Paralyzing Triad.d: Conal physical damage with a potent Paralyze.

Benthic Typhoon.d: Deals damage; additional effect lowers Defense and Magic Defense.

Pelagic Tempest.d: Deals damage with an additional Terror effect.

Acrid Stream.d: Deals water damage and lowers the target's Magic Defense by 25.

Osmosis.d: Absorbs the target's HP and one beneficial effect.

Nucleic Implosion.d: Absorbs HP, fully dispels the target, and resets its job ability recast timers.

Homing Missile.d: Deals damage equal to roughly 90% of the target's current HP and removes enmity.
Homing Missile.notes: Only used by certain Notorious Monsters. Target must be in front.

Artificial Gravity.d: Deals physical damage and inflicts Weight.

Antigravity.d: Deals physical damage and knocks back.

Rail Cannon.d: Deals damage; the area scales with the number of linked Gears (3 Gears = AoE, 2 Gears = frontal cone, 1 Gear = single target).
Rail Cannon.notes: Area depends on the number of linked Gears.

Astral Gate.d: Deals physical damage and knocks back.

Choke Chain.notes: Used only when the door is closed.

Roller Chain.d: Deals physical damage and inflicts Bind.
Roller Chain.notes: Used only when the door is closed.

Divine Judgment.d: Deals damage, then applies a full dispel and full MP removal.

Divine Spear.d: Deals damage with Petrify, Attack Down (-50%), and Magic Attack Down.

Gospel of the Lost.d: Recovers HP, removes all debuffs, and grants a powerful, unremovable Stoneskin.
Gospel of the Lost.notes: Used in response to any debuff being applied.

Perfect Defense.d: Grants complete damage immunity for 30 seconds.
Perfect Defense.notes: Triggered by receiving five skillchains; may also follow every third Gospel of the Lost.

Mega Holy.d: Deals damage to both HP and MP in an area of effect.

Radiant Sacrament.d: Deals damage with Silence, Defense Down (-50%), and Magic Defense Down.

Void of Repentance.d: Inflicts Stun, Accuracy Down (-100), and Magic Accuracy Down.
Void of Repentance.notes: Used after any skillchain is performed.

Meteorite.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Deals area damage.

Holy Mist.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A light-based attack that also lowers the target's Defense.
Holy Mist.notes: Carbuncle Prime ★ uses an AoE version.

Ruinous Omen.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Halves the current HP of enemies in an area of effect.
Ruinous Omen.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.

Howling Moon.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A dark-based area attack.
Howling Moon.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit (used by the ★ version).

Lunar Roar.d: Removes up to ten beneficial effects from targets in a 30' area of effect.

Aerial Blast.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Garuda's ultimate wind attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.
Aerial Blast.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.

Wind Blade.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A wind-based ranged attack that ignores shadows.

Inferno.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Ifrit's ultimate fire attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.
Inferno.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.

Meteor Strike.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A fire-based attack that ignores shadows.

Judgment Bolt.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Ramuh's ultimate lightning attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.
Judgment Bolt.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.

Thunderstorm.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A lightning-based attack that ignores shadows.

Tidal Wave.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Leviathan's ultimate water attack, dealing heavy damage to enemies in an area of effect.
Tidal Wave.notes: Partial hate reset on all targets hit.

Grand Fall.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A water-based attack that ignores shadows.

Heavenly Strike.d: Deals ice damage in an area of effect. Ignores shadows.

Hysteric Assault.d: A fivefold physical attack that also drains HP proportional to the damage dealt.

Sonic Buffet.d: Wind-based conal attack that dispels 2-3 beneficial effects.

Bitter Elegy.d: A single-target wind-based Slow (50%), applied as a song debuff (removed by Erase).

Clarsach Call.d: High wind damage in a wide radius; grants the Siren Attack/Defense/Evasion/Magic Attack/Magic Accuracy/Magic Evasion/Magic Defense bonuses for 3 minutes (each individually dispellable).

Earthen Fury.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Titan's ultimate earth attack, dealing heavy damage in an area of effect.
Earthen Fury.notes: Once per battle. Partial hate reset on all targets hit.

Rock Throw.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A ranged attack with an additional Slow effect.

Rock Buster.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Blunt damage that inflicts Bind.

Megalith Throw.d: Blood Pact: Rage. A stronger ranged attack with an additional Slow effect.

Earthen Ward.d: Blood Pact: Ward. Grants a Stoneskin effect.

Mountain Buster.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Stronger blunt damage that inflicts Bind.

Geocrush.d: Blood Pact: Rage. Earth damage that inflicts Stun and ignores shadows.

Ofnir.d: Deals damage with Defense Down and Magic Defense Down.

Valfodr.d: Deals damage with Curse and Silence.

Gagnrath.d: Conal physical damage that inflicts Terror.

Geirrothr.d: Area damage scaled by difficulty and divided among the players in range. Additional effect: Bind.

Sanngetall.d: Dispels all songs and rolls from targets in a 15' area of effect.

Yggr.d: Grants Odin an intimidation and attack boost effect.

Zantetsuken X.d: Instantly K.O.s any target in a 20' area when Odin's attack exceeds a set ratio over their defense.

Divine Favor.d: Removes status ailments from the caster.

Cacodemonia.d: An area-of-effect attack that deals dark damage and inflicts Curse.

Nightmare.d: Puts targets in an area into a deep (hyper) sleep.

Hypnogenesis.d: Deals dark damage (a large single-target hit, or an AoE Throat Stab depending on the caster).

Daydream.notes: Used incrementally after Nightmare (once after the first, twice after the second, and so on).

Ultimate Terror.d: Drains 2-4 of the target's stats by 22 and steals one beneficial effect from targets in range.

Dream Shroud.d: Grants Diabolos a Magic Attack and Magic Defense boost.

Camisado.d: Dark damage; the AoE version deals 500-700 with a 10' knockback.

Pull In.d: Draws in the target from a very large range.

Floodlight.d: Fires a searing light over a large area.
Floodlight.notes: Used by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega (two-legged form).

Guided Missile II.d: Targets players around its current target with a missile. Additional effect: Bind.
Guided Missile II.notes: Used by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega (two-legged form). Ignores shadows.

Laser Shower.d: Rains laser fire on players in a fan-shaped area.

Pod Ejection.d: Ejects and deploys a Gunpod to assist it.
Pod Ejection.notes: Used periodically by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega. Gunpods self-destruct with Electrocharge for severe AoE damage if not defeated quickly.

Rear Lasers.d: Fires lasers to the rear at players holding hate from behind. Additional effect: Petrifaction.
Rear Lasers.notes: Only used when hate is pulled from the rear.

Stun Cannon.d: Fires an energy cannon at players in a fan-shaped area. Additional effect: Paralysis.
Stun Cannon.notes: Used by Proto-Omega and Arch-Omega (two-legged form). Ignores shadows.

Armor Buster.d: Deals damage to players in range. Additional effect: Weight.
Armor Buster.notes: Used by Proto-Ultima and Arch-Ultima. Can be absorbed by shadows.

Citadel Buster.d: Charges and unleashes a devastating light blast over a wide radius.
Citadel Buster.notes: Used below ~25% HP after a ~30-second charge (up to ~2600 damage); resets hate. Preceded by a warning countdown and mitigated by Sentinel's Scherzo, Migawari: Ichi, or Earthen Armor.

Citadel Siege.notes: Arch-Ultima only, at 49/39/29/19/9% HP. Avoidable by keeping distance; skipped while Arch-Ultima is readying Citadel Buster.

Dissipation.d: Emits a pulse that strips beneficial effects from players in range. Additional effect: Terror + Enmity reset.
Dissipation.notes: Full dispel. Can be blocked with Asylum. Used at set HP intervals.

Energy Screen.d: Erects a barrier that nullifies physical damage.
Energy Screen.notes: Cannot be active at the same time as Mana Screen.

Mana Screen.d: Erects a barrier that nullifies magical damage.
Mana Screen.notes: Cannot be active at the same time as Energy Screen.

Wirecutter.d: Slashes a single player for high physical damage.
Wirecutter.notes: Can be absorbed by shadows or Third Eye. Consumes two shadows.

Catastrophic Malfunction.d: Deals damage to players in range and lowers their elemental resistances.
Catastrophic Malfunction.notes: Arch-Ultima only. Above 50% HP it is followed by a tier-V nuke or Comet; below 50% by a -ja nuke, Banishga IV, or Meteor.

Soul Vacuum.d: Drains attributes from all players within range, reducing each stat by roughly 50 points.
Soul Vacuum.notes: Used by Atomos, immediately followed by Soul Infusion.

Soul Infusion.d: Transfers the attributes drained by Soul Vacuum to Cait Sith Ceithir.

Seed of Nihility.d: Deals minor damage to players in range and resets every party member's job-ability recast timers to maximum, including two-hour abilities.

Seed of Deference.d: Charms players in range, dressing any charmed player in a Mandragora costume.

Seed of Deception.d: Clones the targeted player as a 'Seed Thrall' that attacks whoever currently holds hate.

Seed of Judgement.d: A high-damage knockback blast over an area.
Seed of Judgement.notes: Used by Seed Crystal only below 50% HP.

Seismostomp.d: A stomping shockwave that damages nearby players. Additional effect: Stun.
Seismostomp.notes: Used by all Replicas. Absorbed by Utsusemi. As a Replica's HP falls its regain intensifies, so it uses Seismostomp more often and can chain it back-to-back when fed TP by incoming damage.

Lead Breath.d: A heavy breath striking players in a cone. Additional effect: Weight.

Numbing Glare.d: A paralyzing gaze at a player in front.
Numbing Glare.notes: Used by Orc-type Replicas. A gaze — avoid by facing away.

Tormentful Glare.d: A cursing gaze at a player in front, cutting maximum HP by 10%.
Tormentful Glare.notes: Used by Yagudo-type Replicas. A gaze — avoid by facing away. Remove Curse with Holy Water or Cursna.

Torpid Glare.d: A sleep-inducing gaze at a player in front.
Torpid Glare.notes: Used by Goblin-type Replicas. A gaze — avoid by facing away.

Empty Salvation.d: AoE damage (~250) that dispels up to 3 beneficial effects.

Pestilent Penance.d: Cone attack (~400 damage) with an additional Plague effect.

Malevolent Blessing.d: Cone attack (400-500 damage) with an additional Curse effect.

Infernal Deliverance.d: AoE damage plus Stun. Ignores Utsusemi.

Seal of Quiescence.d: AoE Mute lasting up to 75 seconds. Cannot be removed with Silena or Echo Drops.

Winds of Oblivion.d: AoE Amnesia lasting up to 75 seconds.

Bastion of Twilight.d: Grants the caster a Magic Shield that nullifies magic damage.
Bastion of Twilight.notes: Ring beneath the boss glows green while the magic shield is up.

Wheel of Impregnability.d: Grants the caster Invincible, nullifying physical damage.
Wheel of Impregnability.notes: Ring beneath the boss glows red while the physical shield is up.

Chains of Apathy.d: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Arrogance.d: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Cowardice.d: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Envy.d: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Chains of Rage.d: A chain attack that appears to have no notable effect.

Celling Rupture.d: Conal damage with Bind, Max HP Down, and Knockback.

Destitution.d: Conal damage with Max HP Down and Terror.

Essence Devour.d: Conal attack that drains HP and MP from a player and lowers all attributes for 30 seconds.

Shearing Undulation.d: AoE damage with Defense Down and Magic Defense Down (60s each).

Primordial Surge.d: AoE that drains HP from all players, then absorbs incoming damage until its next TP move.
Primordial Surge.notes: Head gem glows red while absorbing; deal no damage. Ends with Waning Vigor or Expunge.

Waning Vigor.d: AoE damage scaled by the damage absorbed during Primordial Surge; applies Weakness (15s) to the primary target.

Expunge.d: AoE damage scaled by the damage absorbed during Primordial Surge, plus a full dispel.
Expunge.notes: Used after Primordial Surge, below 25% HP.

Bane of Tartarus.d: Dispels all buffs including food; the primary target gains ~60s Weakness.

Eternal Misery.d: Damage, ~5-second Zombie, and an enmity reset.

Impudence.d: Conal damage, ~5-second Zombie, and an enmity reset.
Impudence.notes: Used above 90% HP (the boss uses only this until 90%).

Incessant Void.notes: Used at 50% HP or below. On Hades it grants a Magic Barrier that a stagger removes.

Prismatic Breath.d: AoE conal damage plus Inhibit TP (Store TP reduction).

Orogenesis.d: AoE damage with Weight, Choke, and Evasion Down.

Diffractive Break.d: AoE damage with Amnesia, Muddle, and Silence.

Euhedral Swat.d: High AoE damage and knockback with Attack Down and Defense Down; used when hate is pulled from behind.

Crystallite Shower.d: AoE damage with Dia, Slow, and Addle.

Graviton Crux.d: AoE HP drain with random attribute absorb and a partial draw-in; the caster gains temporary Damage Spikes.

Phason Beam.d: AoE damage and Magic Defense Down.

Crystal Bolide.d: AoE damage with Terror and Obliviscence (disables sub jobs).

Fragor Maximus.d: AoE damage that applies Weakness; the caster gains a strong Killer (intimidation) effect for a time.

Atomic Ray.d: AoE magical damage and -50% to all attributes. Prevented by cruor buffs.
Atomic Ray.notes: Unlocked at mid HP (66%-). Used while its wings are spread.

Cataclysmic Vortex.d: AoE magical damage that tries to reduce every target to 1 HP, and resets the enmity of whoever holds the most hate.
Cataclysmic Vortex.notes: Shell and -MDT% gear both cut the damage. The enmity reset frequently pulls a Draw In straight afterwards, which can interrupt the cures you need right then.

Cosmic Breath.d: Front conal breath for moderate damage with Plague and Attack Down.
Cosmic Breath.notes: Fires even with nobody in range. Standing to its sides avoids it outright, the same trick that lessens Wyrm breath.

Dark Matter.d: 20' AoE magical damage with Terror (15+ seconds).

Gyre Charge.d: AoE physical damage with Paralysis and knockback.

Mighty Guard.d: Restores roughly 15% of its own HP and raises two separate buffs: a one-minute damage shield and a dispellable 10 TP/tick Regain.
Mighty Guard.notes: The shield completely nullifies spell damage and standard melee hits; weapon skills and the occasional critical hit punch through it. The Regain can be dispelled, the shield cannot. With its wings spread it will still absorb damage from attacks landed while it is casting or using TP, shield or no shield.

Supernova.d: 20' AoE magical damage with a 10-count Doom.
Supernova.notes: Unlocked at low HP (33%-). Used while its wings are down; not used on Very Easy or Easy. Any Doom still running is removed on leaving the battlefield.

Protostar.d: 20' AoE magical damage that resets every ready job ability on its targets to full recast — a whole-party ability wipe, not a self-buff.
Protostar.notes: Unlocked at low HP (33%-). Used while its wings are spread, and it may also reset its current target's hate.

Light Blade.d: Three-hit sword strike dealing severe physical damage to a single target.
Light Blade.notes: Damage scales with distance closed; can be mitigated by kiting.

Great Wheel.d: Area attack that resets enmity on those it hits.

Damning Edict.notes: Signals a period of physical immunity on the Very Difficult (★) battlefield.

Swath of Silence.notes: Signals a period of magic immunity on the Very Difficult (★) battlefield.

Bowels of Agony.notes: Limited-range second-form attack seen on the Very Difficult (★) battlefield.

Cross Reaver.d: Cone attack dealing heavy physical damage (~500-900).

Chant du Cygne.d: Three-hit sword weapon skill with a high critical-hit rate.

Amon Drive.d: Unique scythe weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Havoc Spiral.d: Unique weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Larceny.notes: Steals a beneficial effect from the target; used to counter SP-ability use.

Cloudsplitter.d: Weapon skill dealing damage to a single target.
Cloudsplitter.notes: Favored below 25% HP, alongside Darkness skillchains.

Dominion Slash.d: Unique weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).
Dominion Slash.notes: Absorbable by Utsusemi; can also dispel buffs.

Shield Strike.d: Cone attack dealing ~100 damage with a knockback.
Shield Strike.notes: Knockback may be absorbed by shadows; reduced by Repulse Mantle.

Arrogance Incarnate.d: A modified Spirits Within that strikes targets within ~5 yalms.

Dragonfall.d: Unique weapon skill dealing area damage (~100-300).

Tachi: Fudo.d: Katana weapon skill dealing damage to a single target.

Spirits Within.d: Sword weapon skill dealing damage based on the user’s remaining HP to a single target.

Vicious Kick.d: A kick attack dealing physical damage to a single target.

Gaea Stream.d: Inflicts damage to a single target.

Uranos Cascade.d: Inflicts damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Cronos Sling.d: Inflicts damage to enemies in a cone.

Vortex.d: Inflicts damage and resets hate to enemies in an area of effect.

Stellar Burst.d: Inflicts damage to enemies in an area of effect.

Omega Javelin.d: Inflicts damage and petrification to a single target.

Amatsu: Kazakiri.d: Tachi: Jinpu variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Torima.d: Tachi: Enpi variant. A two-hit attack that inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Yukiarashi.d: Tachi: Yukikaze variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Tsukioboro.d: Tachi: Gekko variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Hanaikusa.d: Tachi: Kasha variant. Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Kamikaeshi.d: Inflicts damage to a single target.

Amatsu: Tsukikage.d: Inflicts damage to a single target and closes the Cosmic Elucidation skillchain.

Oisoya.d: Namas Arrow variant. A ranged attack that inflicts high damage to a single target.

Hane Fubuki.d: Single-target physical damage with an additional Poison effect.

Happobarai.d: AoE physical damage with an additional Stun effect.

Hiden Sokyaku.d: Single-target physical damage with an additional Stun effect.

Shibaraku.d: AoE physical damage with additional Knockback and Stun.

Kagedourou.d: Summons multiple clones of the user. The clones depop once enough damage is dealt to the caster and can also be defeated individually. Used above 50% HP.

Karakuridourou.d: Summons multiple clones below 50% HP. Every clone (and the caster) is masked and invulnerable except one “correct” clone; deal enough damage to the correct clone and the rest depop, resuming the fight.

Tsujikaze.d: AoE magical damage (~14.9′) with Silence, Defense Down, and Magic Defense Down. Used below 50% HP.

Kamaitachi.d: AoE physical damage with major Knockback and a full Dispel. The dispel can be avoided by a shield block or Utsusemi. Used below 50% HP.

Dark Thorn.d: The user gains Dread Spikes and Stoneskin.

Durance Whip.d: Cone physical damage with additional Bio, Bind, and Amnesia.

Moonlight Veil.d: AoE dark magic damage with Terror. Spawns a Dark Gyve. On the ★ battlefield it also inflicts Magic Defense Down.

Petaline Tempest.d: AoE magic damage that lowers Max HP, MP, and TP (up to 1,000).

Subjugating Slash.d: Cone damage with Knockback that dispels up to 3 enhancements. On the ★ battlefield it instead resets enmity and deals a large % of Max HP.

Fatal Allure.d: Cone gaze that Charms and inflicts a 60-second Poison. The charm can be avoided by facing away from the caster. Used while under Trance.

Dark Burst.d: Cone lightning magic damage with Stun that resets all of the user’s ability timers, and summons a Thunder Gyve.

Dark Flare.d: Cone fire magic damage with TP reset and Enmity reduction, and summons a Fire Gyve.

Dark Flood.d: Cone water magic damage with Encumbrance and Knockback, and summons a Water Gyve.

Dark Freeze.d: Cone ice magic damage with Terror and Enmity reduction, and summons an Ice Gyve.

Dark Quake.d: AoE earth magic damage with Bind and Amnesia, and summons an Earth Gyve.

Dark Tornado.d: AoE wind magic damage with a full Dispel and Knockback, and summons a Wind Gyve.

Dark Moon.d: AoE dark magic damage with Weakness, summoning two Dark Gyves. Used below 50% HP.

Dark Sun.d: AoE light magic damage with a chance of Death, summoning two Light Gyves. Used below 50% HP.

Dynastic Gravitas.d: AoE physical attack. Additional effect: Amnesia.

Bellatrix of Light.d: Self-buff: switches Arciela to light mode (higher magic evasion).

Bellatrix of Shadows.d: Self-buff: switches Arciela to dark mode (magic accuracy bonus).

Guiding Light.d: Grants Arciela and Ygnas Magic Defense Boost, Magic Attack Boost, Attack Boost, and Defense Boost.

Illustrious Aid.d: Restores about 1200 HP to Arciela and Ygnas.

Ascension.d: AoE damage; switches Arciela to light mode.

Descension.d: AoE damage; switches Arciela to dark mode.

Dignified Awe.d: AoE. Additional effects: Amnesia and Bind.

Naakual's Vengeance.d: Summons one of the six Naakuals to use a single ability.
Naakual's Vengeance.notes: Achuka → Incinerating Lahar; Colkhab → Incisive Apotheosis; Tchakka → Marine Mayhem; Yumcax → Tiiimbeeer; Hurkan → Static Prison; Kumhau → Glassy Nova.

Ruthlessness.d: Frontal cone: drains about 1500 HP and inflicts Amnesia.

Daybreak.d: AoE damage; starts the 60-second timer for No Quarter.

No Quarter.d: Frontal line dealing up to 9999 damage, distributed among those hit. Used 60 seconds after Daybreak.
No Quarter.notes: Avoid by standing far from August, or by stunning No Quarter. If he is stunned at the 60-second mark he must recast Daybreak to reset the timer.

Oppressive Yawp.d: Very wide area-of-effect dispel. Removes everything except Reraise, Afterglow and signet-like effects.
Oppressive Yawp.notes: Some listings give this move as inflicting Terror instead.

Landfall.d: Area-of-effect damage that knocks players back.

Black Sanctus.d: Instantly KOs any active NPC helpers, and summons a Profane Circle for each helper that falls.

Sanative Shadow.d: Restores the user to full HP once its HP bar becomes shrouded.

Battle Trance.d: Summons Velkk adds (7 Velkk and 1 Puk).

Coming Through.d: Conal damage with knockback. Absorbed by 2 shadows.

Croctastrophe.d: Damage, Amnesia and knockback in a 30-yalm radius.

Galumph.d: Damage, Stun and Attack Down in a 15-yalm radius.

Merciless Mauling.d: Conal damage that removes the target's weapon. Absorbed by 2 shadows.
Merciless Mauling.notes: The weapon-removal effect does not occur when used by the Bozzetto Regent.

Velkkan Ambush.d: Four-hit attack that dispels one effect per hit. Absorbed by 4 shadows.

Nobless Oblige.d: Levels up, restores 15% HP and resets enmity; every other Velkk levels up and uses its one-hour ability.
Nobless Oblige.notes: Bozzetto Regent only. Triggered by defeating a Bozzetto Servitor, or by dealing 25,000+ damage including skillchains — 40,000+ once a Servitor has been defeated.

Sovereign's Edict.d: Grants a magic shield for 15 seconds and causes every other Velkk to use its one-hour ability.

Beguiling Gaze.d: Charms its target with a gaze attack.

HP Cloak.d: Its health bar stays hidden for the whole fight.
HP Cloak.notes: Certain TP moves make the bar briefly visible — that is the only read you get on its HP.

Battle Stances.d: Alternates between spread and folded wings, which changes how it takes damage.
Battle Stances.notes: Wings spread: absorbs damage from any source if the hit lands during a TP move or a cast. Wings folded: absorbs nothing, but takes reduced damage from everything. It switches roughly every three minutes while active and always opens the fight with wings spread, however long you wait to engage.

Ka-thwack.d: Instantly KOs every player and pet in range. A player in range who has Reraise has it dispelled and takes severe dark damage instead.
Ka-thwack.notes: Used at 100%, 69%, 39% and 9% HP. It also grants the user an aura whose debuffs depend on its remaining HP: none above 69%, Avoidance Down and Muddle between 69% and 9%, and potent Plague plus Avoidance Down and Muddle below 9%. Enough damage of the correct element removes the aura.

Booby Prize.d: Inflicts one randomly chosen debuff on targets in an area of effect.
Booby Prize.notes: The roll is one of Defense Down, Magic Defense Down, Attack Down, Magic Attack Down, Blind, Paralysis or Petrify.

Pandora's Gift.d: Restores a moderate amount of HP to all players in range.

Slam.d: Deals damage to a single target.

Scouring Bubbles.notes: Mihli Aliapoh's signature weapon skill; she prefers it over other WS.

Gush o' Goo.d: Deals magic damage in an area around the monster and inflicts Encumbrance, which unequips all gear and blocks equipment changes.
Gush o' Goo.notes: Encumbrance lasts roughly 60 seconds. A Flan-type move; often paired with the Xenoglossia trait, which grants the monster an instant cast on its next spell.

Temblor Blade.d: Area-of-effect sword weapon skill: heavy magic damage and Petrification. Also resets the user's hate.
Temblor Blade.notes: Klara's signature move; used in both of her quest battles.

Darkring Blade.d: Area-of-effect sword weapon skill: heavy damage, knockback and Curse, dropping maximum HP by about half.
Darkring Blade.notes: Klara only uses this in the Bonds of Mythril fight.

Royal Bash.d: An enhanced Shield Bash: single-target damage and Stun.

Essence Jack.d: Used at low health on the player whose gear the Spitewarden copied. Inflicts Terror and lowers all of that player's stats; the Spitewarden's own damage rises sharply, apparently by absorbing what it drains.
Essence Jack.notes: If the copied player is out of range the Spitewarden breaks off its current target and runs at them to land it. Not a hate reset — the behaviour lasts only until Essence Jack connects.

Amorphic Spikes.d: Delivers a fivefold attack. Damage varies with TP.
Amorphic Spikes.notes: Skillchain properties: Gravitation / Transfixion. Weapon-skill attributes are 20% DEX and 20% INT; fTP is 1.0 below 1500 TP and 1.375 from 1500 to 2999. Also a Blue Magic spell, learned from Flan and usable from level 98 for 79 MP and 4 blue magic points, granting INT+5, MND+2 and the Gilfinder trait.

Disembowel.d: Physical damage to enemies in a frontal cone. Additional effect: Accuracy Down.

Extirpating Salvo.d: Physical damage to a single target. Additional effect: Stun.

Boreas Mantle.d: Creates ghostly copies of the user.
Boreas Mantle.notes: Only used by the Phantom Puk in the ISNM Shadows of the Mind. Instead of the ordinary Blink effect it creates replicas of itself (500 HP each).

Behemoth: Resistances are consistent across the family; only NMs (e.g. Sarsaok) differ.
Some NMs shift resistances mid-fight or have gimmicks (proc requirements, changing damage types).
Buffalo: Despoil: Buffalo Hide (Evasion Down), Buffalo Horn (Attack Down), or Buffalo Meat (Slow).
Cerberus: Cerberus and Orthrus subspecies share the same resistances (e.g. -50% magic damage taken).
Cehuetzi: Bite: single-target physical damage with Defense Down (-25%).
Right Claws: single-target ice damage with Magic Defense Down.
Polar Roar creates an aura — Paralysis and Frost on nearby players, Ice Spikes on the mob while it readies TP/casts; enough fire damage removes it.
Weak to blunt (impact) and fire; extremely resistant to ice and wind.
Coeurl: Despoil: Coeurl Meat or Coeurl Hide.
Dhalmel: Despoil: Dhalmel Meat (Defense Down), Dhalmel Hide (Evasion Down), or Giant Femur (Magic Defense Down).
Gnole: Attack, Accuracy, Evasion, Attack Speed, and TP-move potency rise with the Moon Phase, peaking at Full Moon.
Detects by Sight, Sound, and Links while bipedal; Sight only while quadrupedal.
Normally quadrupeds; stance shifts with level, Moon Phase, and time of day (Lv 76 and below never stand; Lobisons 80-82 go bipedal near Full Moon or when provoked).
Bipedal: Hand-to-Hand base damage with Monk-like traits (Kick Attacks, Counter), lower attack. Quadrupedal: lower base damage, higher attack.
A Silver Bullet or Silver Arrow forces the quadrupedal stance.
Manticore: Higher attack delay than most monsters (360 vs ~240).
Despoil: Manticore Hair (Accuracy Down) or Manticore Hide.
Marid: Spawns a Chigoe with each of its first five TP moves.
Tusks can be broken with critical hits or physical TP moves, dropping a Marid Tusk on defeat.
Stealing a Lesser Chigoe from a Marid raises its attack delay from ~325 to ~400.
Despoil: Marid Hide (Defense Down) or Marid Tusk (Attack Down).
Raaz: Behavior includes movement speed and gimmicks (e.g. Silence prevents its TP moves).
Rabbit: TP move Dust Cloud is replaced by Snow Cloud for Rabbits in arctic areas.
Rabbits, Rarabs, Arctic Hares, and Lapinions share the same resistance values.
Despoil: Rabbit Hide (Evasion Down) or Hare Meat (Slow).
Ram: Despoil: Ram Horn (Attack Down) or Ram Skin (Evasion Down).
Tiger: Despoil (Tiger): Black Tiger Fang (Attack Down), Tiger Hide (Evasion Down).
Despoil (Smilodon): Smilodon Liver (Attack Down), Smilodon Hide (Evasion Down).
Adamantoise: Aspidochelone and Tartaruga Gigante gain a potent Regen when they draw their head into their shell — triggered by damage, and reversible by damage.
Bugard: Despoil: Bugard Tusk (Attack Down) or Bugard Skin (Evasion Down).
Eft: Despoil: Eft Skin or H.Q. Eft Skin (Evasion Down), or Lizard Egg (Slow).
Gabbrath: Normal auto-attacks are one of three types: Bite (single-target physical + Defense Down -20%), Charge (frontal AoE physical + Stun, heavy knockback), or Spin (AoE physical, light knockback).
Gradually builds resistance to Stun. Silence prevents its TP moves.
Hill Lizard: The TP move Fireball is replaced by Snowball for lizards that reside in arctic areas.
Despoil: Lizard Tail (Accuracy Down), Lizard Egg (Magic Defense Down), or Lizard Skin (Evasion Down).
Matamata: Has three auto-attacks: a forward bite (single-target, ignores shadows, unblockable by shields), a sideways head swipe (conal, takes shadows, adds Stun), and a full-body spin (AoE, takes shadows, adds Knockback).
Has notable Fire and Water magic evasion.
Peiste: Peistes do not change colour mid-fight — each mob has a fixed colour and resistance profile.
Raptor: The TP move Thunderbolt is replaced by Frost Breath for raptors in arctic areas, or Foul Breath for raptors in arid/tropical regions.
Color variants have different resistances: Blue and Red (temperate, Thunderbolt), Ice Region (arctic/Nival, Frost Breath), and Green (arid/tropical, Foul Breath).
Wivre: Will not turn to face their target.
Have a high Double Attack rate.
Despoil: Wivre Horn (Attack Down) or Wivre Hide (Defense Down).
Wivres ridden by Mamool Ja additionally use Fire Angon, Blazing Angon, and Burning Memories (all AoE Fire).
Antlion: Black Pit-type Antlions are aggressive and hide beneath the ground, invisible to players.
Stepping over a burrowed Pit-type Antlion without Sneak aggravates it and triggers an immediate Pit Ambush.
Bee: Aside from Notorious Monsters, all bee variants share the same resistance values.
Despoil: Beehive Chip (Evasion Down), Giant Stinger (Attack Down), Honey (Accuracy Down).
Beetle: Despoil: Beetle Shell (Defense Down), Beetle Jaw (Attack Down), Insect Wing (Accuracy Down).
Bztavian: Normal auto-attacks are one of three types: Bite (single-target physical + knockback), Slash/Scratch (conal physical + knockback), and Stinger shot (AoE damage + Poison, ~50 HP/tick).
Trait: gains Blink after every TP move (Silence prevents TP moves).
Chapuli: Despoil: Chapuli Horn and Chapuli Wing (Accuracy Down).
Chapuli have Green and Yellow resistance variants; the Green Variant is shown here.
NM variants cast wind-based spells; after any TP move a Chapuli is briefly immune to damage and debuffs.
Chigoe: Possess no TP moves; rapid attack rate.
Non-NM Chigoes are instantly defeated (no XP) when hit by a Bash-type Job Ability, an Automaton Job Ability, any weapon skill, or a critical hit.
Physical attacks may have Additional Effect: Disease.
Spawned (up to 5) when Marid, Marid-X, Grand Marid, Aydeewa Diremite, Wild Karakul, or Mosshorn uses a TP move; the Marid NM Hildesvini spawns 3 Chigoe on every TP move.
Crawler: Poison Breath is replaced with Incinerate for Eruca-type crawlers.
Eruca-type crawlers in outdoor Treasures of Aht Urhgan areas sleep from 21:00 to 6:00 and are not aggressive or linkable then.
Fire weather gives Eruca-type crawlers a very potent Regain effect.
Despoil: Crawler Egg (Slow), Crawler Cocoon (Magic Defense Down).
Diremite: Has a shorter attack delay of 210 (typical is 240).
Despoil: Bloodthread (Magic Defense Down), Avatar Blood (Evasion Down).
Fly: Dragonflies are ectotherms and are especially weak to Ice.
Cursed Sphere is a Dark-based magic attack for the Fly family (it is Water-based only when cast by Blue Mages).
Giant Gnat: Two resistance tables: Black/White (Melisseus) — used by all Giant Gnats except Duke Vepar — and Blue/Green (Duke Vepar), used only by Duke Vepar. Both tables resist every element.
Gnat: Booming Bombilation is used by Midge-type members only.
Ladybug: Only aggressive during daytime; by day it gains enhanced stats and deals more damage.
Daytime moves: Nepenthean Hum, Noisome Powder, Spiral Spin. Sudden Lunge is used only at night.
Searing Effulgence is used by golden (Luckybug) members only.
Mantid: Normal attacks hit as a frontal AoE and consume multiple Utsusemi shadows; may jump for a radial AoE hit.
Preying Posture is a self-buff (Attack/Accuracy/Magic Attack Boost + Intension); it takes four dispels to fully remove.
Death Prophet is a frontal-cone Death move, usually used below 50% HP after Preying Posture.
Mosquito: Introduced with the Eschan zones; a darker, thinner-bodied relative of the Bee family, often found alongside Bees.
Scorpion: Scolopendrids appear in Wings of the Goddess [S] zones; Earth weather grants them Regain, and they give a 10% EXP bonus.
Despoil: Scorpion Claw (Attack Down), Scorpion Shell (INT Down).
Spider: Despoil: Spider Web (Magic Defense Down) or Rainbow Thread (Magic Defense Down).
Twitherym: Typically link with other Twitherym; come in a cloud-of-small-butterflies form and the single large Fluturini form.
Have MP. Despoil: Twitherym Wing (Accuracy Down).
Wamoura: Evolve from certain Wamouracampa left undisturbed in Mount Zhayolm; cross-link with Wamouracampa.
Possess MP (cast Aspir). The Coral-colored subspecies usually shares these resistances, though NM resistances can vary.
Wamouracampa: Larval form of Wamoura; curls and uncurls (physical damage taken -25% while curled, magical -25% while uncurled), pausing to switch.
Reduced movement speed and do NOT track by scent, so linked groups can be escaped. Link with Wamoura. Wamoura Prince evolves into Wamoura in Mount Zhayolm if left alone.
Despoil: Wamoura Cocoon (Magic Defense Down), Wamoura Scale (Magic Attack Down).
Belladonna: Belladonna plantoids charm players and can sacrifice a nearby Rafflesia pet via Full Bloom to restore ~10% HP, erase debuffs, and gain a potent Stoneskin.
Their charm moves (Frond Fatale, Beautiful Death) can be avoided with Charm Buffer, Fealty, or significant magic evasion / Light resistance.
Flytrap: Despoiling a Flytrap can yield a Flytrap Leaf (inflicts Evasion Down).
Palsy Pollen and Soporific bypass Utsusemi shadows.
Funguar: Steal/Despoil results vary by Funguar type and region (ordinary = Sleepshroom); Coppercaps' steal matches the mushrooms left on the cap.
Goobbue: Double Attack can proc on TP moves, spiking damage on moves like Uppercut.
Despoil yields Boyahda Moss or Tree Cuttings (inflicts Accuracy Down).
Leafkin: Family trait: Silence prevents their TP moves (also has movement-speed gimmicks).
Mandragora: Dream Flower (their Sleep AoE) is not used by Lycopodium-type Mandragoras.
Despoil yields a Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud (Defense Down) or Saruta Cotton (Attack Down).
Morbol: Vampiric Lash also absorbs all beneficial status effects when used by Ameretat-type Morbols.
Panopt: Two modes: green-eye (absorbs magic damage, cannot cast) and red-eye (does not absorb, can cast), switched via a backflip animation.
Casts earth magic (Stonega III, Stone V, Quake, Rasp, Enstone, Stoneskin).
When 'planted' (tail in the ground) they cannot move and detect only by Sound; otherwise True Sight (except in Reisenjima).
Rafflesia: Floral Bouquet charms nearby Bees; Bloody Caress then prioritizes draining the charmed Bees' HP over the player.
Despoil yields Rafflesia Vine (Attack Down) or Rafflesia Petal (Defense Down).
Blighted Bouquet is used only by Mitrastema-type Rafflesia.
Sabotender: Despoil yields a Cactuar Needle (Attack Down).
The N,000 Needles / ??? Needles moves deal fixed damage divided among all targets; ??? Needles scales higher while Photosynthesis is active.
Sapling: Saplings are the young form of Treant and will link with Treants.
Despoil yields Vegetable Seeds or Wildgrass Seeds (Defense Down), or a Treant Bulb (Evasion Down).
Snapweed: Weak to Fire and Ice; strongly resists most elements.
Treant: Despoil: Vegetable Seeds and Wildgrass Seeds (Defense Down), Treant Bulb (Evasion Down).
Yggdreant: Basic Moves: Branch Poke (darkness breath, HP drain), Branch Sweep (evasion down), Branch Spin (stun).
Yztarg: Normal melee is one of three types: a single-target triple attack adding Defense Down (-20%, overwrites Cocoon and similar buffs); a conal/frontal AoE with knockback that reduces player TP; and a conal/frontal AoE with Stun.
Two color forms with different resistances: White Yztarg (default — strongly resists Earth, no weakness) and Red Yztarg (weak to Water, resists Fire).
Soulshattering Roar grants the mob a shield that makes it take 0 damage from one physical damage type; remove it with a weapon skill from behind.
Acuex: Resistant to physical damage like other slimes.
Weak to breath damage, magical damage, and skillchains. Magic-based effects that ignore resistance, such as Quick Draw, will not deal extra damage.
Resistant to Slow (via its Earth resistance); however, Despoil applies Slow when successfully stealing Acuex Poison.
Traits: Sleep Resistant and Bind Resistant — an enhanced resistance rank against those effects, separate from elemental resistance.
A slime-like mold from the underworld that likes caves and other dark places.
The Yecuex is a variety of Acuex that appears in Alluvion Skirmish and Vagary. It possesses 20 magic defense and absorbs 30~100 TP with its attacks.
Leech: All varietals of Leeches share the same resistance values, including Obdellas.
Despoil: Bird Blood, Beastman Blood, and Fiend Blood (Evasion Down).
Plovid: Regular attacks are one of three abilities: Jumping Slam (AoE physical damage and poison), Tongue Lash (single-target physical damage and poison), or Spit (conal, magical Water damage and poison).
Slime: Slimes have a degree of resistance to Charm.
Clots in CoP regions have an additional effect of HP drain on their auto-attacks.
Slug: Gains an auto-regen II (12/tick) during Rain weather.
Tracks by scent, and loses track of the player quickly during rain weather or through water — such as in Pashhow Marshlands [S].

The Encumbrance from Fuscous Ooze and Mucilaginous Ooze used to also remove equipment from the player. This was changed in the October 7th 2014 update due to how powerful the loss of iLvl equipment was.
Worm: Will not cast magic unless their target is out of melee range. This does not apply to all worms, but often applies to Notorious Monsters.
Casts earth-based magic only, and Bind.
Worms in the original areas are a job of BLM/BLM, while Rise of the Zilart worms are BLM/RDM.
Despoil: Copper Ore, Darksteel Ore, Iron Ore, Silver Ore, Zinc Ore (Defense Down).
Amphiptere: Fly in the sky and descend on players when detecting them.
Can detect and aggro low HP despite not being undead.
Possess Triple Attack and +20 (120) Magic Defense despite being a WAR/BLM. The red Sanguiptere subspecies have +50 (150) Magic Defense across all examples.
Amphiptere in Beaucedine Glacier [S] and Xarcabard [S] have a 30 minute respawn time.
Builds sleep and bind resistance — sleep resistance building more rapidly, after only a few casts.
Apkallu: Apkallu within Treasures of Aht Urhgan areas have a ZONE-WIDE enmity system — killing them raises "Apkallu Hate" for that zone, which diminishes slowly over time. This does not apply to Apkallu outside ToAU, such as in Abyssea. Each zone has its own Apkallu enmity.

As Apkallu Hate rises their behaviour changes: they start with Yawn as their only TP move and upgrade to more aggressive ones such as Beak Lunge (and stop using Yawn once they reach Wing Slap); they become aggressive towards players who walk by where they are normally passive; their damage reduces until it is nearly nothing; their double attack and counter rates increase; enmity becomes erratic as they switch to any player casting magic, even if the spell is not completed; and at the final stage they run away like Qiqirns to link their friends.

It is unknown how the NPC Apkallu function. They can be fed by trading large fish (such as Ahtapot or Veydal Wrasse), but not all accept fish and the size may matter. When accepting a fish they follow the player around, though the implications are unclear. The NPC can change into a normal foe if enough Apkallu are defeated.
The Inguza are a subspecies of Apkallu once thought extinct, but recently rediscovered at Marjami Ravine in the East Ulbuka Territory.
Despoil: Apkallu Feather (Evasion Down), Apkallu Egg (Slow).
Bat: Three of the six TP moves are area-gated: Marrow Drain and Subsonics are CoP/ToAU areas only, and Supersonics is ToAU areas only. Bats in the base-game areas have only Blood Drain, Ultrasonics and Soul Accretion.
Despoil: Bat Wing (Accuracy Down), Beastman Blood and other bloods (Evasion Down).
Colibri: Colibri are officially labeled as "hummingbirds" despite behaving like parrots (mimic magic) and having a beak like a toucan's — likely for their rapid hummingbird wing movement, and because "colibri" means hummingbird in Romanian.
Colibri can reflect White Magic, Black Magic, Songs and Ninjutsu back at players, but not Blue Magic. Not all colibri can reflect — Lesser Colibri and the ones in Sheol C are exceptions.
Colibri have the traits of a Red Mage, which means increased Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Defense Bonus.
Snatch Morsel is resistible with magic evasion and fire resistance+. You need a fire resistance value greater than 0, no matter your magic evasion level.
Despoil: Colibri Feather (Evasion Down), Colibri Beak (Attack Down).
Flock Bat: Two of the four standard TP moves are area-gated: Slipstream and Turbulence are CoP/ToAU areas only. Bats in the base-game areas have only Jet Stream and Sonic Boom.
Knife Edge Circle and Train Fall are not part of the standard kit. Only Tres Duendes is known to use them (its second and third forms).
Despoil: Bat Wing (Accuracy Down), Beastman Blood and other bloods (Evasion Down).
Greater Bird: Typical job: Warrior, White Mage, or Black Mage; typical sub: Warrior, Bard, or Red Mage.
Greatly resist dark-based sleeps, but light-based sleeps are not resisted.

NMs and the Gagana subtype swap their ordinary TP moves for enhanced versions: Gliding Spike becomes Dread Dive, Scratch becomes Blind Vortex, Triple Attack becomes Giga Scream, and Stormwind becomes Dread Wind. Feather Barrier is shared by both sets. The swap is per-move, not all-or-nothing - Suzaku keeps Stormwind, and Kreutzet, Gandji, Langmeidong and Zacatzontli use the standard set outright.
Lesser Bird: Despoil: Bird Egg (Evasion Down) or Bird Feather (Accuracy Down).
Blind Side Barrage, Broadside Barrage and Damnation Dive are gated to CoP and ToAU areas. Notorious Monsters use an enhanced conal version of the two Barrages.
Waktza: The entire kit is Magical / Lightning — all six moves, no exceptions.
Crashing Thunder grants the thunder wing aura: -Damage Taken on the mob plus Avoidance Down on players. Earth-based damage removes it — a magic burst, a skillchain, or Lunge.
Hippogryph: THIS FAMILY BREAKS THE BIRD PIERCING RULE. Its grid row 1 is 100% across all eight — no physical weakness and no physical resist. General Notes say it outright: they do not take bonus damage from piercing. Every other Bird family is Piercing/Ranged +25%.
Killing one grants a 15% experience point bonus.
Despoil: Hippogryph Tailfeather (Evasion Down) or Hippogryph Feather (Accuracy Down).
Hoof Volley is used by Notorious Monsters only.
Harpeia: Resists no melee damage type at all — Slashing, Blunt and H2H are all 100%. The resistance is on Magical (87.5%) and Breath (75%) instead. Unusual for a Bird family.
Crab: Despoil: Land Crab Meat (Slow), Crab Shell (Defense Down).
Standard kit is 5 moves. Mega Scissors and Venom Shower are restricted: Mega Scissors is used by Karkinos, Krabimanjaro and Krabkatoa, Venom Shower by those three plus Krabakarpo.
Bubble Shower is a breath-type move: its damage scales with the crab's remaining HP.
Craklaw: Normal melee attacks can be one of three types: Slash (a 3-hit attack), Pincer (conal, additional effect Defense Down -20%), and Spin (AoE, additional effect Stun). These are melee variants, not TP moves.
Frog: DOES NOT HAVE ANY TP ABILITIES — the whole family. Possesses low melee delay instead.
Links with other Frogs, and also with Poroggos.
Magic Defense by colour: Green Toads 100, Red Toads 100, Blue Toads 70.

Lore: during the Age of Magic the Windurstian hero Samariri used forbidden magic to enlarge the toads being trampled on the paths of Windurst Waters; they kept growing and turned into beastmen (the Poroggos). The toads of the Sarutabaruta area and the Flume Toads in the canals beneath Windurst are uniquely extra large and have MP, which is why researchers believe they are the closest living relatives of the toads from the old texts.
Orobon: Lanterns can be broken via critical hits; this makes the Orobon also drop an Orobon Lure.

Abominable Belch, Deathgnash, Leeching Current and Mayhem Lantern are restricted, not part of the standard kit. The standard kit is Gnash / Hypnic Lamp / Seaspray / Seismic Tail / Sonic Buffet. Mayhem Lantern needs its lanterns attached and is Ogrebon's alone.
Pteraketos: Neither the standard nor the Horned resistances hold a single weakness: full damage from all eight damage types, and every element resisted.
Pugil: Despoil: Fish Scales, Pugil Scales (Magic Defense Down).
Rockfin: Every member is an NM - Dakuwaqa (Delve), Ngai (Odyssey) and Tchakka (Wildskeeper Reive). There is no standard Rockfin.
It is all resistance and no weakness: Fire and Water 15%, Dark 30%, Lightning and Earth 70%, Wind/Light/Ice 50%.
Auto-attacks are chosen from one of three types: Bite (single target, Defense Down), Thrust (conal, knockback) and Spin (spins in place, AoE, knockback).

Shared kit of six TP moves, ungated: Protolithic Puncture, Aquatic Lance, Pelagic Cleaver, Carcharian Verve, Tidal Guillotine and Marine Mayhem. Carcharian Verve is the pivot - it buffs the user and opens the window for Marine Mayhem, which is only ever used straight after it.
Ruszor: Ruszors have a longer than standard attack delay.
All Ruszor TP moves are self-target, and can happen even if no player is in range of them.
Despoil: Ruszor Meat (Slow), Ruszor Hide (Defense Down), Ruszor Fang (Attack Down).
Sea Monk: A warrior type monster which attacks with Hand-to-hand, and can double attack.

Resistances go by the colour of the model: the Kulushedra types (Kulushedra, Bathybic Kulushedra, Kraken Kulushedra, Somnial Kulushedra) are white and blue and take the second set; every other Sea Monk is orange and black.
Uragnite: Hides in its shell after being out of it for 40 seconds. Dealing physical damage above a threshold sends it into its shell early - the threshold is the mob's current HP divided by 10, rounded down, and never goes below 1% (so at 100% HP it is 10%).
The shell lasts 9 ticks (27 seconds), and it recovers 1% HP a tick (every 3 seconds) while inside.
Gains double defense and takes -75% magic damage while inside its shell.
Will retaliate with Gas Shell if physically attacked while inside its shell.
Has a longer than usual melee delay at 290.
Despoil: Seashell (Magic Defense Down) and Uragnite Shell (Defense Down).
Corpselight: Family possesses a Breath and Magic damage taken reduction of 16/256 (6.3%).
Corse: Ordinary Corse carry a standard 100 Magic Defense; Notorious Monsters tend to have a comparably higher value. Add their higher INT and a 25% cut to magic damage and Corse are a bit more resilient to magic than other foes.
Robe colour gates two moves: Final Retribution is "Staff wielding Corses only" and Hadal Summons is "Purple Robe Corses (Kumakatok) only".
Defiant: Regular attacks are one of four abilities, each dealing dark-elemental magical damage: Orb Toss (AoE damage and Bio; removes shadows), Claw Attack (damage and Stun), Orb Backhand (damage and Blind), or Kick (AoE damage and Knockback).
Fomor: Shadows are the Elvaan types in chainmail, typically found in The Eldieme Necropolis. They predate Fomors and keep their own resistances, but operate as a sub-species of Fomor.
Shadows use only Dimensional Death, though some Shadow notorious monsters can also use Fomor TP moves.
Foxfire is used only by Fomors wielding a one-handed weapon, Grim Halo only by those wielding a two-handed weapon, and Shackled Fists only by those fighting hand-to-hand.

Fomor Hate: every Fomor you defeat widens the aggressive detection range of Fomors in Lufaise Meadows, Misareaux Coast, Phomiuna Aqueducts and Sacrarium. Defeating Tavnazian beastmen reverses it — 50 kills resets it from maximum. Resauchamet at (K-7) on the top floor of Tavnazian Safehold will tell you your current level.
At maximum Fomor Hate (level 4), trading a Fomor Codex to a Stale Draft spawns the Swift Belt notorious monsters in Sacrarium — one per playable race.
Ghost: Floating pieces of cloth possessed by spirits. Unaware of their passage into the afterlife, they return to possess their former clothing, and unwittingly sow death and misery with their deadly pranks.
Despoil steals Cotton Cloth or Linen Cloth and inflicts Magic Defense Down.
Hound: Despoil steals Wolf Hide (Evasion Down) or Revival Root.
Naraka: Three types of normal attack (JA autos): single, conal, and self-centred AoE.
Alternates between Raksha Stance (-50% magic damage taken) and Yaksha Stance (-50% physical damage taken); the stance in effect decides which TP moves it can use.
Qutrub: Takes double damage from every source, and has triple the HP of a typical monster.

The damage multiplier double-dips, so hybrid weapon skills and skillchains are especially effective: a skillchain built off an already-doubled weapon skill can land around four times the usual damage, more again with a Holy Circle potency bonus.
Abilities that restore HP or MP from the damage they deal, such as Spirit Taker, gain the same advantage as long as they work on undead.
Black Mage type Qutrub carry Thief traits of the same level, which makes them more evasive than the Dark Knight type.
Vampyr: Hand-to-Hand type Vampyrs always attack twice.
Resists almost everything: Light is its only weakness (+15%), and it takes just 5% damage from Dark.
Skeleton: Not susceptible to dark-based Sleep spells.
The armored and robed skeletons in Reisenjima have the same resistance values as an ordinary skeleton.
Despoil yields a Bone Chip and lowers its magic defense.
Acrolith: Each time an Acrolith uses the TP move Detonating Grip, it loses one arm.
An Acrolith cannot use Detonating Grip when it possesses no arms.
The TP move Dismemberment can only be used after an Acrolith loses both arms.
Bomb: Outdoor spawns occur only during Fog weather, usually in the mornings (2:00-7:00).
Indoor and underground spawns occur at all times of day with no weather requirement.
Heat Wave and Vulcanian Impact are used only in CoP and ToAU areas; Hellstorm only in ToAU areas.
Djinn: When Djinn are hit with elemental damage (including en-spells) they gain 1,000 TP.
Useful for Beastmaster leveling: it makes them blow up on beast pets for quick EXP.
Cardian: Job varies by card suit — Batons: Black Mage, Coins: Red Mage, Cups: White Mage, Swords: Paladin.
Weak to all elements (+30%); resists Magical damage (-25%).
Caturae: Arcana chess-piece NMs — each has Black/White model variants (Pawn through King).
Many gain a damage-immunity shield via Stygian Sphere or Tabbiyaa Gambit; magic damage (or a random damage type) removes it.
Jobs and elemental resistances vary per member; most are tier-V Black Mage casters.
Six chess-piece models (Black/White each): Pawn=Sippoy, Knight=Kutharei, Bishop=Yaanei, Rook=Iratham, Queen=Rani, King=Raja — every other member reuses one of these six.
Cluster: A cluster of bombs (Related: Bomb) — weak to Fire (+30%), resists every other element (-40%).
Uses Self-Destruct once per bomb at set HP thresholds (66% / 32% / 20%); several moves scale with the number of bombs still in the cluster.
Detector: The Arcana "Spheroid" globes (Detector family) — weak to all physical (+25%) and to Lightning (+50%).
Mimic: Treasure-chest Arcana mimics — the standard family resists all physical damage (-50%).
Use single-target Draw In and a very low attack delay (~170).
Doll: The Doll family's Berserk grants Warcry (Attack +33%) rather than the Berserk effect.
Evil Weapon: Possesses a Magic Defense Bonus trait.
Evil Weapons are ordinary weapons exposed to a strange energy that gained a will of their own and enslaved kobolds to do their bidding; they must stay near the source of their power to survive.
Weak to Fire and Light (+50%) and to Wind, Lightning, and Earth (+30%); neutral to Ice, Water, and Dark.
Golem: Despoil: Mythril Ore (Defense Down) or Golem Shard (Magic Defense Down).
Volcanic Wrath is used only by red golems.
Grimoire: Generally possess a massive Magic Defense (e.g. Rw Nw Prt M Hrw has a Magic Defense of 300).
The only TP move used is Exponential Burst (heavy AoE damage and Magic Defense Down); Grimoires are primarily spellcasters.
Mammets: Switches between four battle forms roughly every 30 seconds — Hand-to-Hand, Sword, Polearm, and Staff — which changes the TP moves it can use.
Hand Form’s Transmogrification absorbs physical damage as HP; Staff Form’s Mind Wall absorbs offensive magic as HP (each ~30s).
Marolith: Appear as dormant rocks and boulders, but rise up once disturbed (similar to Iron Giants).
Tectonic Shift is used only by Notorious Monsters.
Iron Giant: JA auto-attacks carry additional effects — Stomp: Amnesia; Lateral Swing: Knockback; Vertical Swing: Stun.
Orange Giants also resist Breath damage (~-12.5%); Blue Giants and the floating Head variant do not.
The floating head variant (Ironclad Observer) uses its own moves: Auger Smash, Area Bombardment, and Cauterizing Field.
Khimaira: Fulmination is the signature move: massive AoE Thunder damage (600-1100) with Stun and potent Paralysis.
Takes full physical damage but strongly resists magic, Breath and every element (Lightning most of all).
Khrysokhimaira variants (with "Khrysokhimaira" in the name) are less resistant overall and add Lithic Breath (frontal Petrifaction + Weakness).
Magic Pot: Strong against magic (halves it) and resists every element; no elemental weakness. Break them with Blunt or Hand-to-Hand physical damage (weak to both).
Possesses Magic Defense Bonus and Double Attack scaled to its RDM/WAR level. Despoil yields a Magic Pot Shard (Magic Defense Down).
Aggro is by magic: they detect and attack players who use magic nearby.
Magic Millstones (with "Millstone" in the name) are stylized magic pots found in Pso’Xja; functionally identical.
Ahriman: Immune to Silence outside of Stymie.
Despoil: Ahriman Tears (INT Down), Ahriman Wing (Accuracy Down).
Gallu: Attacks count as abilities rather than normal melee swings (Melees are Abilities trait): they get TP-move treatment, cannot be countered, occur even with no players nearby, and are prevented by Silence.
Three melee attacks: Triple Punch (single-target 3-hit), Claw Swipe (conal, +Stun), Ground Punch (AoE, +Bind).

Shared elemental TP kit, one move per element: Bolt of Perdition (Lightning), Crippling Rime (Ice), Diluvial Wake (Water), Divesting Gale (Wind), Kurnugi Collapse (Earth), Searing Halitus (Fire), Oblivion’s Mantle (Dark, 10-count Doom).
Two models (Purple / White Gallu) with identical resistances except Breath (Purple -62.5%, White -25%); NO subtype — grid assigned per mob by model.
Macuil: Regular attacks are one of three abilities (Melees are Abilities): Gust (Wind — Choke ~-18 HP/tic + knockback, passes through shadows), Lightning (shock ~-18 HP/tic + Stun, removes all shadows), and a 3-hit Triple Attack (absorbed by three shadows).

Its hands carry an elemental aura (Wind or Thunder) that sets which TP moves it can use and shifts its resistances: Wind hand -> Chokehold, Tearing Gust, Shrieking Gale; Thunder hand -> Zap, Concussive Shock, Undulating Shockwave.
Macuil's Shrieking Gale is Wind damage + knockback (the shared ability entry shows the Harpeia Dispel variant).
Gargouille: Alternates between standing and flying modes (~every 3+ minutes; lands again after waiting or taking enough damage; some NMs switch modes after a set amount of damage). Gains +60 Evasion while flying, and certain NMs (e.g. Wasserspeier) avoid all melee attacks while flying.
Available TP moves change with mode: standing -> Bloody Claw, Terror Eye, Triumphant Roar; flying -> Dark Orb, Dark Mist. Shadow Burst is NM-only, below 50% HP.
Despoil yields Gargouille Eye (Accuracy Down), Gargouille Horn (Attack Down), or Gargouille Shank (Magic Defense Down).
Demon: Moves at roughly 150% of normal speed (Increased Movement Speed).
Typical jobs: Warrior, Dark Knight, Black Mage, Summoner.

Comes in Black and Red variants. Black Demons are weak to Light (~+30%) and take normal damage from other elements; Red Demons are weak to Light (~+15%) but resist all other elements (~-15%). Both resist Magic damage (~-25%).
Standard TP moves: Demonic Howl, Hecatomb Wave, Soul Drain. Some members add restricted moves: Condemnation (Dark Kindred), Hellborn Yawp (Shadowsoul/Abununnu/Count Bifrons), Quadrastrike.
Dvergr: Most Dvergr NMs carry a large Magic Defense Bonus (~+30-50) and very high INT. Apex Powercrazed Dvergr have neutral Magic Defense but the highest INT (455) of any non-NM foe in the game.

Standard TP moves: Bilgestorm, Cackle, Hellsnap, Hellclap, Necrobane, Necropurge, Thundris Shriek. Naphula and Fjalar also use Dunur Strike (strips equipment) and Bilrost Squall (random-element AoE + enfeebles).
Imp: An imp's horn can be broken with critical hits or a weapon skill that deals critical damage; the horn regrows after a time.
Without its horn an imp cannot use Abrasive Tantara or Deafening Tantara, and resorts to Frenetic Rip.

With its horn intact an imp resists more (Wind 60%, Dark 20%, and neutral to Lightning/Ice/Earth/Water); once the horn is broken it opens up to Fire/Lightning/Light/Ice/Earth/Water weakness while its Wind and Dark resistance eases.
Despoil yields an Imp Wing (Accuracy Down).
Soulflayer: Despoil yields Soulflayer Staff (Magic Attack Down) or Soulflayer Robe (Magic Defense Down).
Detects Magic and Job Abilities out to 20′ and has True Sound within 5′.
Black Mage / Blue Mage. Casts elemental and enfeebling magic and resists Water and Dark spells (and Silence).

Some Soulflayers change to a Black Robe mid-fight, shifting resistances to: Magical -25, Fire/Wind/Lightning/Earth -30, Light -15, Ice -50, Water -90, Dark -95 (no weaknesses). Taelmoth the Diremaw is permanently in this Black Robe state.
Any Soulflayer can use Reprobation (an AoE full Dispel) once brought to low HP.
Taurus: As Monks, Taurus fight with Hand-to-Hand and can Counter, Guard, and land Kick Attacks.
Despoil steals a Demon Horn or Demon Skull, each of which applies a stat Down.
Dragon: Type: Dragon. Typical Job: Warrior. Detects by Sound. Despoil yields Dragon Blood (Evasion Down).
Non-NM Dragons use only a subset of the family kit: Body Slam OR Heavy Stomp, only one type of breath, and only one of the three songs (Lodesong / Voidsong / Thornsong).
Songs (Lodesong, Voidsong, Thornsong, Nullsong) are not used while the dragon is silenced.

Dahak (red) variant: silencing it grants a 150 TP/tick regain but blocks its Song abilities. Every instance of water damage (including Enwater or Unda runes) reduces its TP by 300; every instance of fire damage increases its TP by 500.
Purple variant: uses Discordant Note (knockback + Slow, Silence and a very potent Gravity).
Hydra: Type: Dragons. Typical Job: Warrior. Detects by Sound. Immune to Breath damage; highly resistant to all magic and to weapon damage.
Three-headed. Heads break off to critical hits, Weapon Skills or damaging Job Abilities and regenerate over time. Which head is alive gates its TP moves.

Pyric Bulwark grants an undispelable Magical Shield (right head); Polar Bulwark grants an undispelable Physical Shield (left head). Bring mixed physical/magical damage. In Nyzul Isle the head requirements are reversed.
Gains Nerve Gas (AoE damage + a -50% HP/MP Curse + Poison) at low HP while all three heads are alive.
Zilant: Type: Dragons · Typical Job: Warrior · Dark Crystal · detects by Sight and Sound.
Positional cone family: Dexter Wing hits from the right, Sinister Wing from the left, Dancing Tail from behind, and Soul Douse / Chaos Blast / Abyssic Buster from the front.

Wing state changes the damage it takes: both wings up = -25% physical / -75% magical; both wings down = -75% physical / -25% magical. It also takes extra physical and magical damage while casting a spell or readying a weapon skill.
Its wing moves stack the family's spread of down-effects — Attack, Magic Attack, Accuracy, Magic Accuracy, Defense and Magic Defense Down.
When its wings are up its TP moves gain extra effects (e.g. Dark Star adds Defense/Magic Defense Down; Soul Douse's Doom becomes a faster 5-count).
Chilling Roar inflicts AoE Terror; on Notorious Monsters it also summons adds and/or raises the monster's level.
Puk: Gains 1,000 TP when hit with magic matching the day’s element (includes Enspells, Reprisal, Sleep, etc.); never gains a Regain or Store TP effect.
Reduced attack delay of 200 (vs. the standard 240).
Job combo is BRD/BRD despite not using songs (typical job Bard).
Family kit: Crosswind, Obfuscate, Wind Shear, Zephyr Mantle. Ill Wind is used only by Mamook Puks and NMs; White Wind only by Peapuks (once) and NMs (at will).
Despoil steals Puk Wing (also inflicts Accuracy Down), Puk Egg (Slow), or Chimera Blood (Evasion Down).
Wind wyverns — a chimera of dragon and vermin; capable of speech and sometimes serve the Mamool Ja Savages. Wind-based attackers.
Wyvern: Three subspecies with distinct resistances: Brown (base — resists Fire, weak to Wind/Earth/Light/Dark), Blue (heavily resists most elements and all physical except Slashing; weak to Lightning and Slashing), and Green (resists Fire/Ice; weak to Wind/Earth/Light/Dark).
The Ajattara (Green Wyvern) subspecies gains an attack-speed bonus after enough wind damage is dealt to it.
Despoil steals Wyvern Scales (also inflicts Magic Defense Down).

Standard kit: Dispelling Wind, Dread Shriek, Deadly Drive, Fang Rush, Wind Wall, Radiant Breath, Tail Crush, Thunder Breath, plus the typical enhanced Wyvern movement speed. Notorious Monsters use enhanced variants (Deadly Dive, Dreaded Shriek) and extra elemental breaths (Hurricane / Blizzard / Chaos).
Detects by Sight only (not true sight or sound; does not track by scent).
Wyvern (Dragoon Pet): The wyvern avatars summoned by various Notorious Monsters (Dragoon-style pets); Bestiary Type = Dragons.
Weak to all eight elements (+30%); resistances may change during battle.
Use six single-element Frontal breaths: Flame (Fire), Frost (Ice), Gust (Wind), Hydro (Water), Lightning, and Sand (Earth).
Wyrm: Four elemental resist profiles keyed to the Wyrm’s element: Standard & Fire (resists Fire/Lightning, weak Light), Ice (resists Ice/Lightning, weak Fire), Earth (resists Wind/Water, weak Ice), Dark (resists Dark, weak Earth/Light). All strongly resist Magical (~-40 to -50%).
Magic damage taken varies by instance: KSNM99 ±0%, HNMs -50% (and -50% Ranged), ENM Ouryu Cometh -50%, ENM Wyrmking Descends -40%. Resistances may change mid-battle.
Kit splits by posture: ground breaths (Fiery/Geotic/Glacial/Sable/Dragon Breath), sky blasts (Flame/Inferno/Orche/Sleet Blast), and elemental wings (Bai/Hurricane/Tebbad/Gregale/Cyclone Wing).

Plus Absolute Terror (Terror), Horrid Roar (dispel + enmity reset), and Spike Flail (tail move, rear arc). Which breath/blast/wing a given Wyrm uses depends on its element and whether it is grounded or flying.
Aern: Despoil steals Aern Organ or Luminian Tissue (Defense Down).
Typical jobs vary across the family (Bard, Beastmaster, Black Mage, Monk, Ranger, Red Mage, Thief).
Uses a weapon-dependent TP move in addition to the core kit: Hand-to-Hand → Sideswipe, Axe → Biotic Boomerang, Polearm → Medusa Javelin, Sword → Glacier Splitter, Dagger → Disseverment.
Euvhi: Detects by Sound. Despoil steals Euvhi Organ or Luminian Tissue.
Shifts between an open flower (Bloomed) form and a closed bud (Petal) form roughly every 80 seconds in combat; aggressive while open, passive while closed.
In Petal (bud) form gains +100% Defense Bonus with standard weapon damage and delay; in Bloomed (flower) form has no Defense Bonus but +50% weapon damage and faster (3s) delay.
Higher-than-standard Magic Defense Bonus (120). Uses different TP moves depending on its current form (see ability notes).
Drops elemental crystal clusters rather than a single element, and grants a 10% EXP bonus on defeat.
Hpemde: Detects by Sound. Passive-aggressive: aggros and follows, but only turns hostile once something reduces its HP.
Takes reduced damage in its default closed-mouth form; after taking damage it opens its mouth and then takes increased damage. A single large hit tends to flip it between the two forms.
Despoil steals a Hpemde Organ or Luminian Tissue.
Phuabo: Detects by Sound. Possesses MP. Has enhanced movement speed and grants a 10% EXP bonus on defeat.
Xzomit: Detects by Sound. Despoil steals a Xzomit Organ or Luminian Tissue.
Buffs itself with Molluscous Mutation (Defense Bonus) and Saline Coat (Magic Defense Bonus); Siphon Discharge is a frontal water attack for 10% of its current HP (capped at 500).
Wynav: Related to the Wyvern (Dragoon Pet). The only family member, Aern’s Wynav, is the summoned pet/add of Absolute Virtue, Warder of Courage and Ix’aern.
Its resistances and TP moves are undocumented (the family page lists every resistance as unknown).
Yovra: Commonly called "UFOs". Grants a 37.5% EXP bonus, possesses MP, and is generally immune to Paralyze (it has no native Magic Defense Bonus trait).

Al’Taieu Yovra track by scent and are true sound (their water does not wash off scent), have a 50 HP/tick Regen (reduced over land), and add Paralysis on melee hits. Eschan Yovra are only Sound and can be slipped with Sneak.
Despoil steals a Yovra Organ or Luminian Tissue.
Antica: Ant-like Beastmen of the Altepa deserts and Quicksand Caves. Detect by Sound; drop a Dark Crystal.
Weak to most elements (Wind especially); resist Earth and Dark. Physical and magical damage taken normally.

Standard kit: Jamming Wave (AoE Silence), Sandstorm (AoE Blind), Sand Trap (AoE Petrify + hate reset), Sand Shield / Sand Veil (self Def / Eva up), Shoulder Slam (Knockback), Spikeball (Poison), Magnetite Cloud (breath + Weight).
Typical jobs across the family: Warrior, Black Mage, Paladin, Ranger.
Bugbear: Beastmen of the Movalpolos tunnels — Moblin-bred slaves (related to Goblins) with enhanced strength and a transplanted extra brain and eyes. Link with other Bugbears, Moblins and Goblins.
Detect by Sight and Scent. Night Vision: sight-detection within ~10 yalms / 60-degree cone in darkness (dungeons or nighttime), reduced outdoors during the day. Silence prevents their TP moves.
Weak to most elements (Light especially); resist Dark. Lightning Crystal; Typical Job Monk.
Standard kit: Bionic Boost (self Counterstance), Earthshock (AoE phys + Stun), Flying Hip Press (AoE Wind magical damage), Heavy Whisk (cone phys + Knockback), Heavy Blow (single phys).
Gigas: Giant Beastmen of Delkfutt's Tower, Qufim, Korroloka, the Movalpolos approaches and the northern glaciers. Link with other Gigas.
Despoil (Wool Thread / Wool Cloth) inflicts Evasion Down. Detect by Sight; Ice Crystal. Typical jobs: Warrior, Monk, Ranger, Beastmaster.

Resistances vary by variant. Base Green Gigas and the Jotunn variant (Jotunn Gatekeeper/Hallkeeper/Wallkeeper/Wildkeeper, named Jotunn) are weak to Earth and resist Lightning. The ice variants (Cold/Rime/Sleet/Snow/Blizzard/Frost/Graupel/Hail Gigas, Humbaba) are weak to Fire and resist Ice. The armored variant (Briareus + the Campaign (S) crew) resists all eight elements. A fourth 'Tattooed (Uranos)' all-neutral grid is published but its members are not yet assigned.

Standard kit: Grand Slam / Trebuchet / Catapult / Power Attack (physical), Impact Roar and Ice Roar (fan-shaped roars), Lightning Roar (magical thunder), Moribund Hack (ice, Paralyze + hate reset), Colossal Blow (enmity reset + Knockback), Mercurial Strike (fixed 111-1111 magical). Some NMs also use Colossal Slam, Mighty Strikes or Familiar.
Goblin: Beastmen tribe found across nearly every region of Vana'diel — tinkerers, merchants and mercenaries who fight with an improvised arsenal (bombs, dice, frying pans). Related to the Moblins of Movalpolos; link with other Goblins.
Detect by Sight and Scent. Fire Crystal. Typical Jobs: Thief, Warrior, Ranger, Dark Knight, Beastmaster, Black Mage, White Mage.

Weak to every element except Dark (Light especially, +50%); Dark is neutral. Goblins in Dynamis/Divergence take less elemental damage and resist Dark. Moblins resist Dark more (-30%) and are neutral to Earth.

Bomb Toss can backfire — the goblin drops its bomb, killing itself and dealing damage based on its remaining HP (Bomb Toss (Dropped)). Paralysis Shower, Crispy Candle and Smokebomb can also backfire and then only affect the goblin itself (except in Dynamis).

Standard Goblin kit: Goblin Rush (3-hit + Knockback), Bomb Toss (Fire AoE, magic accuracy scales with TP), Smokebomb (Dark cone Blind), Crispy Candle (Fire cone). Goblins in Dynamis/Divergence and Wings of the Goddess "Moblin-look" areas additionally use Moblin TP moves — Frypan (AoE + Stun), Paralysis Shower (Ice cone Paralysis) — and Goblin Dice (random effect; Vanguard goblins, Moblin Fantocciniman and the summoned Choplix only).
Moblin kit: Goblin Rush, Frypan, Paralysis Shower. Despoil: Goblin Chocolate / Goblin Bread (Defense Down), Goblin Stew / Goblin Mushpot (Magic Defense Down).
Lamiae: Serpent-bodied Beastmen of the Near East (Aht Urhgan) — the Lamiae. Their aquatic kin the Merrow (and the Nix dancers) share the family; the Gorgon sisters Medusa, Stheno and Euryale are its petrifying elite. Link with other Lamiae.

Detect by Sight. Water Crystal. Lamiae carry a higher Magic Defense Bonus than most monsters (~110 vs the standard 100; Notorious Monsters often higher still). Typical Jobs: Ranger, Corsair, Summoner, Black Mage, Bard, Samurai, Red Mage.

Lamia (base) are weak to Fire/Wind/Earth (+15%) and Lightning/Light/Ice (+30%); they resist Water (-40%), Dark (-30%) and Magical (-12.5%). Merrow are weak to Fire/Wind/Earth (+15%) and Lightning (+30%) and strongly resist Water (-50%). Gorgon (Medusa/Stheno) variants have a guaranteed partial resist to every element except — ironically — Earth.

The kit is weapon/job/type-gated. Universal: Tail Slap (physical cone + Stun). Lamia-only: Hypnotic Sway (single gaze, Amnesia). Merrow-only: Torrent (strips all equipment, water-based). Weapon-gated: Arrow Deluge (Bow), Gusting Gouge (one-handed, Wind damage + Knockback), Pole Swing (Staff), Tidal Slash (Polearm); if a Lamia loses its weapon it uses Hysteric Barrage instead (consumes 5 shadows). Corsair Lamia use Dukkeripen (a random Phantom Roll effect).

Notorious Monster Lamia add Belly Dance (AoE gaze Charm) and Grim Reaper (physical cone + Doom); NM Merrow add Rising Swell (strips all equipment). Gorgons (Medusa/Stheno) use escalating HNM petrify moves as their HP drops — Petrifaction (single), Calcifying Deluge (long conal petrify + ~600 damage), Gorgon Dance (sight-based AoE petrify within ~20'), Pinning Shot (moderate ranged AoE, 2 shadows). Despoil: Lamian Kaman -1.
Mamool Ja: The Mamool Ja are a reptilian Beastmen race of the Near East (Aht Urhgan). They field a broad job spread — Thief, Ninja, Warrior, Dragoon, Blue Mage, White Mage and Black Mage — and yield a Wind Crystal.
Detects by Sight. Weak to Lightning, Ice (strongest) and Dark; resists Wind.

Every Mamool Ja uses Somersault Kick (physical + Knockback), Warm-Up (self Accuracy/Evasion Boost) and Firespit — a fire attack that is a 3-hit physical strike for melee jobs (BLU/BST/DRG/NIN/THF) but single-target fire magic for casters (BLM/WHM).

Beyond the base kit, an individual Mamool Ja uses a job-gated art: Forceful Blow (H2H), Rushing Drub (WHM/BLM), Rushing Slash (BST), Rushing Stab (DRG) or Vorpal Blade (BLU) — all single-target physical. Notorious Monsters can additionally use Groundburst (AoE fire).
Despoil (THF) on a Mamool Ja can steal a Tariqah -1 and inflicts Defense Down.
